items.question: Find employees who manage at least two direct reports. Show the manager employee id and the count of direct reports.
items.sql: SELECT mgr_emp_id, COUNT(*) FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mgr_emp_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY mgr_emp_id ASC;

items.question: Show the employee id and full name for employees who are in the same department as their direct manager.
items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm FROM emp AS t1 INNER JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.mgr_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t1.dept_cd = t2.dept_cd ORDER BY t1.emp_id ASC;

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, list the entire management chain above employee 'E-008' from their direct manager upward. Show employee id, full name, and level.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE mgr_tree AS (SELECT t.emp_id, t.emp_nm, t.mgr_emp_id, 1 AS lvl FROM emp AS t WHERE t.emp_id = (SELECT mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-008') UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, mt.lvl + 1 FROM emp AS e INNER JOIN mgr_tree AS mt ON e.emp_id = mt.mgr_emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, lvl FROM mgr_tree ORDER BY lvl ASC, emp_id ASC;

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, list all subordinates under manager 'E-001' at any level down the tree. Show employee id, full name, and depth level.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE sub_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 1 AS lvl FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, st.lvl + 1 FROM emp AS e INNER JOIN sub_tree AS st ON e.mgr_emp_id = st.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, lvl FROM sub_tree ORDER BY lvl ASC, emp_id ASC;

items.question: Find the maximum management depth (number of reporting steps) from the top-level executives down to the lowest reports in the company using a recursive CTE.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE depth_cte AS (SELECT emp_id, 1 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, d.depth + 1 FROM emp AS e INNER JOIN depth_cte AS d ON e.mgr_emp_id = d.emp_id) SELECT MAX(depth) FROM depth_cte;

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, retrieve all staff reporting into 'E-002' (both direct and indirect). Return employee id, full name, and department code.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE org_chart AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, dept_cd, mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-002' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.dept_cd, e.mgr_emp_id FROM emp AS e INNER JOIN org_chart AS o ON e.mgr_emp_id = o.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, dept_cd FROM org_chart ORDER BY emp_id ASC;

items.question: Find employees who share the exact same direct manager. Show the manager employee id and a comma-separated or grouped list of employee names—wait, just show the manager employee id and count of peers sharing that manager, ordered by count descending.
items.sql: SELECT mgr_emp_id, COUNT(*) AS peer_count FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mgr_emp_id ORDER BY peer_count DESC, mgr_emp_id ASC;

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, find the ultimate top-level manager (ancestor with NULL manager) for employee 'E-007'. Return their employee id and full name.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE top_mgr AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-007' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id FROM emp AS e INNER JOIN top_mgr AS tm ON e.emp_id = tm.mgr_emp_id WHERE tm.mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM top_mgr WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL;

items.question: List each department code and the total number of employees in that department who report to someone in a different department.
items.sql: SELECT t1.dept_cd, COUNT(*) FROM emp AS t1 INNER JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.mgr_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t1.dept_cd <> t2.dept_cd GROUP BY t1.dept_cd ORDER BY t1.dept_cd ASC;

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, count how many total subordinates (direct and indirect) each top-level executive (manager with NULL mgr_emp_id) has. Show executive employee id and total subordinate count.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE exec_tree AS (SELECT emp_id AS top_id, emp_id, mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT et.top_id, e.emp_id, e.mgr_emp_id FROM emp AS e INNER JOIN exec_tree AS et ON e.mgr_emp_id = et.emp_id) SELECT top_id, COUNT(*) - 1 AS sub_count FROM exec_tree GROUP BY top_id ORDER BY top_id ASC;

items.question: Find all employees whose direct manager was hired in a later year than the employee themselves. Show employee id and full name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm FROM emp AS t1 INNER JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.mgr_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t1.hire_dt < t2.hire_dt ORDER BY t1.emp_id ASC;

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, generate the complete organizational reporting path (chain of employee IDs) starting from top managers down to employee 'E-006'. Show the sequence of employee IDs.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE path_cte AS (SELECT emp_id, mgr_emp_id, CAST(emp_id AS CHAR(500)) AS chain FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.mgr_emp_id, CONCAT(p.chain, ' > ', e.emp_id) FROM emp AS e INNER JOIN path_cte AS p ON e.mgr_emp_id = p.emp_id) SELECT chain FROM path_cte WHERE emp_id = 'E-006';

items.question: List managers who have direct reports spanning across 3 or more different departments. Show manager employee id.
items.sql: SELECT t2.mgr_emp_id FROM emp AS t1 INNER JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.emp_id = t2.mgr_emp_id GROUP BY t2.mgr_emp_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t1.dept_cd) >= 3 ORDER BY t2.mgr_emp_id ASC;

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, list all employees who are exactly 3 reporting steps away from any top-level executive. Show employee id and full name.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE level_cte AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, 0 AS lvl FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, lc.lvl + 1 FROM emp AS e INNER JOIN level_cte AS lc ON e.mgr_emp_id = lc.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM level_cte WHERE lvl = 3 ORDER BY emp_id ASC;

items.question: Show the shipment id and the warehouse id for orders shipped using the carrier UPS.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, wh_id FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS' ORDER BY ship_id ASC

items.question: List the warehouse name and the region code for all warehouses located in the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY wh_nm ASC

items.question: Show the product SKU and current on-hand quantity for inventory items in warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Give me the movement id and quantity for stock movements of type restock.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' ORDER BY mv_id ASC

items.question: List the payment attempt id and payment amount for payments made using a credit card.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' ORDER BY pay_id ASC

items.question: Show the order id and total amount for orders placed through the web sales channel.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' ORDER BY ord_id ASC

items.question: Display the product name and list price for products belonging to the electronics category.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY prod_nm ASC

items.question: Show the shipment id and shipping date for shipments handled by DHL that were handed to the carrier since 2026-01-01.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' AND ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY ship_dt ASC, ship_id ASC

items.question: List the warehouse name and the count of shipments dispatched from each warehouse where the shipment status is delivered.
items.sql: SELECT T2.wh_nm, COUNT(T1.ship_id) FROM shipment AS T1 INNER JOIN warehouse AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T1.ship_status = 'D' GROUP BY T2.wh_nm ORDER BY COUNT(T1.ship_id) DESC, T2.wh_nm ASC

items.question: Show the product SKU and product name for items whose on-hand quantity in warehouse W2 is currently at or below their reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W2' AND T1.on_hand_qty <= T1.reorder_pt ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: Give me the payment method code and the total payment amount collected for each method where the payment attempt outcome was settled.
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY SUM(pay_amt) DESC, method_cd ASC

items.question: Show the order date and count of orders placed through the app sales channel between 2026-04-01 and 2026-06-30.
items.sql: SELECT ord_dt, COUNT(ord_id) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY ord_dt ORDER BY ord_dt ASC

items.question: List the product name and the sum of moved quantities for stock movements of type customer shipment.
items.sql: SELECT T2.prod_nm, SUM(T1.qty) FROM inv_move AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY T2.prod_nm ORDER BY SUM(T1.qty) ASC, T2.prod_nm ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse name and the total current on-hand inventory quantity for all warehouses serving the Europe region.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T1.region_cd = 'EU' GROUP BY T1.wh_nm ORDER BY SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) DESC, T1.wh_nm ASC

items.question: Find the product name and average list price for active products in the kitchen category.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, prod_nm ASC

items.question: List the shipment id and order total amount for orders shipped via FedEx where the order status is delivered.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ship_id, T2.ord_total_amt FROM shipment AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T1.carrier_cd = 'FDX' AND T2.ord_status = 'D' ORDER BY T2.ord_total_amt DESC, T1.ship_id ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse name, product name, and on-hand quantity for items where the on-hand stock is lower than 400 units in warehouses located in the Asia Pacific region.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, T3.prod_nm, T2.on_hand_qty FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T2.sku = T3.sku WHERE T1.region_cd = 'AP' AND T2.on_hand_qty < 400 ORDER BY T2.on_hand_qty ASC, T1.wh_nm ASC, T3.prod_nm ASC

items.question: For orders placed through the phone sales channel with a status of cancelled, show the order id, payment method code, and settled payment amount.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T2.method_cd, T2.pay_amt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN payment AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T1.channel_cd = 'PHN' AND T1.ord_status = 'C' AND T2.pay_status = 'S' ORDER BY T2.pay_amt DESC, T1.ord_id ASC

items.question: Show the carrier code and the count of shipments for delivered shipments managed by each carrier where delivery happened on or after 2026-04-01.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(ship_id) FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' AND deliv_dt >= '2026-04-01' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY COUNT(ship_id) DESC, carrier_cd ASC

items.question: List the warehouse name, product name, and movement timestamp for stock adjustments that occurred in warehouses serving the Latin America region during October 2025.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, T3.prod_nm, T2.mv_ts FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inv_move AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T2.sku = T3.sku WHERE T1.region_cd = 'LA' AND T2.mv_type = 'ADJ' AND T2.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND T2.mv_ts < '2025-11-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY T2.mv_ts ASC, T1.wh_nm ASC

items.question: Find the product category code, product name, and current on-hand quantity for products in the home category that have an on-hand quantity greater than 300 across all warehouses.
items.sql: SELECT T1.categ_cd, T1.prod_nm, T2.on_hand_qty FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.categ_cd = 'HOM' AND T2.on_hand_qty > 300 ORDER BY T2.on_hand_qty DESC, T1.prod_nm ASC

items.question: Show the order id, order date, and total amount for orders paid via PayPal that were shipped using the UPS carrier and have a returned order status.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T1.ord_dt, T1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN payment AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id INNER JOIN shipment AS T3 ON T1.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T2.method_cd = 'PP' AND T3.carrier_cd = 'UPS' AND T1.ord_status = 'R' ORDER BY T1.ord_total_amt DESC, T1.ord_id ASC

items.question: For orders placed through the store sales channel, list the warehouse name, shipment id, and shipping date for all shipments where the shipment status is in transit.
items.sql: SELECT T2.wh_nm, T1.ship_id, T1.ship_dt FROM shipment AS T1 INNER JOIN warehouse AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T1.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.channel_cd = 'STR' AND T1.ship_status = 'I' ORDER BY T1.ship_dt ASC, T1.ship_id ASC

items.question: Show the product name, warehouse name, and reorder point for items in the office category where the current on-hand quantity is below the reorder point in warehouses located in North America.
items.sql: SELECT T2.prod_nm, T1.wh_nm, T3.on_hand_qty FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T3 ON T1.wh_id = T3.wh_id INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T3.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.region_cd = 'NA' AND T2.categ_cd = 'OFC' AND T3.on_hand_qty < T3.reorder_pt ORDER BY T3.on_hand_qty ASC, T2.prod_nm ASC

items.question: Which shipping carrier had the lowest average transit delay time in days across all delivered orders last month?
items.reply: -- UNANSWERABLE: The shipment table tracks ship and delivery dates but does not record carrier transit delay time or benchmarks.

items.reply: -- UNANSWERABLE: The product catalog and inventory tables do not store physical product weight or total weight metrics.

items.question: Can you show me the driver name and license plate number assigned to shipment S-8001?
items.reply: -- UNANSWERABLE: The shipment table only tracks carrier codes, not individual drivers or vehicle license plates.

items.question: How much customs duty tax was charged on international orders shipped from the Rotterdam Hub last week?

items.sql: SELECT disc_pct FROM promo WHERE promo_id = 3

items.question: Can you check the start date and end date for the Black Friday promo? Show those two dates.
items.sql: SELECT starts_dt, ends_dt FROM promo WHERE promo_cd = 'BF25'

items.question: Pull up the customer name and phone number for ID C-1002.
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, phone_no FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id = 'C-1002'

items.question: Find the order date and total amount for order O-5002.
items.sql: SELECT ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_id = 'O-5002'

items.question: Show the list of all customers in the NA sales region. Return their customer ID and customer name.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'NA'

items.question: Which orders have a status of cancelled? List their order IDs and customer IDs.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C'

items.question: List out all promotions that offer a discount percentage greater than 15. Show the promo code, promo name, and discount percentage.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00

items.question: Show me all web events for session sess000001. Return the event timestamp and event type, ordered by event timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT evt_ts, evt_type FROM web_event WHERE session_id = 'sess000001' ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC

items.question: Find all customers who signed up between 2022-07-01 and 2022-07-31. Show their customer ID, name, and signup date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-07-01' AND '2022-07-31' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Get all orders placed through the mobile app channel ('APP') with a total amount over 300 USD. Display the order ID, customer ID, and order total amount.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 300.00 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Find all platinum tier customers who are currently inactive (is_actv equals 0). Return their customer ID, name, and signup date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND is_actv = 0 ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Show all customer segment history records for customer C-1001. Return the month date and segment code, ordered by month date.
items.sql: SELECT month_dt, segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001' ORDER BY month_dt ASC

items.question: Get a list of web events where the event type is PURCHASE and the channel is WEB. Return the event timestamp, customer ID, and order ID.
items.sql: SELECT evt_ts, cust_id, ord_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC

items.question: List all active promotions that were running on 2025-11-15. Show the promo ID, promo code, and promo name.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt <= '2025-11-15' AND ends_dt >= '2025-11-15' ORDER BY promo_id ASC

items.question: Find all customer browsing sessions where a customer was logged in (cust_id is not null) and performed a checkout event. Show distinct customer IDs and session IDs.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cust_id, session_id FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' ORDER BY cust_id ASC, session_id ASC

items.question: Show all orders placed in the year 2026 that used a promotion. Return the order ID and the promotion ID by joining the ord_promo table, sorted by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t2.promo_id FROM ord_hdr AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY t1.ord_id ASC, t2.promo_id ASC

items.question: Identify all customers who were in the VIP segment during the month of September 2026. Return their customer IDs.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-09-01' AND segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Find all orders placed by platinum tier customers in the European region ('EU') during Q2 2026. Show the order ID, customer ID, and order date.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.cust_id, t1.ord_dt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.tier_cd = 'P' AND t2.region_cd = 'EU' AND t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' ORDER BY t1.ord_dt ASC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: Get the count of web events of type 'CART' grouped by channel code. Show the channel code and event count.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY event_count DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: List all customers who have never been assigned a segment in the customer segment history table. Show their customer ID and name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 LEFT JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.cust_id IS NULL ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find all orders that had the 'Flash sale' promotion applied. Show the order ID and order date.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id INNER JOIN promo AS t3 ON t2.promo_id = t3.promo_id WHERE t3.promo_nm = 'Flash sale' ORDER BY t1.ord_dt ASC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: For each customer tier, count how many customers are currently active (is_actv = 1). Show the tier code and the active customer count.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS active_cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY active_cust_count DESC, tier_cd ASC

items.question: Find web browsing sessions that resulted in a purchase event where no customer ID was linked (anonymous purchases). Return the session ID and event timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, evt_ts FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND cust_id IS NULL ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, session_id ASC

items.question: List the customer names and order totals for all orders placed in April 2026 where the order total exceeded 500 USD. Sort by order total descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.ord_total_amt FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' AND t2.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t2.ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY t2.ord_total_amt DESC, t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: How many active platinum customers do we have in the NA sales region?

items.question: Show the count of orders placed through the mobile app channel in April 2026.

items.question: What is the total order amount for each order status in 2026? Give me the status and the sum, ordered by the sum descending, then status ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_sum FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY total_sum DESC, ord_status ASC

items.question: List each promotion code along with the count of orders that used it, ordered from highest count to lowest, then promotion code alphabetically.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS order_count FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd ORDER BY order_count DESC, t1.promo_cd ASC

items.question: How many unique customers triggered web events using the WEB channel in November 2025?

items.sql: SELECT COUNT(t1.ord_id) FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP'

items.question: List the customer name and total order amount for the top 5 customers by total spend in USD currency during 2026. Sort by total amount descending, then customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) AS total_spend FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY total_spend DESC, t1.cust_nm ASC LIMIT 5

items.question: For web events in 2025, show each event type and the count of distinct sessions that performed that event type, ordered by count descending then event type ascending.
items.sql: SELECT evt_type, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sess_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY evt_type ORDER BY sess_count DESC, evt_type ASC

items.question: Which customer segments had an average order total greater than 300.00 in USD during 2026? Show the segment code and average order amount, sorted by average amount descending then segment code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.segment_cd, AVG(t1.ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' AND t2.month_dt = DATE_FORMAT(t1.ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY t2.segment_cd HAVING AVG(t1.ord_total_amt) > 300.00 ORDER BY avg_amt DESC, t2.segment_cd ASC

items.question: Show the promotion name and the total revenue (sum of ord_total_amt for currency USD) generated by orders using that promotion in 2026, for promotions with total revenue above 100.00. Order by revenue descending, then promotion name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) AS total_rev FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t3.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm HAVING SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) > 100.00 ORDER BY total_rev DESC, t1.promo_nm ASC

items.question: What is the count of distinct customers who placed an order using the WEB channel and also had a web event of type PURCHASE in 2025?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id) FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND t2.evt_type = 'PURCHASE'

items.question: For each sales region of customers, calculate the total order amount in USD and the count of orders for orders placed in 2026. Show region code, order count, and total amount, ordered by total amount descending, then region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS ord_count, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY t1.region_cd ORDER BY total_amt DESC, t1.region_cd ASC

items.question: Find the customer name and count of orders for customers in the NA region who have placed more than 0 orders in 2026, ordered by order count descending, then customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS ord_count FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.region_cd = 'NA' AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(t2.ord_id) > 0 ORDER BY ord_count DESC, t1.cust_nm ASC

items.question: How many web events of type VIEW occurred in November 2025 across all sessions?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND evt_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-11-30 23:59:59'

items.question: Show each customer segment code and the average discount percentage of promotions used on orders by customers in that segment during 2026. Group by segment code, and order by average discount descending, then segment code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.segment_cd, AVG(t3.disc_pct) AS avg_disc FROM cust_segment_hist AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t4 ON t2.ord_id = t4.ord_id JOIN promo AS t3 ON t4.promo_id = t3.promo_id WHERE t1.month_dt = DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m-01') AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY t1.segment_cd ORDER BY avg_disc DESC, t1.segment_cd ASC

items.question: What is the total sum of order amounts for orders placed via the STR channel in 2026?
items.sql: SELECT SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'STR' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31'

items.question: List the promotion code and the count of distinct orders that applied it, restricted to promotions with a discount percentage of 15.00 or higher, ordered by order count descending then promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.ord_id) AS ord_count FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id WHERE t1.disc_pct >= 15.00 GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd ORDER BY ord_count DESC, t1.promo_cd ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and the count of web events for customers who logged in and had web events in December 2025, keeping only those with more than 1 event, sorted by event count descending then customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts BETWEEN '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY event_count DESC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the promotion code and promotion name for all active promotions.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE '2026-06-01' BETWEEN starts_dt AND ends_dt

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for platinum tier customers in the North America sales region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA'

items.question: What are the session id and channel code for website events recorded for customer C-1001 on 2025-11-23?
items.sql: SELECT session_id, channel_cd FROM web_event WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001' AND DATE(evt_ts) = '2025-11-23'

items.question: Show the order id and order date for orders placed through the mobile app channel in currency USD.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND currency_cd = 'USD'

items.question: Display the segment code and the count of customer segment history records for the month of 2026-07-01, ordered by segment code.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' GROUP BY segment_cd ORDER BY segment_cd

items.question: List the product name and list price for discontinued products in the electronics category.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 AND categ_cd = 'ELC'

items.question: Show the order id and promotion name for orders that used the Black Friday promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t2.promo_nm FROM ord_promo AS t1 INNER JOIN promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id WHERE t2.promo_cd = 'BF25'

items.question: List the customer name and segment code for customers who were in the VIP segment for the month starting 2026-09-01.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.segment_cd FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-09-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP'

items.question: For orders placed on 2026-04-03, show the order id, customer name, and order total amount.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t2.cust_nm, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_dt = '2026-04-03'

items.question: Show the session id and customer name for web events of type PURCHASE that occurred on 2025-11-27.
items.sql: SELECT t1.session_id, t2.cust_nm FROM web_event AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND DATE(t1.evt_ts) = '2025-11-27'

items.question: List each promotion name and the total number of orders that used it, ordered from highest to lowest count then promotion name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM promo AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t2.ord_id) DESC, t1.promo_nm ASC

items.question: Show the customer name and order date for orders placed by at-risk customers in the AP sales region during April 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.ord_dt FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id INNER JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t1.region_cd = 'AP' AND t3.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND t3.month_dt = '2026-04-01' AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'

items.question: For website sessions on 2025-11-09, list the session id, customer name, and loyalty tier for any logged-in users who performed a CART event.
items.sql: SELECT t1.session_id, t2.cust_nm, t2.tier_cd FROM web_event AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.evt_type = 'CART' AND DATE(t1.evt_ts) = '2025-11-09'

items.question: Show the promotion name and total order amount generated by orders using promotions that started on or after 2025-11-01, ordered by total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) DESC

items.question: List the customer name, order id, and order total amount for orders placed in Q2 2026 by customers who were in the REG segment in May 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.ord_id, t2.ord_total_amt FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id INNER JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t3.month_dt = '2026-05-01' AND t3.segment_cd = 'REG' AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30'

items.question: For web events associated with a purchase order, show the session id, order id, and customer name for all events on 2025-12-09.
items.sql: SELECT t1.session_id, t1.ord_id, t2.cust_nm FROM web_event AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t1.evt_ts) = '2025-12-09'

items.question: Show the code description for order statuses alongside the count of orders in each status during the year 2026, ordered by status description.
items.sql: SELECT t1.code_desc, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM code_lookup AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.code_val = t2.ord_status WHERE t1.code_type = 'ORD_STATUS' AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.code_val, t1.code_desc ORDER BY t1.code_desc

items.question: List the customer name, order id, and channel code for orders placed via website or app by customers in the NEW segment in June 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.ord_id, t2.channel_cd FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id INNER JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t3.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND t3.segment_cd = 'NEW' AND t2.channel_cd IN ('WEB', 'APP')

items.question: Find the customer name and signup date for gold tier customers who signed up in the European sales region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'G' AND region_cd = 'EU'

items.question: Display the region description from code lookup along with the customer count for each region code, ordered by customer count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.code_desc, COUNT(t2.cust_id) FROM code_lookup AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.code_val = t2.region_cd WHERE t1.code_type = 'REGION' GROUP BY t1.code_val, t1.code_desc ORDER BY COUNT(t2.cust_id) DESC

items.question: Show the session id, event timestamp, and product stock keeping unit for website view events involving electronic products on 2025-11-01.
items.sql: SELECT t1.session_id, t1.evt_ts, t1.sku FROM web_event AS t1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND t2.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND DATE(t1.evt_ts) = '2025-11-01'

items.question: For orders placed in July 2026, list the customer name, order id, and currency code for orders exceeding 800 in total amount.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.ord_id, t2.currency_cd FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' AND t2.ord_total_amt > 800.00

items.question: Show the promotion name and discount percentage for promotions that offer a discount greater than 15 percent and end after 2026-03-31.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 AND ends_dt > '2026-03-31'

items.question: List the customer name, promotion name, and order date for orders placed in April 2026 that applied a promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t3.promo_nm, t2.ord_dt FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id INNER JOIN ord_promo AS t4 ON t2.ord_id = t4.ord_id INNER JOIN promo AS t3 ON t4.promo_id = t3.promo_id WHERE t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'

items.question: Show the promotion code and the promotion name for all active promos.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE ends_dt >= '2026-06-01' ORDER BY promo_id ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for platinum tier customers in the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: What are the session ID and customer ID for web events of type view that occurred on 2025-11-01?
items.sql: SELECT session_id, cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-11-02 00:00:00' ORDER BY evt_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer ID and segment code for customers in the VIP segment during July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'VIP' AND month_dt = '2026-07-01' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: List the order ID and order total amount for orders placed through the web channel in currency USD.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY ord_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer ID and count of distinct orders placed by each customer.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.ord_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id GROUP BY t1.cust_id ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the promotion ID and total number of distinct orders that used each promotion.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ord_id) FROM ord_promo GROUP BY promo_id ORDER BY promo_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer ID and count of web events recorded for each customer.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(DISTINCT evt_id) FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Find the promotion code and the total sum of order totals for all orders that used the Black Friday promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.promo_cd = 'BF25' GROUP BY t1.promo_cd

items.question: List the customer ID, customer name, and the total count of distinct orders for customers who signed up in 2022 and have placed at least one order.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.ord_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND t1.signup_dt < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer name, loyalty tier, and total order amount for all delivered orders placed by gold tier customers.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t1.tier_cd, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'G' AND t2.ord_status = 'D' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, t1.tier_cd ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: What is the total payment amount successfully settled for orders that applied any promotion?
items.sql: SELECT SUM(t2.pay_amt) FROM ord_promo AS t1 JOIN payment AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.pay_status = 'S'

items.question: Show the promotion name and the count of unique customers who placed an order using that promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t3.cust_id) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY t1.promo_id ASC

items.question: List the channel code and the total order amount for orders created through web events that had a purchase event type.
items.sql: SELECT t1.channel_cd, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM web_event AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' GROUP BY t1.channel_cd ORDER BY t1.channel_cd ASC

items.question: Find the customer ID, customer name, and total sum of order amounts for orders that used the Flash sale promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t4 ON t2.ord_id = t4.ord_id JOIN promo AS t5 ON t4.promo_id = t5.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t5.promo_cd = 'FLASH30' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the region code and the count of distinct customers who were in the VIP segment in October 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-10-01' GROUP BY t1.region_cd ORDER BY t1.region_cd ASC

items.question: For each loyalty tier, show the tier code, the total number of customers, and the total order amount across all their orders, including customers with zero orders.
items.sql: SELECT t1.tier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id), COALESCE(SUM(t2.ord_total_amt), 0) FROM cust_master AS t1 LEFT JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id GROUP BY t1.tier_cd ORDER BY t1.tier_cd ASC

items.question: List the promotion name, the count of orders using it, and the sum of payment amounts settled for those orders, for promotions active in November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.ord_id), SUM(t3.pay_amt) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN payment AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.starts_dt <= '2025-11-30' AND t1.ends_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND t3.pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY t1.promo_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer ID, customer name, and the count of distinct web event sessions for customers who were in the RISK segment in August 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t3.session_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id LEFT JOIN web_event AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t2.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-08-01' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find the region code, count of customers, and total order amount for customers in the European region who placed orders in 2026 using any promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id), SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.region_cd = 'EU' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY t1.region_cd

items.question: Show the promotion code, the total order amount, and the total settled payment amount for all orders tied to each promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, SUM(DISTINCT t2.ord_total_amt), SUM(t3.pay_amt) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t4 ON t1.promo_id = t4.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t4.ord_id = t2.ord_id JOIN payment AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd ORDER BY t1.promo_id ASC

items.question: For each sales channel, list the channel code, the number of unique customers who placed an order, and the total order revenue.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id), SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY channel_cd ASC

items.question: Show the customer ID, customer name, and total order revenue for customers who switched between segments from June 2026 to July 2026 (having segment records in both months).
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, SUM(t4.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t4 ON t1.cust_id = t4.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND t3.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND t2.segment_cd <> t3.segment_cd GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the promotion name, the number of distinct web event sessions, and the total order amount for orders associated with each promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t3.session_id), SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t4 ON t1.promo_id = t4.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t4.ord_id = t2.ord_id LEFT JOIN web_event AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY t1.promo_id ASC

items.question: Show the promotion code and promotion name for all promotions that started between '2026-01-01' and '2026-03-31'.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'

items.question: List the customer ID and sign-up date for customers who signed up in the year 2022.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31'

items.question: Show the order ID and order date for orders placed on '2026-04-03'.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-04-03'

items.question: List the session ID and event timestamp for web events recorded on '2025-11-09'.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, evt_ts FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-09 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-11-10 00:00:00'

items.question: Show the customer ID and segment code for records where the month date is '2026-07-01'.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01'

items.question: List the order ID and promotion ID for entries in the order promotion table where the promotion ID is 3.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, promo_id FROM ord_promo WHERE promo_id = 3

items.question: Show the promotion ID, promotion name, and discount percentage for promotions ending after '2026-01-01' ordered by discount percentage descending and promotion ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE ends_dt > '2026-01-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_id ASC

items.question: Find the customer ID, customer name, and sign-up date for active customers in the 'AP' region who signed up between '2022-01-01' and '2022-12-31'.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' AND is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31'

items.question: List the order ID, order date, and order total amount for orders placed in the WEB channel during the month of April 2026.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'

items.question: Show the customer ID and count of orders for each customer who placed an order between '2026-01-01' and '2026-06-30'.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY cust_id

items.question: List the promotion code, promotion name, and count of orders that used each promotion during the period starting '2025-11-01'.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id WHERE t1.starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm

items.question: Show the channel code and the number of web events captured between '2025-11-01 00:00:00' and '2025-11-30 23:59:59'.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd

items.question: List the customer ID, customer name, and the number of days between their signup date and '2026-10-31' for customers in the 'EU' region who signed up in 2022.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, DATEDIFF('2026-10-31', signup_dt) FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'EU' AND signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31'

items.question: Show the promotion name and the average order total amount for orders that used promotions active during Q1 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, AVG(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.starts_dt <= '2026-03-31' AND t1.ends_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm

items.question: Find the customer ID, customer name, and total order amount for customers who placed orders in Q2 2026 totaling more than 300 USD.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm HAVING SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) > 300.00

items.question: Show the segment code and the count of unique customers assigned to each segment in the month of July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' GROUP BY segment_cd

items.question: List the customer ID, customer name, and latest order date for active customers who placed at least one order between '2026-01-01' and '2026-07-31'.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, MAX(t2.ord_dt) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm

items.question: Show the promotion code and the total count of distinct orders associated with promotions that have a discount percentage of 15.00 or higher and started before '2026-02-01'.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.ord_id) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id WHERE t1.disc_pct >= 15.00 AND t1.starts_dt < '2026-02-01' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd

items.question: Find the session ID and the count of web events for sessions that occurred between '2025-11-01' and '2025-12-31' and included a PURCHASE event.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE') AND evt_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY session_id

items.question: List the customer ID, customer name, and the number of days between their signup date and the order date for their earliest order placed in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, DATEDIFF(MIN(t2.ord_dt), t1.signup_dt) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, t1.signup_dt

items.question: Show the promotion name and the maximum order total amount for orders using promotions that end between '2026-01-01' and '2026-08-31'.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, MAX(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.ends_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm

items.question: Find the region code and the count of active customers who signed up between '2022-01-01' and '2022-09-30' grouped by region.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-09-30' GROUP BY region_cd

items.question: Show the customer ID, customer name, and the count of web events for customers who logged in and generated web events during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.evt_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.evt_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm

items.question: List the loyalty tier code and the average number of days since signup to '2026-10-31' for all active customers grouped by tier.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, AVG(DATEDIFF('2026-10-31', signup_dt)) FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY tier_cd

items.question: Can you give me a breakdown of order volume by month for all orders placed in 2026? Show the month and the number of orders, sorted chronologically by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, COUNT(*) AS ord_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: Pull up the total sales amount by month for web channel orders during 2026. Return the month and total sales in order currency, in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_sales FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: How many customer support tickets were opened each month across 2026? List the month and ticket count chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') AS tkt_month, COUNT(*) AS tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND opened_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY tkt_month ASC;

items.question: I need to see the count of website viewing events per month for the year 2025. Show the month and event count in ascending order by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') AS evt_month, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01' AND evt_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY evt_month ASC;

items.question: Show me the monthly count of new refund requests submitted between November 2025 and October 2026. Display the month and request count in date order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') AS rfd_month, COUNT(*) AS rfd_count FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND req_dt < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY rfd_month ASC;

items.question: What's the quarterly order count and total order amount for 2026? Give me the quarter and metrics, ordered by quarter.
items.sql: SELECT QUARTER(ord_dt) AS ord_quarter, COUNT(*) AS ord_count, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY QUARTER(ord_dt) ORDER BY ord_quarter ASC;

items.question: Can you track the monthly count of shipments dispatched from warehouse W1 during 2026? Return the month and shipment count in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ship_month, COUNT(*) AS ship_count FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ship_month ASC;

items.question: I want a monthly breakdown of settled payment amounts for 2026. Show the month and total payment amount in ascending order by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') AS pay_month, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_paid FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND paid_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY pay_month ASC;

items.question: How many customer signups did we get each month in 2022? Display the month and signup count in chronological sequence.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') AS signup_month, COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY signup_month ASC;

items.question: Break down the number of web checkout events by month for the second half of 2025. List the month and event count chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') AS evt_month, COUNT(*) AS checkout_count FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' AND evt_ts >= '2025-07-01' AND evt_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY evt_month ASC;

items.question: Give me a weekly breakdown of orders placed in November 2025. Show the year-week format and the order count, ordered by week.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%u') AS ord_week, COUNT(*) AS ord_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND ord_dt < '2025-12-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%u') ORDER BY ord_week ASC;

items.question: List the monthly count of VIP customer segment assignments recorded in cust_segment_hist for 2026. Return month and count in time order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') AS seg_month, COUNT(*) as vip_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'VIP' AND month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY seg_month ASC;

items.question: Show me the monthly total quantity of items moved out of warehouses due to customer shipments across 2025 and 2026. Output month and total absolute units moved, chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mv_month, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-11-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mv_month ASC;

items.question: I need to see the quarterly count of support tickets by severity level 1 (critical) for 2026. Show quarter and ticket count, ordered by quarter.
items.sql: SELECT QUARTER(opened_ts) AS tkt_quarter, COUNT(*) AS crit_count FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1 AND opened_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND opened_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY QUARTER(opened_ts) ORDER BY tkt_quarter ASC;

items.question: What is the monthly average order total amount for orders placed through the app channel in 2026? Return month and average amount in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: Give me a month-by-month count of promotions applied to orders (ord_promo combined with ord_hdr) during 2026. Show month and promotion usage count, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t1.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, COUNT(t2.promo_id) AS promo_count FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN ord_promo t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t1.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: Pull the count of purchase events recorded in the web event stream by month for 2026. Output the month and purchase count in time order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') AS evt_month, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND evt_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY evt_month ASC;

items.question: How many refund requests were approved each month in 2026? Return the month and approved refund count, sorted chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') AS rfd_month, COUNT(*) AS approved_count FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' AND req_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND req_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY rfd_month ASC;

items.question: Track the monthly volume of customer support tickets categorized under billing (BILL) during 2026. Show month and ticket count in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') AS tkt_month, COUNT(*) AS bill_tkt_count FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'BILL' AND opened_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND opened_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY tkt_month ASC;

items.question: Can you summarize the total sales amount grouped by order status and month for all orders in 2026? Show month, order status, and total sales, ordered by month and status.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, ord_status, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_sales FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m'), ord_status ORDER BY ord_month ASC, ord_status ASC;

items.question: List the monthly count of new customer segments recorded in cust_segment_hist across 2026. Display month and count chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') AS seg_month, COUNT(*) AS new_seg_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'NEW' AND month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY seg_month ASC;

items.question: What is the monthly sum of requested refund amounts for damaged items (reason code DMG) across 2025 and 2026? Show month and total requested amount in time order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') AS rfd_month, SUM(rfd_amt) AS total_dmg_rfd FROM refund_req WHERE reason_cd = 'DMG' AND req_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND req_dt < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(req_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY rfd_month ASC;

items.question: Show me the quarterly distribution of customer signups for the entire year 2022. Return the quarter and number of new signups, sorted by quarter.
items.sql: SELECT QUARTER(signup_dt) AS signup_quarter, COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY QUARTER(signup_dt) ORDER BY signup_quarter ASC;

items.question: Provide a monthly breakdown of web cart addition events for 2026. Show the month and the count of cart additions, in ascending order by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') AS evt_month, COUNT(*) AS cart_count FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_type = 'CART' AND evt_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND evt_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY evt_month ASC;

items.question: Show the promotion code, promotion name, and discount percentage for promotions starting in 2026, ordered by discount percentage descending and promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_cd ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for all platinum tier customers in the North America sales region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA'

items.question: Show the order ID and order total amount for all orders placed through the mobile app channel in April 2026, ordered by order date ascending and order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Give me the promotion ID and count of orders that used each promotion, ordered by order count descending and promotion ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, COUNT(ord_id) AS ord_cnt FROM ord_promo GROUP BY promo_id ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC, promo_id ASC

items.question: Show the event type and total count of web events recorded for the web channel on 2025-11-09, ordered by event type ascending.
items.sql: SELECT evt_type, COUNT(evt_id) AS evt_cnt FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-09 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-09 23:59:59' GROUP BY evt_type ORDER BY evt_type ASC

items.question: List each customer segment code and the number of customer segment history records for July 2026, ordered by count descending.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' GROUP BY segment_cd ORDER BY cust_cnt DESC

items.question: Find the promotion ID and name for promotions with a discount percentage strictly greater than 15, ordered by discount percentage ascending and promotion ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct ASC, promo_id ASC

items.question: Show the order ID, customer ID, and order total amount for the top 5 largest orders placed in USD currency during 2026, ordered by order total amount descending and order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC LIMIT 5

items.question: Rank promotions by their discount percentage in descending order, showing the promotion name, discount percentage, and the rank. Order by rank ascending and promotion name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY disc_pct DESC) AS rnk FROM promo ORDER BY rnk ASC, promo_nm ASC

items.question: For each customer tier, show the tier code, customer ID, customer name, and signup date for the customer who signed up earliest in that tier. Order by tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM (SELECT tier_cd, cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tier_cd ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC) AS rn FROM cust_master) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY tier_cd ASC

items.question: Calculate the running total of order amounts for customer C-1006 across their orders placed in 2026, showing the order ID, order date, order total amount, and running total. Order by order date ascending and order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC) AS running_tot FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1006' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: For each web event on session sess000001, show the event ID, event timestamp, event type, and the timestamp of the previous event in the same session using LAG. Order by event timestamp ascending and event ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, evt_ts, evt_type, LAG(evt_ts, 1) OVER (ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC) AS prev_evt_ts FROM web_event WHERE session_id = 'sess000001' ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC

items.question: Show each promotion name, its discount percentage, and the difference between its discount percentage and the maximum discount percentage among all promotions. Order by discount percentage descending and promotion name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct, disc_pct - MAX(disc_pct) OVER () AS diff_from_max FROM promo ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_nm ASC

items.question: For each customer in the Europe sales region, show the customer ID, customer name, signup date, and the signup date of the next customer signed up in Europe using LEAD, ordered by signup date ascending and customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt, LEAD(signup_dt, 1) OVER (ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC) AS next_signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'EU' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ascending

items.question: List the customer ID, customer name, order ID, and order total amount for orders placed by active customers in the Asia Pacific region, ordered by order total amount descending and order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.is_actv = 1 AND c.region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY o.ord_total_amt DESC, o.ord_id ASC

items.question: For each order placed in July 2026, calculate its order total amount as a percentage of the daily total order amount for that order date. Show order ID, order date, order total amount, and the percentage. Order by order date ascending and order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, (ord_total_amt * 100.0 / SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY ord_dt)) AS pct_of_day FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Using DENSE_RANK, rank promotions within each start year based on their discount percentage descending. Show the promotion ID, promotion code, discount percentage, start date, and the rank. Order by start date ascending, rank ascending, and promotion ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, disc_pct, starts_dt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTRING(CAST(starts_dt AS CHAR), 1, 4) ORDER BY disc_pct DESC) AS yr_rank FROM promo ORDER BY starts_dt ASC, yr_rank ASC, promo_id ASC

items.question: For customers who signed up in 2022, assign a row number ordered by signup date ascending and customer ID ascending. Show the row number, customer ID, customer name, tier code, and sales region. Order by the assigned row number ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC) AS row_num, cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd, region_cd FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' ORDER BY row_num ASC

items.question: Find the top 2 highest-value orders for each sales region of the customer, showing the region code, customer ID, order ID, and order total amount. Order by region code ascending and order total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, cust_id, ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT c.region_cd, o.cust_id, o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region_cd ORDER BY o.ord_total_amt DESC, o.ord_id ASC) AS rn FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id) t WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY region_cd ASC, ord_total_amt DESC

items.question: Calculate the moving average of order totals over the current order and the 2 preceding orders for customer C-1006 in 2026, showing the order ID, order date, order total amount, and the 3-order moving average. Order by order date ascending and order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, AVG(ord_total_amt) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS mov_avg FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1006' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: For each web event of type PURCHASE, show the event ID, session ID, customer ID, event timestamp, and the timestamp of the immediately preceding purchase event across all sessions using LAG. Order by event timestamp ascending and event ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, session_id, cust_id, evt_ts, LAG(evt_ts, 1) OVER (ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC) AS prev_purchase_ts FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC

items.question: For each customer segment history record in 2026, show the customer ID, month date, segment code, and the previous segment code assigned to that customer using LAG, ordered by customer ID ascending and month date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, month_dt, segment_cd, LAG(segment_cd, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY month_dt ASC) AS prev_segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY cust_id ASC, month_dt ASC

items.question: Rank orders placed in April 2026 by their total amount descending within each sales channel. Show the channel code, order ID, customer ID, order total amount, and rank. Order by channel code ascending, rank ascending, and order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC) AS rnk FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' ORDER BY channel_cd ASC, rnk ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: For each customer tier, find the customer who placed the order with the highest total amount in 2026. Show the tier code, customer ID, customer name, and the maximum order amount. Order by tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, cust_id, cust_nm, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT c.tier_cd, c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, o.ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY o.ord_total_amt DESC, o.ord_id ASC) AS rn FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01') t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY tier_cd ASC

items.question: Show the promotion code and the count of orders for each promotion applied to orders in 2026, ordered by the count descending then promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS order_count FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t3.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.promo_cd ORDER BY order_count DESC, t1.promo_cd ASC

items.question: Show the promotion name and the average order total amount for each promotion used on orders placed via the web channel.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, AVG(t3.ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_total FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY t1.promo_nm

items.question: Show the promotion code and the total order amount for all promotions that generated over 500.00 in total order amounts.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_cd HAVING SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) > 500.00

items.question: Show the promotion name and the count of unique customers who used each promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t3.cust_id) AS cust_count FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_nm

items.question: Show the promotion code and the maximum order total amount for promotions whose maximum order amount exceeds 500.00.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, MAX(t3.ord_total_amt) AS max_total FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_cd HAVING MAX(t3.ord_total_amt) > 500.00

items.question: Show the promotion name and the count of orders for promotions that start on or after 2026-01-01.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS ord_count FROM promo AS t1 LEFT JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id WHERE t1.starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t1.promo_nm

items.question: Show the loyalty tier code and the count of web events for customers in each tier during June 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.tier_cd, COUNT(t2.evt_id) AS event_count FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.evt_ts >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND t2.evt_ts <= '2026-06-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY t1.tier_cd

items.question: Show the segment code and the count of customer segment history records for each segment in October 2026.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS record_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-10-01' GROUP BY segment_cd

items.question: Show the sales region code and the count of customers who signed up in 2022 for each region.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS signup_count FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY region_cd

items.question: Show the event type and the count of web events recorded through the app channel.
items.sql: SELECT evt_type, COUNT(evt_id) AS app_event_count FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' GROUP BY evt_type

items.question: Show the loyalty tier code and the average signup duration in days from 2022-01-01 for active customers in each tier.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, AVG(DATEDIFF(signup_dt, '2022-01-01')) AS avg_days FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY tier_cd

items.question: Show the promotion id and the count of orders for promotions applied to at least 2 different orders.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, COUNT(ord_id) AS ord_count FROM ord_promo GROUP BY promo_id HAVING COUNT(ord_id) >= 2

items.question: Show the sales region code and the count of active VIP customers in each region as of October 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, COUNT(t1.cust_id) AS vip_count FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-10-01' GROUP BY t1.region_cd

items.question: Show the channel code and the count of purchase events recorded in the web event stream during April 2026.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(evt_id) AS purchase_count FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd

items.question: Show the segment code and the count of unique customers who were in the 'RISK' segment at least once during 2026.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS cust_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'RISK' AND month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY segment_cd

items.question: Show the promotion name and the total order amount generated by each promotion, using a CTE to calculate totals first.
items.sql: WITH promo_totals AS (SELECT promo_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_promo JOIN ord_hdr ON ord_promo.ord_id = ord_hdr.ord_id GROUP BY promo_id) SELECT t1.promo_nm, t2.total_amt FROM promo AS t1 JOIN promo_totals AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id

items.question: Show the promotion code and the average discount percentage for promotions that have a discount percentage greater than 15.00.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, AVG(disc_pct) AS avg_disc FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 GROUP BY promo_cd

items.question: Show the loyalty tier code and the count of customers for each tier among active customers.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS active_cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY tier_cd

items.question: Show the sales region code and the count of customer master records for each region.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS total_cust FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd

items.question: Show the order status and the count of orders for each status in the ord_hdr table.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, COUNT(ord_id) AS status_count FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY ord_status

items.question: Show the channel code and the sum of order total amounts for each channel in the ord_hdr table.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd

items.question: Show the customer id and the count of web events for customers who generated more than 1 web event.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(evt_id) AS event_count FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(evt_id) > 1

items.question: Show the session id and the count of events for each session in the web event log.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, COUNT(evt_id) AS evt_count FROM web_event GROUP BY session_id

items.question: Show the promotion name and the count of orders where the promotion was applied, filtered for promotions with discount percentages of at least 20.00 using a CTE.
items.sql: WITH high_disc_promos AS (SELECT promo_id, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct >= 20.00) SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS ord_count FROM high_disc_promos AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id GROUP BY t1.promo_nm

items.question: Show the promotion code and promotion name for all active promotions.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE ends_dt >= '2026-04-01' ORDER BY promo_id ASC

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for all active platinum tier customers in the NA region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Display the session id and customer id for web events on channel WEB that involved product ELC-026.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, cust_id FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND sku = 'ELC-026' ORDER BY evt_id ASC

items.question: Show the order id and order total amount for orders placed using the mobile app channel in EUR currency.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND currency_cd = 'EUR' ORDER BY ord_id ASC

items.question: Find the customer id and customer name for customers who had the VIP segment in October 2026.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T2.cust_nm FROM cust_segment_hist AS T1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND T1.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY T1.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the promotion id and discount percentage for promotions that start on or after 2026-03-01.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-03-01' ORDER BY promo_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and name for customers who registered in the NA region or the EU region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'NA' UNION SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'EU' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: List customer IDs and names for customers who were segmented as VIP in June 2026 or July 2026.
