items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T2.cust_nm FROM cust_segment_hist AS T1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND T1.segment_cd = 'VIP' UNION SELECT T1.cust_id, T2.cust_nm FROM cust_segment_hist AS T1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND T1.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Find the customer id and name of customers who placed an order on 2026-04-03 and also placed an order on 2026-04-04.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T2.cust_nm FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.ord_dt = '2026-04-03' INTERSECT SELECT T1.cust_id, T2.cust_nm FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.ord_dt = '2026-04-04' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Show customer IDs and names for customers who used the 'BACK2SCH' promotion code but never used the 'BF25' promotion code.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id INNER JOIN ord_promo AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id INNER JOIN promo AS T4 ON T3.promo_id = T4.promo_id WHERE T4.promo_cd = 'BACK2SCH' EXCEPT SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id INNER JOIN ord_promo AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id INNER JOIN promo AS T4 ON T3.promo_id = T4.promo_id WHERE T4.promo_cd = 'BF25' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: List the customer id and name for active customers who have never placed any order.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the order id and total amount for orders that used promotion id 1 and had a total amount greater than 200.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T2.promo_id = 1 AND T1.ord_total_amt > 200.00 ORDER BY T1.ord_id ASC

items.question: List the channel code and the count of web events for each channel in December 2025.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY channel_cd ASC

items.question: Show the promotion code and the number of orders that applied each promotion.
items.sql: SELECT T2.promo_cd, COUNT(T1.ord_id) FROM ord_promo AS T1 INNER JOIN promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id GROUP BY T2.promo_cd ORDER BY T2.promo_cd ASC

items.question: Find the tier code and the count of customers in each tier for active customers signed up in 2022.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC

items.question: List the month date and count of customers who were in the RISK segment for each month in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT month_dt, COUNT(cust_id) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'RISK' AND month_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month_dt ORDER BY month_dt ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and name of customers who viewed product ELC-025 in web events and also placed an order on the WEB channel.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 INNER JOIN web_event AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.sku = 'ELC-025' INTERSECT SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.channel_cd = 'WEB' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: List customer IDs and names for customers who have placed orders through both the WEB channel and the APP channel.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T2.cust_nm FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.channel_cd = 'WEB' INTERSECT SELECT T1.cust_id, T2.cust_nm FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Find the customer id and name of customers who had a 'NEW' segment in June 2026 but do not have any record in the customer segment history for July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T2.cust_nm FROM cust_segment_hist AS T1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND T1.segment_cd = 'NEW' AND T1.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01') ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the promotion code and promotion name for promotions that were applied to at least one order in currency USD but never applied to an order in currency EUR.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE promo_id IN (SELECT T1.promo_id FROM ord_promo AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T2.currency_cd = 'USD') EXCEPT SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE promo_id IN (SELECT T1.promo_id FROM ord_promo AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T2.currency_cd = 'EUR') ORDER BY promo_cd ASC

items.question: List the customer id and name for gold tier customers who have placed at least two orders with a total amount greater than 300.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.tier_cd = 'G' AND T2.ord_total_amt > 300.00 GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(T2.ord_id) >= 2 ORDER BY T1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find the session id and customer id for web event sessions that recorded both a VIEW event and a CART event for any product.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' INTERSECT SELECT session_id, cust_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART' ORDER BY session_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and customer name for customers who triggered a PURCHASE event on the APP channel and also placed an order via the STR channel.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 INNER JOIN web_event AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.channel_cd = 'APP' AND T2.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' INTERSECT SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.channel_cd = 'STR' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: List promotion codes and promotion names for promotions that were applied to orders in both the NA region and the EU region.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, T1.promo_nm FROM promo AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id INNER JOIN cust_master AS T4 ON T3.cust_id = T4.cust_id WHERE T4.region_cd = 'NA' INTERSECT SELECT T1.promo_cd, T1.promo_nm FROM promo AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id INNER JOIN cust_master AS T4 ON T3.cust_id = T4.cust_id WHERE T4.region_cd = 'EU' ORDER BY promo_cd ASC

items.question: Which customers signed up after 2022-06-01 in the AP region? Give me the customer ID and customer name.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt > '2022-06-01' AND region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: List all promotion codes and their names where the discount percentage is greater than 15.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_cd ASC

items.question: Show the order ID and order total amount for orders placed through the WEB channel on 2026-04-03.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Find the session ID and event timestamp for web events of type CHECKOUT that happened on 2025-11-27.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, evt_ts FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-27 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-27 23:59:59' ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, session_id ASC

items.question: What is the total number of orders placed in each sales channel? Show channel code and order count.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: How many active versus inactive customers do we have per region? Show region code, active status, and customer count.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, is_actv, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd, is_actv ORDER BY region_cd ASC, is_actv DESC

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for customers who have been in the VIP segment at least once during 2026.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND s.month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND s.month_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Which promotions have never been used on any order? Show the promotion ID and promotion code.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd FROM promo WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_promo WHERE ord_promo.promo_id = promo.promo_id) ORDER BY promo_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who have placed an order with a total amount greater than the average order total of all orders.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find all web sessions that recorded a PURCHASE event but never recorded a CART event. List the session ID and customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, cust_id FROM web_event w1 WHERE w1.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event w2 WHERE w2.session_id = w1.session_id AND w2.evt_type = 'CART') ORDER BY session_id ASC

items.question: Which customers have placed orders on every sales channel (APP, PHN, STR, WEB)? Give me the customer ID and name.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT ch.channel_cd FROM (SELECT DISTINCT channel_cd FROM ord_hdr) ch WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id AND o.channel_cd = ch.channel_cd)) ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and name of customers who have never placed any order.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id) ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: For each customer, find their latest segment code recorded in the history table. Show customer ID and segment code.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, s.segment_cd FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.month_dt = (SELECT MAX(s2.month_dt) FROM cust_segment_hist s2 WHERE s2.cust_id = c.cust_id) ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Which orders have a total amount higher than the average order total of their respective customer? Show order ID, customer ID, and order total amount.
items.sql: SELECT o1.ord_id, o1.cust_id, o1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o1 WHERE o1.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(o2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr o2 WHERE o2.cust_id = o1.cust_id) ORDER BY o1.cust_id ASC, o1.ord_id ASC

items.question: Identify customers whose every single order has a total amount greater than 200.00. Show customer ID and name.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id AND o.ord_total_amt <= 200.00) ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find promotions that have been applied to orders where every such order had a total amount exceeding 500.00. Show promotion ID and code.
items.sql: SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_cd FROM promo p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_promo op WHERE op.promo_id = p.promo_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_promo op JOIN ord_hdr o ON op.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE op.promo_id = p.promo_id AND o.ord_total_amt <= 500.00) ORDER BY p.promo_id ASC

items.question: Which customers have orders spanning more than one currency? Show customer ID and customer name.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.currency_cd) > 1 ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find web sessions that contain both a VIEW event for product 'ELC-025' and a PURCHASE event. Show the session ID.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM web_event w1 WHERE w1.sku = 'ELC-025' AND w1.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event w2 WHERE w2.session_id = w1.session_id AND w2.evt_type = 'PURCHASE') ORDER BY session_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer ID and name for customers who placed orders in every month of 2026 that appear in the order table.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT m.ord_mo FROM (SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_mo FROM ord_hdr) m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id AND DATE_FORMAT(o.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') = m.ord_mo)) ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find customers who were assigned the 'VIP' segment in their most recent segment history record. Show customer ID and name.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN cust_segment_hist s ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id WHERE s.month_dt = (SELECT MAX(s2.month_dt) FROM cust_segment_hist s2 WHERE s2.cust_id = c.cust_id) AND s.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Which products have never been viewed in any web event? Show SKU and product name.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event w WHERE w.sku = p.sku) ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Find orders that used more than one promotion code. Show order ID and the count of promotions applied.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(promo_id) FROM ord_promo GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(promo_id) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(promo_id) DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and name for customers who have had at least one support ticket opened with severity level 1.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN support_tkt t ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id WHERE t.sev_lvl = 1 ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the employee ID and full name of employees who have never approved any refund request.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refund_req r WHERE r.approver_emp_id = e.emp_id) ORDER BY emp_id ASC

items.question: Show the count of web events in 2025-11 for each channel code.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd

items.question: List each loyalty tier code and the count of active customers in it.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY tier_cd

items.question: For each sales region code, show the total count of customer master records.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd

items.question: Show the order status code and the count of orders for each status in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY ord_status

items.question: For each channel code, give the count of orders placed in July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY channel_cd

items.question: List every segment code from the customer segment history for 2026-07-01 and the count of customers.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' GROUP BY segment_cd

items.question: Show the promotion ID and the count of distinct orders that used each promotion.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ord_id) FROM ord_promo GROUP BY promo_id

items.question: Give the count of web events broken down by event type for the app channel.
items.sql: SELECT evt_type, COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' GROUP BY evt_type

items.question: For each loyalty tier, show the count of active customers side by side with the count of inactive customers.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd

items.question: For each sales region code, show the total count of customers along with the count of platinum tier customers.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN tier_cd = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd

items.question: Show each promotion ID and the count of orders using it via the web channel versus the app channel.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_id, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN t2.channel_cd = 'APP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM ord_promo AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id

items.question: For each month in the customer segment history during 2026, show the count of customers in the VIP segment versus the REG segment.
items.sql: SELECT month_dt, SUM(CASE WHEN segment_cd = 'VIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN segment_cd = 'REG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY month_dt

items.question: Break down web events in 2025 by event type, showing the count for the WEB channel and the APP channel side by side.
items.sql: SELECT evt_type, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'APP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY evt_type

items.question: For each sales region code in the customer master, give the count of gold tier customers and standard tier customers.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN tier_cd = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN tier_cd = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd

items.question: For each channel code, list the total count of orders in 2026 and the count of orders with status shipped.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd

items.question: Show each promotion ID and the count of orders with status delivered versus cancelled that used that promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_id, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.ord_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN t2.ord_status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM ord_promo AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id

items.question: For every customer sales region, calculate the percentage of active customers out of all customers.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd

items.question: For each loyalty tier, calculate the ratio of active customers to total customers.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd

items.question: For each channel code in order headers during 2026, find the proportion of orders that are delivered relative to all orders.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd

items.question: For each promotion ID, calculate the percentage of its associated orders that have been cancelled.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_id, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t2.ord_status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM ord_promo AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id

items.question: For each month in 2026, show the total number of customer segment history entries along with the counts for NEW, REG, and VIP segments side by side.
items.sql: SELECT month_dt, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN segment_cd = 'NEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN segment_cd = 'REG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN segment_cd = 'VIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY month_dt

items.question: For each web event channel, calculate the percentage of events that are purchase events.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM web_event GROUP BY channel_cd

items.question: For each sales region in the customer master, compute the percentage of platinum tier customers among all active customers.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN tier_cd = 'P' AND is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd

items.question: For each promotion ID, calculate the ratio of orders via the web channel versus total orders using that promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_id, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM ord_promo AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id

items.question: A Black Friday order is defined as any order placed using the Black Friday promotion code 'BF25'. Show the order id and the order total amount for all Black Friday orders placed in the year 2025.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id JOIN promo AS t3 ON t2.promo_id = t3.promo_id WHERE t3.promo_cd = 'BF25' AND t1.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2025-12-31'

items.question: A VIP customer is someone whose customer segment in the cust_segment_hist table is 'VIP'. Show the customer id and customer name for all active customers who held the VIP segment during the month starting 2026-09-01.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-09-01'

items.question: An unpromoted order is an order that has no entries in the ord_promo table. Show the order id and order total amount for all unpromoted orders placed through the website channel ('WEB') on 2026-04-03.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt = '2026-04-03' AND ord_id NOT IN (SELECT ord_id FROM ord_promo)

items.question: A multi-promo order is an order linked to more than one promotion in the ord_promo table. Show the order id and the count of promotions applied for all multi-promo orders, ordered by the count descending then order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(promo_id) AS promo_cnt FROM ord_promo GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(promo_id) > 1 ORDER BY promo_cnt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A web browse session is defined as any tracking session recorded in the web_event table via the 'WEB' channel. Show the distinct session id and the count of web events for each browse session that occurred on 2025-11-09, ordered by event count descending then session id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, COUNT(evt_id) AS ev_cnt FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND DATE(evt_ts) = '2025-11-09' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY ev_cnt DESC, session_id ASC

items.question: A platinum loyalty customer is any customer whose loyalty tier code is 'P'. Show the customer id and customer name for all platinum loyalty customers in the North America region ('NA').
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA'

items.question: A cart abandonment session is a browsing session that recorded a 'CART' event but never recorded a subsequent 'PURCHASE' event. Show the distinct session id for all cart abandonment sessions that happened on 2025-11-23, ordered by session id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM web_event WHERE DATE(evt_ts) = '2025-11-23' AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART') AND session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE') ORDER BY session_id ASC

items.question: A high-value order is any order with an order total amount exceeding 500.00 in USD currency. Show the order id and order date for all high-value USD orders placed during the first half of 2026 (from 2026-01-01 through 2026-06-30).
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00 AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30'

items.question: A risk segment customer is a customer who held the segment code 'RISK' during the month of August 2026 (month starting 2026-08-01). Show the customer id and customer name for these customers.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-08-01'

items.question: An app-based purchase event is a web_event record where the event type is 'PURCHASE' and the channel code is 'APP'. Show the event id, session id, and order id for all app-based purchase events that occurred on 2025-11-27.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, session_id, ord_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND channel_cd = 'APP' AND DATE(evt_ts) = '2025-11-27'

items.question: A promotional discount order is any order that utilized a promotion offering a discount percentage strictly greater than 15.00 percent. Show the distinct order id values for all such orders.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.ord_id FROM ord_promo AS t1 JOIN promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id WHERE t2.disc_pct > 15.00

items.question: A newly signed-up customer is a customer whose signup date is on or after 2022-07-01. Show the customer id, customer name, and signup date for all active customers in the Asia Pacific region ('AP') who are newly signed-up.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'AP' AND signup_dt >= '2022-07-01'

items.question: An inactive customer account is a customer record where the active flag is 0. Show the customer id, customer name, and region code for all inactive customer accounts.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, region_cd FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 0

items.question: A recurring promotion is a promotion code whose name contains the word 'offer' (case-insensitive). Show the promotion id, promotion code, and promotion name for all recurring promotions.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE LOWER(promo_nm) LIKE '%offer%'

items.question: A seasonal promotion is any promotion whose start date falls between 2026-01-01 and 2026-06-30 inclusive. Show the promotion code, promotion name, and discount percentage for all seasonal promotions, ordered by discount percentage descending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND starts_dt <= '2026-06-30' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC

items.question: A customer session journey is defined as a sequence of web events generated during a single browsing session. Show the session id and the total number of events recorded in that session for all sessions that took place on 2025-12-09, ordered by the event count descending then session id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, COUNT(evt_id) AS total_events FROM web_event WHERE DATE(evt_ts) = '2025-12-09' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY total_events DESC, session_id ASC

items.question: A gold tier customer is defined as any customer holding the loyalty tier code 'G'. Show the customer id, customer name, and signup date for all gold tier customers in the European region ('EU').
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'G' AND region_cd = 'EU'

items.question: A phone order is an order placed via the phone channel ('PHN'). Show the order id, customer id, and order total amount for all phone orders placed in July 2026 (from 2026-07-01 through 2026-07-31).
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'PHN' AND ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-07-31'

items.question: A segment transition customer is a customer who has at least two distinct segment records recorded in the cust_segment_hist table. Show the customer id and the count of distinct segments, ordered by the count descending then customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(DISTINCT segment_cd) AS seg_count FROM cust_segment_hist GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT segment_cd) > 1 ORDER BY seg_count DESC, cust_id ASC

items.question: An unfulfilled promotion is a promotion record from the promo table that has never been linked to any order in the ord_promo table. Show the promotion id and promotion code for all unfulfilled promotions.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd FROM promo WHERE promo_id NOT IN (SELECT promo_id FROM ord_promo)

items.question: A product view event is a web_event record where the event type is 'VIEW' and a specific product SKU is provided. Show the distinct product SKU values viewed through the mobile app channel ('APP') on 2025-12-12.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND channel_cd = 'APP' AND sku IS NOT NULL AND DATE(evt_ts) = '2025-12-12'

items.question: A top promotional campaign is any promotion that has been applied to 3 or more distinct orders. Show the promotion id, promotion code, and the count of orders it was applied to, ordered by the order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS ord_cnt FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd HAVING COUNT(t2.ord_id) >= 3 ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC

items.question: A high-frequency web visitor is a customer account associated with more than 2 distinct browsing sessions in the web_event table. Show the customer id and the count of distinct sessions, ordered by the session count descending then customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sess_cnt FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) > 2 ORDER BY sess_cnt DESC, cust_id ASC

items.question: A cancelled order is an order whose order status code is 'C'. Show the order id, order date, and order total amount for all cancelled orders placed in the Latin America region ('LA') through customer records.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_status = 'C' AND t2.region_cd = 'LA'

items.question: Can you list the full name and employee ID of Amara Singh's direct reports?
items.sql: SELECT T1.emp_nm, T1.emp_id FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.mgr_emp_id = T2.emp_id WHERE T2.emp_nm = 'Amara Singh'

items.question: Show me the employee ID and full name of anyone whose manager is employee E-001.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001'

items.question: Which employees report directly to Beatrice Owusu? Give me their full names and employee IDs.
items.sql: SELECT T1.emp_nm, T1.emp_id FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.mgr_emp_id = T2.emp_id WHERE T2.emp_nm = 'Beatrice Owusu'

items.question: Pull a list of employee IDs and full names for all staff members who do not have a manager assigned.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL

items.question: How many direct reports does each manager have? Show the manager employee ID and the count of direct reports, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT mgr_emp_id, COUNT(*) FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mgr_emp_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, mgr_emp_id

items.question: For the finance department (FIN), give me the employee ID and full name of every staff member.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'FIN'

items.question: List the full name and employee ID of employees who report directly to someone in the engineering department (ENG).
items.sql: SELECT T1.emp_nm, T1.emp_id FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.mgr_emp_id = T2.emp_id WHERE T2.dept_cd = 'ENG'

items.question: Find all employees who sit two levels below Amara Singh in the reporting chain. Show their employee ID and full name.
items.sql: SELECT T3.emp_id, T3.emp_nm FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.emp_id = T2.mgr_emp_id JOIN emp AS T3 ON T2.emp_id = T3.mgr_emp_id WHERE T1.emp_nm = 'Amara Singh'

items.question: Show the full name and department code of employees whose manager is also in the management department (MGT).
items.sql: SELECT T1.emp_nm, T1.dept_cd FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.mgr_emp_id = T2.emp_id WHERE T2.dept_cd = 'MGT'

items.question: For each department code, count how many employees are top-level managers with no supervisor. Show the department code and the count.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL GROUP BY dept_cd ORDER BY dept_cd

items.question: List the employee ID and full name of employees hired before 2020-01-01 who manage at least one other staff member.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.emp_id, T1.emp_nm FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.emp_id = T2.mgr_emp_id WHERE T1.hire_dt < '2020-01-01' ORDER BY T1.emp_id

items.question: Show the full name of every employee who shares the same manager as employee E-003, excluding E-003 themselves.
items.sql: SELECT emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = (SELECT mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-003') AND emp_id <> 'E-003'

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, get the complete reporting hierarchy starting downwards from Amara Singh. Show the employee ID, full name, and their depth level in the chain.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE org_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 1 AS depth FROM emp WHERE emp_nm = 'Amara Singh' UNION ALL SELECT T1.emp_id, T1.emp_nm, T1.emp_id, T2.depth + 1 FROM emp AS T1 JOIN org_tree AS T2 ON T1.mgr_emp_id = T2.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, depth FROM org_tree ORDER BY depth, emp_id

items.question: Find all employees in the entire reporting chain under Beatrice Owusu using recursion. Return their employee ID, full name, and depth level.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE org_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 1 AS depth FROM emp WHERE emp_nm = 'Beatrice Owusu' UNION ALL SELECT T1.emp_id, T1.emp_nm, T1.mgr_emp_id, T2.depth + 1 FROM emp AS T1 JOIN org_tree AS T2 ON T1.mgr_emp_id = T2.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, depth FROM org_tree WHERE depth > 1 ORDER BY depth, emp_id

items.question: Trace the upward management chain for employee E-007 using a recursive CTE. Show the employee ID, full name, and steps away from E-007.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE up_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 0 AS steps FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-007' UNION ALL SELECT T1.emp_id, T1.emp_nm, T1.mgr_emp_id, T2.steps + 1 FROM emp AS T1 JOIN up_tree AS T2 ON T1.emp_id = T2.mgr_emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, steps FROM up_tree WHERE steps > 0 ORDER BY steps, emp_id

items.question: What is the maximum depth of the reporting tree starting from any top-level manager (someone with a NULL manager)? Show the top-level manager employee ID and their max subordinate depth.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE org_tree AS (SELECT emp_id AS top_id, emp_id, mgr_emp_id, 1 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT T1.top_id, T2.emp_id, T2.mgr_emp_id, T1.depth + 1 FROM org_tree AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T2.mgr_emp_id = T1.emp_id) SELECT top_id, MAX(depth) FROM org_tree GROUP BY top_id ORDER BY top_id

items.question: List the employee ID and full name of employees who belong to the support department (SUP) and whose direct manager is in a different department.
items.sql: SELECT T1.emp_id, T1.emp_nm FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.mgr_emp_id = T2.emp_id WHERE T1.dept_cd = 'SUP' AND T2.dept_cd <> 'SUP'

items.question: Find managers who have at least 2 direct reports that themselves manage at least one person. Return the manager's employee ID and full name.
items.sql: SELECT T1.emp_id, T1.emp_nm FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T2.mgr_emp_id = T1.emp_id WHERE T2.emp_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT mgr_emp_id FROM emp) GROUP BY T1.emp_id, T1.emp_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.emp_id) >= 2 ORDER BY T1.emp_id

items.question: For each department, calculate the total number of employees and how many of them are managers (have at least one direct report). Show department code, total employee count, and manager count.
items.sql: SELECT T1.dept_cd, COUNT(T1.emp_id), COUNT(DISTINCT T2.mgr_emp_id) FROM emp AS T1 LEFT JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.emp_id = T2.mgr_emp_id GROUP BY T1.dept_cd ORDER BY T1.dept_cd

items.question: Identify any employee who manages their own manager's manager (circular reporting anomaly check). Show employee ID and full name.
items.sql: SELECT T1.emp_id, T1.emp_nm FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.mgr_emp_id = T2.emp_id JOIN emp AS T3 ON T2.mgr_emp_id = T3.emp_id WHERE T3.mgr_emp_id = T1.emp_id

items.question: Using recursion, count how many total descendants (subordinates at any level) each top-level executive has. Show the executive employee ID, full name, and total subordinate count.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE org_tree AS (SELECT emp_id AS top_id, emp_id, mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT T1.top_id, T2.emp_id, T2.mgr_emp_id FROM org_tree AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T2.mgr_emp_id = T1.emp_id) SELECT T3.emp_id, T3.emp_nm, COUNT(T1.emp_id) FROM org_tree AS T1 JOIN emp AS T3 ON T1.top_id = T3.emp_id WHERE T1.emp_id <> T3.emp_id GROUP BY T3.emp_id, T3.emp_nm ORDER BY T3.emp_id

items.question: List the employee ID and full name of employees who have no direct reports and whose hire date is earlier than the average hire date of their direct manager.
items.sql: SELECT T1.emp_id, T1.emp_nm FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.mgr_emp_id = T2.emp_id WHERE T1.emp_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL) AND T1.hire_dt < T2.hire_dt ORDER BY T1.emp_id

items.question: Find pairs of employees (manager and direct report) where both were hired in the same calendar year. Show the manager's full name and the report's full name.
items.sql: SELECT T2.emp_nm, T1.emp_nm FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp AS T2 ON T1.mgr_emp_id = T2.emp_id WHERE YEAR(T1.hire_dt) = YEAR(T2.hire_dt) ORDER BY T2.emp_nm, T1.emp_nm

items.question: For each department, find the employee who was hired earliest (first hire). Show department code, employee ID, and hire date.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, emp_id, hire_dt FROM emp AS T1 WHERE hire_dt = (SELECT MIN(hire_dt) FROM emp AS T2 WHERE T2.dept_cd = T1.dept_cd) ORDER BY dept_cd

items.question: Show the promotion name and discount percentage for all active promotions during the Black Friday event.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE promo_cd = 'BF25';

items.question: List the customer name and signup date for platinum tier customers in the North American region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA';

items.question: What is the total order amount for orders placed through the mobile app channel in Europe?
items.sql: SELECT SUM(t1.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.channel_cd = 'APP' AND t2.region_cd = 'EU';

items.question: Show the order ID and order total amount for orders that were cancelled.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C';

items.question: List the customer name and sign-up date for customers who belong to the loyalty reward promotion.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_nm, t1.signup_dt FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id INNER JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id INNER JOIN promo AS t4 ON t3.promo_id = t4.promo_id WHERE t4.promo_cd = 'LOYAL5';

items.question: Show the promotion name and the total number of orders that used the promotion, ordered by order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM promo AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t2.ord_id) DESC, t1.promo_nm ASC;

items.question: List the customer name and segment code for customers in the risk segment as of 2026-08-01.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.segment_cd FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-08-01';

items.question: Count the number of website clickstream events of type cart addition during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_type = 'CART' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00';

items.question: Find the customer name and total spend for all active gold tier customers in the Asia Pacific region, ordered by total spend descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 AND t1.tier_cd = 'G' AND t1.region_cd = 'AP' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.cust_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the session ID and event timestamp for web browsing sessions that started on the web channel and ended with a purchase order placed.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.session_id, t1.evt_ts FROM web_event AS t1 WHERE t1.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t1.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE');

items.question: For each customer tier, calculate the average order total amount for orders placed via the web channel in USD currency.
items.sql: SELECT t1.tier_cd, AVG(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t2.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY t1.tier_cd;

items.question: List the customer name and the count of support tickets they opened in the billing category, ordered by ticket count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.tkt_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN support_tkt AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.categ_cd = 'BILL' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t2.tkt_id) DESC, t1.cust_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the order ID and order date for orders placed by standard tier customers.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.tier_cd = 'S';

items.question: List the customer ID and sign-up date for active customers in Latin America.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'LA';

items.question: Show the promotion code and promotion name for promotions that offer a discount percentage greater than 15 percent.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00;

items.question: What is the total order amount for orders processed through the phone channel?
items.sql: SELECT SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'PHN';

items.question: Find the customer name and the maximum order total amount they placed using the store channel.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, MAX(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'STR' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm;

items.question: List the promotion name and total order amount associated with orders that used the Black Friday promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.promo_cd = 'BF25' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm;

items.question: Show the customer segment code and the number of customers in that segment for July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(cust_id) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' GROUP BY segment_cd;

items.question: List the session ID and event timestamp for website view events involving products in the electronic category.
items.sql: SELECT t1.session_id, t1.evt_ts FROM web_event AS t1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND t2.categ_cd = 'ELC';

items.question: For each sales region, calculate the total order amount for orders placed in 2026 that had a shipped status.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_status = 'S' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.region_cd;

items.question: Find the customer name and total count of web events for VIP customers who logged into the web channel.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.evt_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'P' AND t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm;

items.question: Show the promotion name and average order total for each promotion used on orders placed via the app channel.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, AVG(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.channel_cd = 'APP' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm;

items.question: List the customer name and the number of distinct orders for customers whose segment was new in October 2026, ordered by order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id LEFT JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t3.segment_cd = 'NEW' AND t3.month_dt = '2026-10-01' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t2.ord_id) DESC, t1.cust_nm ASC;

items.sql: SELECT sup_id, AVG(lead_days) FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1 GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY AVG(lead_days) DESC, sup_id ASC

items.question: For stock movements that occurred between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-07, show the movement type and the sum of quantities.
items.sql: SELECT mv_type, SUM(qty) FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-07 23:59:59' GROUP BY mv_type ORDER BY SUM(qty) DESC, mv_type ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the count of inventory items where the on-hand quantity is less than or equal to the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Find the product name and list price for the top 3 most expensive products that are not discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 3

items.question: Show the category code and the average list price for categories where the average list price is above 50 USD.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd HAVING AVG(list_prc) > 50.00 ORDER BY AVG(list_prc) DESC, categ_cd ASC

items.question: List each supplier ID and the count of products they supply where the lead days are strictly greater than 20.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, COUNT(*) FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days > 20 GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, sup_id ASC

items.question: For each order line, calculate the net line value as (qty * unit_prc * (1 - disc_pct / 100)). Show the order ID and the sum of net line values for each order.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, SUM(qty * unit_prc * (1 - disc_pct / 100)) FROM ord_line GROUP BY ord_id ORDER BY SUM(qty * unit_prc * (1 - disc_pct / 100)) DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Find the supplier name and country for the supplier who provides the product with the longest lead time in the product supplier table.
items.sql: SELECT T2.sup_nm, T2.country FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id ORDER BY T1.lead_days DESC, T1.sku ASC, T1.sup_id ASC LIMIT 1

items.question: Show the warehouse name and the total inventory on hand for warehouses that hold more than 1500 units in total across all SKUs.
items.sql: SELECT T2.wh_nm, SUM(T1.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory AS T1 JOIN warehouse AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id GROUP BY T2.wh_id, T2.wh_nm HAVING SUM(T1.on_hand_qty) > 1500 ORDER BY SUM(T1.on_hand_qty) DESC, T2.wh_nm ASC

items.question: List each product category name/code and the count of distinct suppliers that provide products in that category.
items.sql: SELECT T1.categ_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.sup_id) FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku GROUP BY T1.categ_cd ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T2.sup_id) DESC, T1.categ_cd ASC

items.question: Find the product name, SKU, and total stock movement quantity for products that have had stock movement type 'OUT' recorded.
items.sql: SELECT T2.prod_nm, T1.sku, SUM(T1.qty) FROM inv_move AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY T1.sku, T2.prod_nm ORDER BY SUM(T1.qty) ASC, T1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the supplier name, product SKU, and lead days for suppliers whose lead time is strictly greater than the average lead time of all primary supplier records.
items.sql: SELECT T2.sup_nm, T1.sku, T1.lead_days FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T1.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(lead_days) FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1) ORDER BY T1.lead_days DESC, T2.sup_nm ASC, T1.sku ASC

items.question: What is the name and country of the primary supplier for product ELC-025? Show the supplier name and country code.
items.sql: SELECT T2.sup_nm, T2.country FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T1.sku = 'ELC-025' AND T1.is_primary = 1

items.question: Give me the stock level and reorder point for SKU ELC-024 at warehouse W1 today. Show the on hand quantity and reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE sku = 'ELC-024' AND wh_id = 'W1'

items.question: List the names of all warehouses located in the European region. Show the warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'EU'

items.question: What category code and list price does product ELC-026 have? Show the category code and list price.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku = 'ELC-026'

items.question: Find all stock movements of type 'IN' for SKU ELC-029 at warehouse W2. Show the movement id, timestamp, and quantity moved, ordered by timestamp descending.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE sku = 'ELC-029' AND wh_id = 'W2' AND mv_type = 'IN' ORDER BY mv_ts DESC, mv_id DESC

items.question: Show the SKU, lead days, and whether it is the primary supplier for any product supplied by supplier ID 1. Order by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days, is_primary FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 1 ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Which supplier names provide product ELC-024? Show the supplier name and lead days, ordered by lead days ascending, then supplier name.
items.sql: SELECT T2.sup_nm, T1.lead_days FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T1.sku = 'ELC-024' ORDER BY T1.lead_days ASC, T2.sup_nm ASC

items.question: Show all inventory details for products in the electronics category. Return the SKU, warehouse ID, on hand quantity, and reorder point, ordered by SKU and warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.wh_id, T1.on_hand_qty, T1.reorder_pt FROM inventory AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY T1.sku ASC, T1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Which products currently have their on-hand quantity at or below their reorder point in warehouse W1? Show the SKU, product name, on-hand quantity, and reorder point, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm, T1.on_hand_qty, T1.reorder_pt FROM inventory AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' AND T1.on_hand_qty <= T1.reorder_pt ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: Give me the total quantity moved out of warehouse W3 due to customer orders between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31. Show the total quantity as a positive number (sum of absolute quantities).
items.sql: SELECT SUM(ABS(qty)) FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W3' AND mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59'

items.question: What is the primary supplier name and their lead time for each kitchen product (categ_cd 'KIT')? Show the product name, supplier name, and lead days, ordered by product name.
items.sql: SELECT T1.prod_nm, T3.sup_nm, T2.lead_days FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T2.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T1.categ_cd = 'KIT' AND T2.is_primary = 1 ORDER BY T1.prod_nm ASC

items.question: Show all stock movements categorized as adjustments ('ADJ') in warehouse W1 during October 2025. Return movement ID, SKU, timestamp, and quantity, ordered by timestamp ascending.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC

items.question: Which warehouses hold stock for products whose list price exceeds 80.00 USD? Return the warehouse name, SKU, and list price, ordered by list price descending, then warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT T3.wh_nm, T1.sku, T1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku JOIN warehouse AS T3 ON T2.wh_id = T3.wh_id WHERE T1.list_prc > 80.00 ORDER BY T1.list_prc DESC, T3.wh_nm ASC

items.question: Calculate the total inventory valuation (on_hand_qty multiplied by list_prc) for each warehouse. Show the warehouse name and total inventory value, ordered by total value descending.
items.sql: SELECT T3.wh_nm, SUM(T1.on_hand_qty * T2.list_prc) AS total_val FROM inventory AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku JOIN warehouse AS T3 ON T1.wh_id = T3.wh_id GROUP BY T3.wh_nm ORDER BY total_val DESC

items.question: For orders placed in November 2025 (starting 2025-11-01), list the items ordered along with their quantities and the warehouse name from which the order line's product is primarily stocked or linked. Show order ID, SKU, quantity, and warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T1.sku, T1.qty, T3.wh_nm FROM ord_line AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id JOIN inventory AS T4 ON T1.sku = T4.sku JOIN warehouse AS T3 ON T4.wh_id = T3.wh_id WHERE T2.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND T2.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' AND T4.wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY T1.ord_id ASC, T1.sku ASC

items.question: Find suppliers who provide more than 2 products in our catalog. Show the supplier name and the count of products they supply, ordered by count descending, then supplier name.
items.sql: SELECT T2.sup_nm, COUNT(T1.sku) AS prod_cnt FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id GROUP BY T2.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(T1.sku) > 2 ORDER BY prod_cnt DESC, T2.sup_nm ASC

items.question: What is the average lead time (in days) across all products supplied by each supplier? Show the supplier name and average lead days, ordered by average lead days descending.
items.sql: SELECT T2.sup_nm, AVG(T1.lead_days) AS avg_lead FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id GROUP BY T2.sup_nm ORDER BY avg_lead DESC, T2.sup_nm ASC

items.question: List all products that have stock quantities below the reorder point in all warehouses where they are stored. Show the SKU, product name, warehouse ID, on hand quantity, and reorder point, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm, T1.wh_id, T1.on_hand_qty, T1.reorder_pt FROM inventory AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.on_hand_qty < T1.reorder_pt ORDER BY T1.sku ASC, T1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Which warehouses have the highest total on-hand inventory across all SKUs? Show the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and total units on hand, ordered by total units descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T2.wh_nm, SUM(T1.on_hand_qty) AS total_units FROM inventory AS T1 JOIN warehouse AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T2.wh_nm ORDER BY total_units DESC

items.question: List every stock movement associated with an order, showing the movement ID, order ID, SKU, warehouse ID, movement type, and quantity moved for movements occurring in October 2025. Order by movement ID.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, ord_id, sku, wh_id, mv_type, qty FROM inv_move WHERE ord_id IS NOT NULL AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' ORDER BY mv_id ASC

items.question: Find the maximum list price among products supplied by supplier 'Orion Electronics'. Return the maximum price.
items.sql: SELECT MAX(T1.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T2.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T3.sup_nm = 'Orion Electronics'

items.question: How many discontinued products (disc_flag = 1) are currently listed in each product category? Show the category code and the count, ordered by category code.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(sku) FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC

items.question: Get the list of all suppliers based in the US or CN. Show the supplier ID, supplier name, and country code, ordered by country code, then supplier name.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country IN ('US', 'CN') ORDER BY country ASC, sup_nm ASC

items.question: What is the total quantity of product ELC-024 ordered across all order lines? Show the total quantity ordered.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(qty) FROM ord_line WHERE sku = 'ELC-024'

items.question: Show the product SKU and list price for all items in the electronics category.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC'

items.question: List the supplier ID and supplier name for all suppliers located in the United States.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US'

items.question: What is the warehouse ID and warehouse name for every facility in the Europe region?
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'EU'

items.question: Give me the SKU and on-hand quantity for every product stored at warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1'

items.question: Show the product SKU and primary supplier flag for all supplier links where the lead days are greater than 30.
items.sql: SELECT sku, is_primary FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days > 30

items.question: List the product name and list price for all items that are currently discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1

items.question: Show the warehouse name and the total number of distinct products currently stocked in each warehouse, ordered by product count descending, then warehouse name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.wh_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.sku) AS product_count FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t2.wh_id, t2.wh_nm ORDER BY product_count DESC, t2.wh_nm ASC

items.question: Find the product SKU and total quantity ordered across all order lines for each product, sorted by total ordered quantity descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_ordered FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_ordered DESC, sku ASC

items.question: List the supplier name and the count of products they supply, ordered by the number of products descending, then supplier name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) AS product_count FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY product_count DESC, t1.sup_nm ASC

items.question: Show the product name and its primary supplier's name for every product that has a primary supplier assigned.
items.sql: SELECT t1.prod_nm, t3.sup_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN supplier AS t3 ON t2.sup_id = t3.sup_id WHERE t2.is_primary = 1

items.question: What is the product SKU and total stock movement quantity for all stock adjustments ('ADJ') recorded in the system, sorted by SKU?
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_adj_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse name and the sum of reorder points for all inventory items in each warehouse, ordered by total reorder point descending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.wh_nm, SUM(t1.reorder_pt) AS total_reorder_pt FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t2.wh_id, t2.wh_nm ORDER BY total_reorder_pt DESC

items.question: For products in the kitchen category, list the SKU, product name, and the maximum lead days among their suppliers, ordered by max lead days descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, MAX(t2.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.categ_cd = 'KIT' GROUP BY t1.sku, t1.prod_nm ORDER BY max_lead_days DESC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the supplier name and the average lead days for all their supplied products, restricted to suppliers who provide more than 1 product, ordered by average lead days ascending, then supplier name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, AVG(t2.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(t2.sku) > 1 ORDER BY avg_lead_days ASC, t1.sup_nm ASC

items.question: List the warehouse name and the total units currently on hand for items where the on-hand quantity is less than or equal to the reorder point, ordered by total deficient stock descending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.wh_nm, SUM(t1.on_hand_qty) AS low_stock_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.on_hand_qty <= t1.reorder_pt GROUP BY t2.wh_id, t2.wh_nm ORDER BY low_stock_qty DESC

items.question: For each product category, show the category code, the total count of products, and the average list price, sorted by average list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(sku) AS product_count, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC

items.question: Show the product SKU, product name, and total revenue generated from order lines (calculated as quantity times unit price) for each product, ordered by total revenue descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, SUM(t2.qty * t2.unit_prc) AS total_revenue FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN ord_line AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sku, t1.prod_nm ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: Find the supplier name and the count of distinct products they are listed as the primary supplier for, ordered by primary product count descending, then supplier name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.sku) AS primary_prod_count FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t2.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY primary_prod_count DESC, t1.sup_nm ASC

items.question: List the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and the total count of outbound stock movements ('OUT') handled by each warehouse, sorted by outbound count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.wh_id, t2.wh_nm, COUNT(t1.mv_id) AS out_move_count FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY t2.wh_id, t2.wh_nm ORDER BY out_move_count DESC

items.question: Show the product SKU and product name for items whose total on-hand quantity across all warehouses exceeds 1000 units, ordered by total on-hand quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sku, t1.prod_nm HAVING SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) > 1000 ORDER BY SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) DESC

items.question: For orders placed in 2025 (since 2025-11-01), show the SKU and the total quantity ordered for each product across all matching order lines, sorted by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, SUM(t1.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' GROUP BY t1.sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC

items.question: Show the supplier name and the maximum lead days among all products they supply, restricted to suppliers from country 'US' or 'CN', ordered by max lead days descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, MAX(t2.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t1.country IN ('US', 'CN') GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY max_lead_days DESC

items.question: Find the product SKU, product name, and the number of distinct warehouses stocking each item, ordered by warehouse count descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.wh_id) AS wh_count FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sku, t1.prod_nm ORDER BY wh_count DESC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: List the country code and the total number of suppliers in each country, filtered to countries with more than 1 supplier, ordered by supplier count descending.
items.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(sup_id) AS supplier_count FROM supplier GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(sup_id) > 1 ORDER BY supplier_count DESC

items.question: Show the product SKU, product name, and list price for items in the electronics category where list price is greater than 80.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 80.00;

items.question: List the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and region code for all warehouses in the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA';

items.question: Show the supplier ID, supplier name, and country for suppliers located in the United States.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US';

items.question: Show the SKU and on-hand quantity for stock items in warehouse W1 where the on-hand quantity is below 400.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty < 400;

items.question: List the movement ID, SKU, quantity moved, and movement timestamp for stock movements that occurred on 2025-10-02.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, qty, mv_ts FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-02 00:00:00' AND mv_ts < '2025-10-03 00:00:00';

items.question: Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and lead days for product supplier records where the lead days are 30 or more.
items.sql: SELECT sku, sup_id, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days >= 30;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products whose name starts with 'Atlas'.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE prod_nm LIKE 'Atlas%';

items.question: List the movement ID and movement timestamp for all adjustment movements recorded between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-05.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_ts FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts BETWEEN '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-10-05 23:59:59';

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and total number of inventory records held in each warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and the average order line unit price for each product, sorted by average unit price descending, breaking ties by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, AVG(unit_prc) AS avg_unit_prc FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY avg_unit_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the supplier ID and the count of products supplied by each supplier.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS product_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse ID, SKU, and on-hand quantity for inventory items where the on-hand quantity is less than or equal to the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY wh_id ASC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products that have a primary supplier with lead days greater than 20.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.is_primary = 1 AND T2.lead_days > 20 ORDER BY T1.sku ASC;

items.question: List the movement type and the total quantity moved for each movement type during October 2025 (between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31).
items.sql: SELECT mv_type, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts BETWEEN '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY mv_type ORDER BY mv_type ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse name and the total on-hand quantity across all products for each warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) AS total_stock FROM warehouse AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_stock DESC;

items.question: List the supplier name and the maximum lead time among their supplied products.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, MAX(T2.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm ORDER BY max_lead_days DESC, T1.sup_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and the total quantity ordered across all order lines for each product in the electronics category.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, COALESCE(SUM(T2.qty), 0) AS total_ordered FROM prod_catalog AS T1 LEFT JOIN ord_line AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.categ_cd = 'ELC' GROUP BY T1.sku, T1.prod_nm ORDER BY total_ordered DESC, T1.sku ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and the number of distinct products stored in each warehouse where total stock is greater than 500.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm, COUNT(T2.sku) AS product_count FROM warehouse AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm HAVING SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) > 500 ORDER BY product_count DESC, T1.wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the supplier name, product SKU, and lead days for products where the lead time is strictly greater than the average lead time of all product supplier assignments.
items.sql: SELECT T2.sup_nm, T1.sku, T1.lead_days FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T1.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(lead_days) FROM prod_supplier) ORDER BY T1.lead_days DESC, T1.sku ASC;

items.question: Find products that have never been moved in any inventory movement table. Return the SKU and product name.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM inv_move) ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: For each supplier, show the supplier name and the count of products where they serve as the primary supplier, ordered by primary product count descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, COUNT(T2.sku) AS primary_count FROM supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T2.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm ORDER BY primary_count DESC, T1.sup_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and the absolute sum of movement quantities for movements of type 'OUT' that occurred between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-15.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, SUM(ABS(T2.qty)) AS total_out_qty FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN inv_move AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.mv_type = 'OUT' AND T2.mv_ts BETWEEN '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-10-15 23:59:59' GROUP BY T1.sku, T1.prod_nm ORDER BY total_out_qty DESC, T1.sku ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and the sum of reorder points for all inventory items in warehouses located in regions 'NA' or 'EU'.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm, SUM(T2.reorder_pt) AS total_reorder_pt FROM warehouse AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T1.region_cd IN ('NA', 'EU') GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_reorder_pt DESC, T1.wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, list price, and the total inventory on hand across all warehouses for products whose list price exceeds 100.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T1.list_prc, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.list_prc > 100.00 GROUP BY T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T1.list_prc ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, T1.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the calendar year and month of order lines alongside the total quantity ordered for each month in 2025, ordered by year and month ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, SUM(t1.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: List each month in 2025 by year-month and report the count of stock movements that occurred in that month, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mv_month, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mv_month ASC;

items.question: Provide the year and quarter for each order date in 2025 along with the total order line revenue (sum of unit_prc * qty), sorted by quarter chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(t2.ord_dt), '-Q', QUARTER(t2.ord_dt)) AS ord_quarter, SUM(t1.unit_prc * t1.qty) AS total_revenue FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(t2.ord_dt), QUARTER(t2.ord_dt) ORDER BY ord_quarter ASC;

items.question: Display the year and week number for inventory movements of type 'OUT' during October 2025, showing the sum of quantities moved, ordered by week ascending.
items.sql: SELECT YEARWEEK(mv_ts, 3) AS yr_week, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_out_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01' AND mv_ts < '2025-11-01' GROUP BY YEARWEEK(mv_ts, 3) ORDER BY yr_week ASC;

items.question: Show the product category code, the year and month, and the total quantity ordered for each category per month in 2025, ordered by category code then month.
items.sql: SELECT t3.categ_cd, DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, SUM(t1.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog AS t3 ON t1.sku = t3.sku WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t3.categ_cd, DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY t3.categ_cd ASC, ord_month ASC;

items.question: For 2025, give the year and month of stock adjustments ('ADJ') and the net adjustment quantity for each month, ordered by month ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS adj_month, SUM(qty) AS net_adj_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY adj_month ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse ID, year, and month, along with the count of stock movements processed at each warehouse during the second half of 2025, ordered by warehouse ID and month.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mv_month, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-07-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY wh_id, DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY wh_id ASC, mv_month ASC;

items.question: Show the year and quarter for order lines associated with category 'ELC' (electronics) in 2025, reporting the total units ordered per quarter in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(t2.ord_dt), '-Q', QUARTER(t2.ord_dt)) AS ord_quarter, SUM(t1.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog AS t3 ON t1.sku = t3.sku WHERE t3.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(t2.ord_dt), QUARTER(t2.ord_dt) ORDER BY ord_quarter ASC;

items.question: Display the year and month of order dates in 2025 and the distinct count of customers who placed orders in each month, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS distinct_customers FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: Provide the calendar month (year-month) and the average unit price of order lines for each month in 2025, sorted chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, AVG(t1.unit_prc) AS avg_unit_price FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: Show the year and week number for stock movements categorized as 'IN' (restocks) across all warehouses during 2025, reporting total restock quantity per week in ascending order.
items.sql: SELECT YEARWEEK(mv_ts, 3) AS yr_week, SUM(qty) AS total_in_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEARWEEK(mv_ts, 3) ORDER BY yr_week ASC;

items.question: For each quarter of 2025, calculate the total line revenue (unit_prc * qty) specifically for sales channel code 'WEB', sorted by quarter.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(t2.ord_dt), '-Q', QUARTER(t2.ord_dt)) AS ord_quarter, SUM(t1.unit_prc * t1.qty) AS web_revenue FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(t2.ord_dt), QUARTER(t2.ord_dt) ORDER BY ord_quarter ASC;

items.question: List each month in 2025 and the total number of order line items sold that had a discount percentage greater than zero, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, SUM(t1.qty) AS discounted_qty FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.disc_pct > 0 AND t2.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: Display the region code of the warehouse, the year and month, and the total absolute movement quantity for stock movements in 2025, ordered by region and month.
items.sql: SELECT t2.region_cd, DATE_FORMAT(t1.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mv_month, SUM(ABS(t1.qty)) AS total_moved_qty FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND t1.mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t2.region_cd, DATE_FORMAT(t1.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY t2.region_cd ASC, mv_month ASC;

items.question: Show the year and month for 2025 along with the count of distinct products that had at least one order line, ordered by year-month ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.sku) AS distinct_products FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: Give the calendar year and month alongside the maximum order total amount (ord_total_amt) recorded in each month of 2025, sorted chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_order_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: Report the year and quarter and the total quantity of items moved via 'OUT' movements for each quarter of 2025, ordered chronologically.
