items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(mv_ts), '-Q', QUARTER(mv_ts)) AS mv_quarter, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_out_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(mv_ts), QUARTER(mv_ts) ORDER BY mv_quarter ASC;

items.question: Show the product SKU, the year and month, and the sum of quantities ordered for SKU 'ELC-024' across all months in 2025, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, SUM(t1.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.sku = 'ELC-024' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t1.sku, DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: List each month in 2025 and the average discount percentage applied across all order lines in that month, ordered by month ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, AVG(t1.disc_pct) AS avg_discount_pct FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t2.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: Display the supplier ID, the year and month of lead times, or rather count of product-supplier entries by primary flag and month? Let's stick strictly to bucketing: Show the supplier ID, year and month based on prod_supplier? Wait, prod_supplier has no date column. Let's use inv_move joined with prod_supplier via sku: Show the supplier ID, year and month, and total quantity moved for each supplier's products during 2025, ordered by supplier ID and month.
items.sql: SELECT t2.sup_id, DATE_FORMAT(t1.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mv_month, SUM(ABS(t1.qty)) AS total_moved_qty FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND t1.mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t2.sup_id, DATE_FORMAT(t1.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY t2.sup_id ASC, mv_month ASC;

items.question: Show the year and week number along with the total order line revenue for each week in October 2025, ordered by week ascending.
items.sql: SELECT YEARWEEK(t2.ord_dt, 3) AS yr_week, SUM(t1.unit_prc * t1.qty) AS weekly_revenue FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_dt >= '2025-10-01' AND t2.ord_dt < '2025-11-01' GROUP BY YEARWEEK(t2.ord_dt, 3) ORDER BY yr_week ASC;

items.question: Provide the calendar year and month and the total number of orders placed in each month of 2025, sorted chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: For each quarter in 2025, report the quarter name and the total count of stock movements that had movement type 'IN', sorted by quarter.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(mv_ts), '-Q', QUARTER(mv_ts)) AS mv_quarter, COUNT(*) AS in_movement_count FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(mv_ts), QUARTER(mv_ts) ORDER BY mv_quarter ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID, the year and month, and the sum of inventory on-hand quantities (grouped by month of movement) for movements at warehouse 'W1' in 2025, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, DATE_FORMAT(t1.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mv_month, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) AS sum_on_hand FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku AND t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.wh_id = 'W1' AND t1.mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND t1.mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t1.wh_id, DATE_FORMAT(t1.mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mv_month ASC;

items.question: Give me the stock levels for each product in the Newark Hub, starting with the highest quantity first.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' ORDER BY t1.on_hand_qty DESC, t1.sku ASC;

items.question: List the supplier names that provide products in the ELC category, ordered alphabetically.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sup_nm FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog AS t3 ON t2.sku = t3.sku WHERE t3.categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY t1.sup_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and list price for all products in the KIT category that are not discontinued, sorted by price descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Display the warehouse ID and the total inventory units held across all products for each warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: What are the lead times for all products supplied by Orion Electronics? Show the SKU and lead days.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.lead_days FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t2.sup_nm = 'Orion Electronics' ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: List the movement ID, timestamp, and quantity for all stock adjustments in the Singapore Hub.
items.sql: SELECT t1.mv_id, t1.mv_ts, t1.qty FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.wh_nm = 'Singapore Hub' AND t1.mv_type = 'ADJ' ORDER BY t1.mv_ts ASC, t1.mv_id ASC;

items.question: Rank products within each category by their list price in descending order. Show category code, SKU, list price, and the price rank.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, sku, list_prc, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) AS price_rank FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY categ_cd ASC, price_rank ASC, sku ASC;

items.question: For each warehouse, find the product with the maximum on-hand quantity. Show warehouse ID, SKU, and the on-hand quantity.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty FROM (SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC) AS rn FROM inventory) AS sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the cumulative sum of movement quantities over time for product ELC-026 in warehouse W3, ordered by movement timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC) AS running_qty FROM inv_move WHERE sku = 'ELC-026' AND wh_id = 'W3' ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC;

items.question: For product ELC-025, list each movement timestamp, type, and quantity, alongside the previous movement quantity using LAG.
items.sql: SELECT mv_ts, mv_type, qty, LAG(qty, 1) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC) AS prev_qty FROM inv_move WHERE sku = 'ELC-025' ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC;

items.question: Find the primary supplier for each product that has a lead time greater than 20 days. Show SKU, supplier name, and lead days.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.sup_nm, t1.lead_days FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t1.is_primary = 1 AND t1.lead_days > 20 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the top 3 warehouses by total stock units on hand. List the warehouse name and total units.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_nm, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) AS total_units FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_units DESC, t1.wh_nm ASC LIMIT 3;

items.question: List the top 2 highest-priced products in every category using DENSE_RANK. Show category code, product name, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) AS dr FROM prod_catalog) AS sub WHERE dr <= 2 ORDER BY categ_cd ASC, list_prc DESC, prod_nm ASC;

items.question: Calculate the running total of stock movement quantities for warehouse W1 over time, showing movement ID, timestamp, quantity, and running total.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC;

items.question: For each supplier, compare their product's lead time against the next supplier's lead time for the same product using LEAD. Show SKU, supplier ID, lead days, and next lead days.
items.sql: SELECT sku, sup_id, lead_days, LEAD(lead_days, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY sku ORDER BY lead_days ASC, sup_id ASC) AS next_lead_days FROM prod_supplier ORDER BY sku ASC, lead_days ASC, sup_id ASC;

items.question: Find each product's list price as a percentage of the maximum list price in its category. Show category code, SKU, list price, and price percentage.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, sku, list_prc, (list_prc / MAX(list_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd)) * 100.0 AS pct_of_max FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY categ_cd ASC, pct_of_max DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Identify the stock movements that had a quantity greater than the average movement quantity across all movements for the same product. Show movement ID, SKU, and quantity.
items.sql: SELECT t1.mv_id, t1.sku, t1.qty FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN (SELECT sku, AVG(ABS(qty)) AS avg_qty FROM inv_move GROUP BY sku) AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE ABS(t1.qty) > t2.avg_qty ORDER BY t1.sku ASC, t1.mv_id ASC;

items.question: Assign a row number to each stock movement partitioned by warehouse and movement type, ordered by timestamp. Show warehouse ID, movement type, movement timestamp, and row number.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, mv_type, mv_ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id, mv_type ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC) AS row_num FROM inv_move ORDER BY wh_id ASC, mv_type ASC, mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity for products whose stock is strictly below the average on-hand quantity of their respective warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.wh_id, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN (SELECT wh_id, AVG(on_hand_qty) AS avg_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.on_hand_qty < t2.avg_qty ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC, t1.on_hand_qty ASC, t1.sku ASC;

items.question: For each order line, show the SKU, quantity, unit price, and the running total of order line amounts (qty * unit_prc) ordered by order ID and line number.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, sku, qty, unit_prc, SUM(qty * unit_prc) OVER (ORDER BY ord_id ASC, line_no ASC) AS running_line_total FROM ord_line ORDER BY ord_id ASC, line_no ASC;

items.question: Rank suppliers by their average lead time across all products they supply, from lowest to highest average lead time. Show supplier ID, average lead days, and rank.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead_days, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(lead_days) ASC) AS lead_rank FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY lead_rank ASC, sup_id ASC;

items.question: Find all products that have an on-hand inventory quantity greater than the reorder point. Show SKU, warehouse ID, on-hand quantity, and reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty > reorder_pt ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show each product's stock quantity in warehouse W1 along with the previous product's quantity sorted by SKU using LAG.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty, LAG(on_hand_qty, 1) OVER (ORDER BY sku ASC) AS prev_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: Display the supplier name, country, and total count of products they supply, restricted to suppliers with at least 2 products, ordered by product count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, t1.country, COUNT(t2.sku) AS product_count FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm, t1.country HAVING COUNT(t2.sku) >= 2 ORDER BY product_count DESC, t1.sup_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and list price of all products in the ELC category that cost more than 50 USD, ordered by list price descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: List every warehouse name and its region code for hubs serving the NA region, sorted alphabetically by warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY wh_nm ASC;

items.question: What is the total quantity on hand for each warehouse ID in the inventory table? Show the warehouse ID and total stock, ordered by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show all distinct movement types present in the stock movements table, ordered alphabetically.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT mv_type FROM inv_move ORDER BY mv_type ASC;

items.question: For supplier ID 1, list the SKU, lead days, and whether they are primary, sorted by lead days ascending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days, is_primary FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 1 ORDER BY lead_days ASC, sku ASC;

items.question: Find the average list price for each product category code in the product catalog. Show category code and average price, ordered by category code.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and total units ordered across all order lines, ordered by total units descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: List the supplier name and country for all suppliers located in the US, ordered by supplier name.
items.sql: SELECT sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_nm ASC;

items.question: Show each SKU and the number of suppliers that provide it, for products having more than one supplier, ordered by supplier count descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, COUNT(sup_id) AS sup_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(sup_id) > 1 ORDER BY sup_count DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse ID and the count of SKUs where the current stock is at or below the reorder point, ordered by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(sku) AS low_stock_count FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: Which products have an average line unit price greater than 100 USD? Show the SKU and average unit price, ordered by average unit price descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, AVG(unit_prc) AS avg_unit_prc FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING AVG(unit_prc) > 100.00 ORDER BY avg_unit_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: For each supplier, show the supplier ID, supplier name, and the maximum lead days they have across all their products, ordered by maximum lead days descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_id, t2.sup_nm, MAX(t1.lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t2.sup_nm ORDER BY max_lead_days DESC, t1.sup_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for items in the ELC category whose list price is above the overall average list price of all products, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > (SELECT AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog) ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: Calculate the total inventory stock movements (quantity) for each movement type in October 2025 (between '2025-10-01' and '2025-10-31'). Show movement type and total quantity, ordered by movement type.
items.sql: SELECT mv_type, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY mv_type ORDER BY mv_type ASC;

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and list price for discontinued products (disc_flag = 1) that are still stocked in warehouse 'W1'. Order by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.disc_flag = 1 AND t2.wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the total absolute quantity moved for OUT movements that occurred on or after '2025-10-02', ordered by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_out_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-02 00:00:00' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_out_qty DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Find products whose total ordered quantity across all order lines is strictly greater than the average total ordered quantity across all SKUs. Show the SKU and total quantity, ordered by total quantity descending.
items.sql: WITH sku_totals AS (SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS tot_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, tot_qty FROM sku_totals WHERE tot_qty > (SELECT AVG(tot_qty) FROM sku_totals) ORDER BY tot_qty DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Identify warehouses where the total on-hand inventory across all products exceeds the average total on-hand inventory of all warehouses. Show warehouse ID and total stock, ordered by total stock descending.
items.sql: WITH wh_totals AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS tot_stock FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, tot_stock FROM wh_totals WHERE tot_stock > (SELECT AVG(tot_stock) FROM wh_totals) ORDER BY tot_stock DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: For each supplier, calculate their primary product count versus their non-primary product count. Show supplier ID, primary count, and non-primary count, ordered by supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, SUM(CASE WHEN is_primary = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS primary_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_primary = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_primary_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC;

items.question: Find SKUs that have both IN and OUT movement types recorded in the inventory movements table. Show the SKU, ordered alphabetically.
items.sql: SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type IN ('IN', 'OUT') GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: For each product category, find the SKU with the maximum list price. Show category code, SKU, and list price, ordered by category code.
items.sql: SELECT t1.categ_cd, t1.sku, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE t1.list_prc = (SELECT MAX(t2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS t2 WHERE t2.categ_cd = t1.categ_cd) ORDER BY t1.categ_cd ASC, t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Calculate the percentage contribution of each warehouse's total inventory to the entire company's inventory sum. Show the warehouse ID, total stock, and percentage (rounded or as decimal), ordered by percentage descending.
items.sql: WITH wh_sum AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS stock FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(on_hand_qty) AS tot FROM inventory) SELECT t.wh_id, t.stock, (t.stock * 100.0 / ts.tot) AS pct FROM wh_sum AS t CROSS JOIN total_sum AS ts ORDER BY pct DESC, t.wh_id ASC;

items.question: Find suppliers whose average lead days across their supplied products is greater than the overall average lead days of all supplier-product rows. Show supplier ID and average lead days, ordered by average lead days descending.
items.sql: WITH sup_avg AS (SELECT sup_id, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id) SELECT sup_id, avg_lead FROM sup_avg WHERE avg_lead > (SELECT AVG(lead_days) FROM prod_supplier) ORDER BY avg_lead DESC, sup_id ASC;

items.question: For each product, determine its primary supplier name and secondary (non-primary) supplier name if any exist. Show SKU, primary supplier name, and secondary supplier name, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, s1.sup_nm AS primary_sup, s2.sup_nm AS secondary_sup FROM prod_catalog AS p LEFT JOIN prod_supplier AS ps1 ON p.sku = ps1.sku AND ps1.is_primary = 1 LEFT JOIN supplier AS s1 ON ps1.sup_id = s1.sup_id LEFT JOIN prod_supplier AS ps2 ON p.sku = ps2.sku AND ps2.is_primary = 0 LEFT JOIN supplier AS s2 ON ps2.sup_id = s2.sup_id ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the product SKU and list price for all items in the electronics category (ELC).
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC'

items.question: List the warehouse ID and warehouse name for all facilities located in North America (NA).
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA'

items.question: Give me the SKU and on hand quantity for products where the stock is currently at or below the reorder point in warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt

items.question: Show the supplier ID and supplier name for all suppliers based in the US.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US'

items.question: List the SKU and product name for all discontinued items in the catalog.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1

items.question: What is the movement ID and movement type for stock movements of type ADJ in warehouse W2?
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_type FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND mv_type = 'ADJ'

items.question: Show the SKU and lead days for supplier records where lead days exceed 30.
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days > 30

items.question: List the SKU and list price for products in the kitchen category (KIT) priced above 50.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND list_prc > 50.00

items.question: Find the SKUs that are supplied by supplier 1 as their primary supplier.
items.sql: SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 1 AND is_primary = 1

items.question: Get the SKU and product name for items that have had stock movement type ADJ recorded in warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM inv_move AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' AND T1.mv_type = 'ADJ'

items.question: List the supplier name and country for suppliers who provide product ELC-024.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, T1.country FROM supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T2.sku = 'ELC-024'

items.question: Show the warehouse name and on hand quantity for product ELC-025 across all warehouses where stock is held.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, T2.on_hand_qty FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T2.sku = 'ELC-025'

items.question: Find the SKU and product name for all items that are categorized as ELC and are not discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0

items.question: List the movement ID and quantity moved for outbound shipments (OUT) that occurred in warehouse W3 during October 2025.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W3' AND mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59'

items.question: Show the SKU and list price for products that have a lead time greater than 20 days from any supplier.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.lead_days > 20

items.question: Find the warehouse ID and warehouse name for warehouses that currently hold product ELC-026 in inventory.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T2.sku = 'ELC-026'

items.question: List SKUs that are supplied by both supplier 1 and supplier 2, showing the SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 1 INTERSECT SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 2

items.question: Find all products (SKU and product name) that are listed in the inventory of warehouse W1 but have never had an inbound stock movement (IN) recorded.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' AND T1.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND mv_type = 'IN')

items.question: Get the SKU and product name for items that appear in order lines with a unit price above 100 or have an inventory on hand quantity exceeding 500, ordered alphabetically by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_line AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.unit_prc > 100.00 UNION SELECT DISTINCT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.on_hand_qty > 500 ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Find the SKU for products that have a primary supplier assignment (is_primary = 1) but do not have any inventory recorded in warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1 EXCEPT SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1'

items.question: List the SKU and product name for items that have been ordered in ord_line with a quantity greater than 3, excluding any items that belong to the office category (OFC).
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_line AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.qty > 3 EXCEPT SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'OFC'

items.question: Find the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers who provide products in category ELC but do not supply any products in category KIT.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm FROM supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T2.sku = T3.sku WHERE T3.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND T1.sup_id NOT IN (SELECT T4.sup_id FROM prod_supplier AS T4 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T5 ON T4.sku = T5.sku WHERE T5.categ_cd = 'KIT')

items.question: Show the SKU and average unit price for order lines of products that are stocked in warehouse W4 and have an inventory reorder point less than 300, ordered by average unit price descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, AVG(T1.unit_prc) AS avg_price FROM ord_line AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.wh_id = 'W4' AND T2.reorder_pt < 300 GROUP BY T1.sku ORDER BY avg_price DESC, T1.sku ASC

items.question: List the warehouse ID and the total count of inventory items held where the on hand quantity is strictly greater than the reorder point, considering only warehouses in the NA or EU regions.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory AS T1 INNER JOIN warehouse AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T1.on_hand_qty > T1.reorder_pt AND T2.region_cd IN ('NA', 'EU') GROUP BY T1.wh_id ORDER BY cnt DESC, T1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Which warehouses are located in the North America region? Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: List all active products in the electronics category. Return the SKU and product name, sorted alphabetically by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: What are the names and countries of all suppliers located in the United States? Sort by supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_id ASC;

items.question: Show the product SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity for any inventory items where the stock is currently at or below the reorder point. Order by SKU then warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Find all stock movements that were recorded as adjustment types on 2025-10-04. Return the movement ID, SKU, and quantity, sorted by movement ID.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND DATE(mv_ts) = '2025-10-04' ORDER BY mv_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU, supplier ID, and lead days for all supplier product records where the lead days are 30 or more. Sort by SKU then supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT sku, sup_id, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days >= 30 ORDER BY sku ASC, sup_id ASC;

items.question: For products in the home category, list their SKU, product name, and list price, ordered from highest price to lowest.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the movement ID, warehouse ID, and movement timestamp for all outbound stock movements related to order 'O-5024'. Sort by movement ID.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, wh_id, mv_ts FROM inv_move WHERE ord_id = 'O-5024' AND mv_type = 'OUT' ORDER BY mv_id ASC;

items.question: Which products have a list price greater than 75.00 USD? Return the SKU and list price, ordered by list price ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 75.00 ORDER BY list_prc ASC, sku ASC;

items.question: Find the primary suppliers for each product. Return the SKU and supplier ID, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, sup_id FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1 ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and region code for warehouses that hold inventory for SKU 'ELC-024'. Order by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm, t1.region_cd FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.sku = 'ELC-024' ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products that are supplied by supplier ID 1. Order by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.sup_id = 1 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Find the total on-hand inventory quantity across all warehouses for each product SKU. Return the SKU and total quantity, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: List the supplier name and the count of products they supply for each supplier. Return supplier name and count, sorted by supplier name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) AS prod_count FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY t1.sup_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products that have never had any stock movements recorded. Order by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move WHERE inv_move.sku = prod_catalog.sku) ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: List all order lines where the unit price is higher than the average unit price of all order lines for the exact same SKU. Return the order ID, line number, and unit price, sorted by order ID then line number.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.line_no, t1.unit_prc FROM ord_line AS t1 WHERE t1.unit_prc > (SELECT AVG(t2.unit_prc) FROM ord_line AS t2 WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku) ORDER BY t1.ord_id ASC, t1.line_no ASC;

items.question: Identify products whose list price is strictly greater than the average list price of all products within their respective category. Return the SKU, category code, and list price, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.categ_cd, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE t1.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(t2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS t2 WHERE t2.categ_cd = t1.categ_cd) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Find inventory records where the on-hand quantity is greater than the average on-hand quantity of all inventory records in the same warehouse. Return the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity, sorted by SKU then warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.wh_id, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 WHERE t1.on_hand_qty > (SELECT AVG(t2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory AS t2 WHERE t2.wh_id = t1.wh_id) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC, t1.wh_id ASC;

items.question: Find suppliers who provide products with lead days higher than the average lead day across all product supply relationships for that same supplier. Return the supplier ID and SKU, sorted by supplier ID then SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_id, t1.sku FROM prod_supplier AS t1 WHERE t1.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(t2.lead_days) FROM prod_supplier AS t2 WHERE t2.sup_id = t1.sup_id) ORDER BY t1.sup_id ASC, t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Which SKUs have an on-hand quantity in every single warehouse? Return the SKU, sorted alphabetically.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku FROM inventory AS t1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM warehouse AS t2 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory AS t3 WHERE t3.sku = t1.sku AND t3.wh_id = t2.wh_id)) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Find products that are supplied by every supplier from country 'US'. Return the SKU, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku FROM prod_supplier AS t1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM supplier AS t2 WHERE t2.country = 'US' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_supplier AS t3 WHERE t3.sku = t1.sku AND t3.sup_id = t2.sup_id)) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and product name for items that have an inventory record in warehouse 'W1' but do not have an inventory record in warehouse 'W2'. Order by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.wh_id = 'W1' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory AS t3 WHERE t3.sku = t1.sku AND t3.wh_id = 'W2') ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Find the most recent stock movement (by timestamp) for each SKU in warehouse 'W1'. Return the movement ID, SKU, and movement timestamp, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT t1.mv_id, t1.sku, t1.mv_ts FROM inv_move AS t1 WHERE t1.wh_id = 'W1' AND t1.mv_ts = (SELECT MAX(t2.mv_ts) FROM inv_move AS t2 WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku AND t2.wh_id = t1.wh_id) ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Find order lines where the ordered quantity is strictly greater than the maximum quantity ever moved in a single inventory movement for that SKU. Return the order ID, line number, SKU, and quantity, sorted by order ID then line number.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.line_no, t1.sku, t1.qty FROM ord_line AS t1 WHERE t1.qty > (SELECT MAX(ABS(t2.qty)) FROM inv_move AS t2 WHERE t2.sku = t1.sku) ORDER BY t1.ord_id ASC, t1.line_no ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and the number of distinct warehouses where it currently has stock on hand greater than zero.
items.sql: SELECT sku, COUNT(DISTINCT wh_id) AS wh_count FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty > 0 GROUP BY sku ORDER BY wh_count DESC, sku ASC

items.question: For each warehouse ID, give the total on-hand quantity and the total reorder point across all its inventory items.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand, SUM(reorder_pt) AS total_reorder_pt FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the product category code, the total count of products, and the count of discontinued products for that category.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_count, SUM(disc_flag) AS disc_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC

items.question: List each supplier ID and the count of products they supply, along with how many of those assignments have a lead time of 30 days or fewer.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, COUNT(*) AS total_products, SUM(CASE WHEN lead_days <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fast_lead_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: For every warehouse ID, show the total number of stock movement records and the count of movements that were restocks (IN).
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS total_movements, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_movement_count FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and the sum of units moved in, plus the sum of absolute units moved out, for movements occurring since 2025-10-01.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'IN' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS total_in_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'OUT' THEN -qty ELSE 0 END) AS total_out_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: For each product category code, display the average list price, the minimum list price, and the maximum list price of products that are not discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_price, MIN(list_prc) AS min_price, MAX(list_prc) AS max_price FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 0 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC

items.question: List each region code of warehouses and show the total on-hand quantity and total reorder point for inventory located in warehouses within that region.
items.sql: SELECT w.region_cd, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand, SUM(i.reorder_pt) AS total_reorder_pt FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id GROUP BY w.region_cd ORDER BY w.region_cd ASC

items.question: For each supplier ID, show the total count of products they supply and the number of products where they are designated as the primary supplier.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, COUNT(*) AS total_supplied, SUM(is_primary) AS primary_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and the count of order lines containing it, as well as the count of order lines for that SKU where the discount percentage was greater than zero.
items.sql: SELECT sku, COUNT(*) AS total_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN disc_pct > 0.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discounted_lines FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: For each supplier ID, give the average lead time in days and the maximum lead time recorded for their supplied items.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead_days, MAX(lead_days) AS max_lead_days FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the total inventory quantity on hand for items whose on-hand quantity is less than their reorder point, alongside the total on-hand quantity for items at or above their reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty < reorder_pt THEN on_hand_qty ELSE 0 END) AS below_reorder_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty >= reorder_pt THEN on_hand_qty ELSE 0 END) AS safe_reorder_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: For each SKU in the inventory, calculate the percentage of warehouses holding stock that currently have on-hand quantities strictly below their reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT sku, (SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty < reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS below_reorder_pct FROM inventory GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: List every warehouse ID and the count of distinct SKUs that have experienced at least one stock movement of type 'OUT' since 2025-10-01.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS distinct_skus_out FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: For each product category code, show the total list price of all products and the total list price of only those products that are discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, SUM(list_prc) AS total_list_prc, SUM(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 1 THEN list_prc ELSE 0 END) AS discontinued_list_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and side-by-side counts of order lines ordered in quantities of 2 or less versus order lines ordered in quantities greater than 2.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(CASE WHEN qty <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS small_qty_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN qty > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS large_qty_lines FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: For each supplier ID, provide the count of products supplied with lead times under 20 days, between 20 and 35 days inclusive, and strictly over 35 days.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, SUM(CASE WHEN lead_days < 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lead_under_20, SUM(CASE WHEN lead_days BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lead_20_to_35, SUM(CASE WHEN lead_days > 35 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lead_over_35 FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: For each warehouse ID, output the total units added via 'IN' movements and the total units removed via 'OUT' movements for all recorded stock history.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'IN' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS total_in_units, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'OUT' THEN -qty ELSE 0 END) AS total_out_units FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, the total order line revenue (calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price), and the total discount amount given (calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price multiplied by discount percentage divided by 100).
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty * unit_prc) AS total_revenue, SUM(qty * unit_prc * (disc_pct / 100.0)) AS total_discount_amt FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: For each supplier country, calculate the total number of suppliers and the count of primary supplier associations across all products provided by suppliers from that country.
items.sql: SELECT s.country, COUNT(DISTINCT s.sup_id) AS supplier_count, SUM(ps.is_primary) AS primary_association_count FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.country ORDER BY s.country ASC

items.question: List every warehouse ID along with the count of SKUs that have on-hand inventory below their reorder point and the count of SKUs that are safely at or above their reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty < reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS items_below_reorder, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty >= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS items_safe FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: For each product category code, display the total number of order lines, the sum of quantities ordered, and the average unit price across those lines.
items.sql: SELECT p.categ_cd, COUNT(o.sku) AS total_order_lines, SUM(o.qty) AS total_qty_ordered, AVG(o.unit_prc) AS avg_unit_prc FROM ord_line o JOIN prod_catalog p ON o.sku = p.sku GROUP BY p.categ_cd ORDER BY p.categ_cd ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, the maximum unit price, the minimum unit price, and the overall average unit price observed across order lines for each product.
items.sql: SELECT sku, MAX(unit_prc) AS max_unit_prc, MIN(unit_prc) AS min_unit_prc, AVG(unit_prc) AS avg_unit_prc FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: For each warehouse name, compute the total inventory on-hand quantity, the total reorder point sum, and the ratio of total on-hand quantity to total reorder point expressed as a percentage.
items.sql: SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand, SUM(i.reorder_pt) AS total_reorder_pt, (SUM(i.on_hand_qty) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(i.reorder_pt), 0) AS stock_to_reorder_ratio FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY w.wh_nm ASC

items.question: An active supplier is one that provides at least one product. Show the supplier ID and supplier name for all active suppliers, ordered by supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id ORDER BY t1.sup_id ASC

items.question: A primary supplier is one where the prod_supplier record has is_primary set to 1. Show the product SKU and supplier ID for all primary supplier relationships.
items.sql: SELECT sku, sup_id FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1

items.question: A bulky warehouse is one located in the North America region (code NA). Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name for all bulky warehouses.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA'

items.question: A stock adjustment movement is an inventory movement where the movement type code is ADJ. Show the movement ID, SKU, and quantity for all stock adjustments.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, SKU, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ'

items.question: A discontinued product is one where the disc_flag is set to 1. Show the product SKU and product name for all discontinued items.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1

items.question: A high lead time is when the lead days exceed 30. Show the SKU and supplier ID for all supplier relationships with a high lead time.
items.sql: SELECT sku, sup_id FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days > 30

items.question: A low stock item is one where the current on hand quantity is strictly less than the reorder point. Show the SKU and warehouse ID for all low stock items in inventory.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty < reorder_pt

items.question: An electronics item is any product in the electronics category code ELC. Show the product SKU and list price for all electronics items, ordered by list price descending with SKU ascending as tie breaker.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: A slow delivery supplier is one who supplies a product with a lead time greater than 30 days. Show the supplier name and product SKU for all slow delivery supplier records, sorted by supplier name ascending and then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, t2.sku FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t2.lead_days > 30 ORDER BY t1.sup_nm ASC, t2.sku ASC

items.question: A regional warehouse list shows the warehouse name alongside the count of inventory rows held there. Show the warehouse name and the count of inventory rows, sorted by the count descending with warehouse name ascending as tie breaker.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t2.sku) DESC, t1.wh_nm ASC

items.question: An active supplier count per country tallies suppliers in countries outside the US. Show the country code and the number of suppliers for each country where the country code is not 'US', ordered by the supplier count descending.
items.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(sup_id) FROM supplier WHERE country <> 'US' GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(sup_id) DESC

items.question: A heavily stocked item is one where total on hand quantity across all warehouses exceeds 1500 units. Show the product SKU and total on hand quantity for such items, ordered by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(on_hand_qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(on_hand_qty) > 1500 ORDER BY SUM(on_hand_qty) DESC

items.question: An inbound stock movement is one where movement type is IN. Show the movement ID, movement timestamp, and quantity for all inbound stock movements that occurred in October 2025 (between '2025-10-01 00:00:00' and '2025-10-31 23:59:59'), ordered by movement timestamp ascending.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts BETWEEN '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-10-31 23:59:59' ORDER BY mv_ts ASC

items.question: A primary supplier catalog entry links the product name with its primary supplier's name. Show the product name and supplier name for all products where is_primary is 1, ordered by product name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.prod_nm, t3.sup_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN supplier AS t3 ON t2.sup_id = t3.sup_id WHERE t2.is_primary = 1 ORDER BY t1.prod_nm ASC

items.question: A high value order line is one where the line total (quantity multiplied by unit price) exceeds 1000 USD. Show the order ID, line number, and computed line total for all such order lines, ordered by line total descending with order ID ascending as tie breaker.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, (qty * unit_prc) AS line_total FROM ord_line WHERE (qty * unit_prc) > 1000 ORDER BY line_total DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A multi-supplier product is one that has more than one supplier offering it. Show the product SKU and the count of suppliers for all such products, ordered by supplier count descending with SKU ascending as tie breaker.
items.sql: SELECT sku, COUNT(sup_id) FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(sup_id) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(sup_id) DESC, sku ASC

items.question: A critical inventory deficit is when a product's total on hand quantity across all warehouses is less than the sum of its reorder points across those same warehouses. Show the product SKU, total on hand quantity, and total reorder point for all such products, ordered by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(on_hand_qty), SUM(reorder_pt) FROM inventory GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(on_hand_qty) < SUM(reorder_pt) ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: A sole-sourced product is one that is provided by exactly one supplier. Show the product name and supplier name for all sole-sourced products, ordered by product name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.prod_nm, t3.sup_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN supplier AS t3 ON t2.sup_id = t3.sup_id WHERE t1.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(sup_id) = 1) ORDER BY t1.prod_nm ASC

items.question: An active warehouse stock summary lists the warehouse name, product category code, and total units on hand for inventory items located in warehouses within the European region (code EU). Show the warehouse name, category code, and total on hand quantity, ordered by warehouse name ascending and category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_nm, t2.categ_cd, SUM(t3.on_hand_qty) FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t3 ON t1.wh_id = t3.wh_id JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t3.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.region_cd = 'EU' GROUP BY t1.wh_nm, t2.categ_cd ORDER BY t1.wh_nm ASC, t2.categ_cd ASC

items.question: A top supplier by catalog items is a supplier that provides more than 3 products. Show the supplier name and the count of products they provide, ordered by product count descending with supplier name ascending as tie breaker.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(t2.sku) > 3 ORDER BY COUNT(t2.sku) DESC, t1.sup_nm ASC

items.question: An inventory movement discrepancy product is one that has had an outbound stock movement (movement type OUT) due to an order where the movement quantity is greater than 10 units in absolute magnitude. Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and movement quantity for all such outbound movements, ordered by movement quantity ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND qty < -10 ORDER BY qty ASC

items.question: A primary supplier lead time summary averages the lead days across primary supplier relationships for each product category. Show the category code and average lead days, ordered by average lead days descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.categ_cd, AVG(t2.lead_days) FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY t1.categ_cd ORDER BY AVG(t2.lead_days) DESC

items.question: An unassigned inventory item is a product present in the product catalog that has no corresponding record in the inventory table. Show the product SKU and product name for all such items, ordered by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM inventory) ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: A high risk procurement item is a discontinued product that still has an on hand inventory greater than 0 units in any warehouse. Show the warehouse ID, product SKU, and on hand quantity for these items, ordered by warehouse ID ascending and SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.sku, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.disc_flag = 1 AND t1.on_hand_qty > 0 ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the employee ID and full name for everyone in the finance department code 'FIN'.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'FIN'

items.question: List the employee ID and full name of Amara Singh's direct manager.
items.sql: SELECT m.emp_id, m.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.emp_nm = 'Amara Singh'

items.question: Display the employee ID and full name for all staff who report directly to employee ID 'E-001'.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001'

items.question: List the employee ID, full name, and department code for all direct reports of Chloe Whitaker.
items.sql: SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.dept_cd FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE m.emp_nm = 'Chloe Whitaker'

items.question: Find the employee ID and full name of the top-level manager who has no direct manager assigned.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL

items.question: Count how many direct reports each manager has, showing the manager employee ID and the count of direct reports, ordered by the count descending then manager employee ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT mgr_emp_id AS manager_emp_id, COUNT(*) AS direct_report_count FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mgr_emp_id ORDER BY direct_report_count DESC, manager_emp_id ASC

items.question: Using the recursive employee chain of command, find the employee ID, full name, and reporting depth starting from top-level managers downward for all employees.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE emp_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 1 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, et.depth + 1 FROM emp e JOIN emp_tree et ON e.mgr_emp_id = et.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, depth FROM emp_tree ORDER BY depth, emp_id

items.question: For employee ID 'E-003', use a recursive CTE to list all employees who report to them at any level, showing their employee ID, full name, and distance from 'E-003'.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE reports_down AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, 1 AS level FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-003' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, r.level + 1 FROM emp e JOIN reports_down r ON e.mgr_emp_id = r.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, level FROM reports_down ORDER BY level, emp_id

items.question: Find the complete management chain upwards for employee ID 'E-007', listing each ancestor's employee ID, full name, and level up.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE chain_up AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 1 AS level FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-007' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, c.level + 1 FROM emp e JOIN chain_up c ON e.emp_id = c.mgr_emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, level FROM chain_up ORDER BY level

items.question: Show the department code and the total number of employees in each department, ordered by the employee count descending then department code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) AS emp_count FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd ORDER BY emp_count DESC, dept_cd ASC

items.question: List the employee ID and full name of employees who belong to the management department code 'MGT' and have someone reporting directly to them.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp r ON r.mgr_emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE e.dept_cd = 'MGT'

items.question: Show the employee ID and full name of employees who were hired in the year 2019 and work in the engineering department code 'ENG'.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'ENG' AND hire_dt >= '2019-01-01' AND hire_dt <= '2019-12-31'

items.question: Find the employee ID and full name of employees who have no direct reports and are not in the executive management department code 'MGT'.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd <> 'MGT' AND emp_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL)

items.question: List each department code and the earliest hire date within that department, ordered by the earliest hire date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, MIN(hire_dt) AS earliest_hire_dt FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd ORDER BY earliest_hire_dt ASC

items.question: Using recursive employee hierarchy, count the total number of descendants (both direct and indirect) for top-level manager employee ID 'E-001'.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE all_subordinates AS (SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e JOIN all_subordinates s ON e.mgr_emp_id = s.emp_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_descendants FROM all_subordinates

items.question: Display the employee ID and full name of managers whose direct reports span across more than one distinct department code.
items.sql: SELECT m.emp_id, m.emp_nm FROM emp m JOIN emp r ON r.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id GROUP BY m.emp_id, m.emp_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.dept_cd) > 1

items.question: List the employee ID and full name of employees who share the exact same direct manager as employee ID 'E-004', excluding 'E-004' itself.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = (SELECT mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-004') AND emp_id <> 'E-004'

items.question: Find the maximum reporting depth (maximum chain length from top to bottom) present in the entire company employee table.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE emp_depth AS (SELECT emp_id, 1 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, ed.depth + 1 FROM emp e JOIN emp_depth ed ON e.mgr_emp_id = ed.emp_id) SELECT MAX(depth) AS max_depth FROM emp_depth

items.question: Show the employee ID and full name for employees whose direct manager is also in the engineering department code 'ENG'.
items.sql: SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE m.dept_cd = 'ENG'

items.question: List the department code and count of managers (employees who have at least one direct report) per department, ordered by manager count descending.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT m.emp_id) AS manager_count FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON m.mgr_emp_id = e.emp_id GROUP BY e.dept_cd ORDER BY manager_count DESC

items.question: Display the employee ID and full name of staff members who were hired earlier than their direct manager.
items.sql: SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.hire_dt < m.hire_dt

items.question: Find the employee ID, full name, and department code of employees who have no manager above them and were hired on or after '2018-01-01'.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, dept_cd FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL AND hire_dt >= '2018-01-01'

items.question: Using recursion, list every employee ID and their distance (number of reporting steps) from the root manager, restricted to employees in department code 'FIN'.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE emp_path AS (SELECT emp_id, dept_cd, 0 AS steps FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.dept_cd, ep.steps + 1 FROM emp e JOIN emp_path ep ON e.mgr_emp_id = ep.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, steps FROM emp_path WHERE dept_cd = 'FIN' ORDER BY steps, emp_id

items.question: Show the employee ID and full name of employees who manage someone who in turn manages at least one other employee (i.e. managers at least two levels deep from the top).
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m1.emp_id, m1.emp_nm FROM emp m1 JOIN emp m2 ON m2.mgr_emp_id = m1.emp_id JOIN emp r ON r.mgr_emp_id = m2.emp_id

items.question: Show the product name and list price for items in the kitchen category.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT';

items.question: List the supplier name and country for suppliers located in the US.
items.sql: SELECT sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US';

items.question: Give me the stock keeping unit and current on hand quantity for products stored in the Newark Hub warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub';

items.question: Retrieve the movement id and movement type for stock movements of type restock.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_type FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN';

items.question: Show the warehouse name and region code for warehouses in the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA';

items.question: Display the product name and list price for discontinued items.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1;

items.question: List the stock keeping unit and lead days for items where the supplier relationship is the primary one.
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1;

items.question: Show the order id and unit price for order lines that belong to orders placed through the web channel.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.unit_prc FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'WEB';

items.question: Find the product name and list price for products in the electronics category that have a list price greater than 50.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 50.00;

items.question: Show the supplier name and lead days for products provided by suppliers in Canada.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, t2.lead_days FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t1.country = 'CA';

items.question: List the warehouse name and the total on hand inventory quantity across all products stored in each warehouse, sorted by the total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.wh_nm, SUM(t1.on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t2.wh_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC, t2.wh_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the product name and the count of suppliers that provide each product, for products with more than one supplier, ordered by supplier count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.prod_nm, COUNT(t1.sup_id) AS sup_count FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t2.sku, t2.prod_nm HAVING COUNT(t1.sup_id) > 1 ORDER BY sup_count DESC, t2.prod_nm ASC;

items.question: Display the stock keeping unit and current on hand quantity for products where the stock has fallen to or below the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt;

items.question: List the supplier name and product name for primary supplier links associated with products in the home category.
items.sql: SELECT t3.sup_nm, t1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN supplier AS t3 ON t2.sup_id = t3.sup_id WHERE t1.categ_cd = 'HOM' AND t2.is_primary = 1;

items.question: Show the order id and the total units ordered for orders containing items from the electronics category.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, SUM(t1.qty) AS total_units FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.categ_cd = 'ELC' GROUP BY t1.ord_id;

items.question: Find the product name and movement quantity for stock movements of type customer shipment that occurred in October 2025.
items.sql: SELECT t2.prod_nm, t1.qty FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.mv_type = 'OUT' AND t1.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND t1.mv_ts < '2025-11-01 00:00:00';

items.question: For each product category, show the category code, the average list price, and the total number of products, sorted by the average list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS prod_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY avg_price DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the supplier name and average lead days for each supplier across all products they provide, restricted to suppliers whose average lead days exceed 25, ordered by the average lead days descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, AVG(t2.lead_days) AS avg_lead FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm HAVING AVG(t2.lead_days) > 25.0 ORDER BY avg_lead DESC, t1.sup_nm ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse name, product name, and current on hand quantity for products whose on hand quantity is strictly less than the warehouse average for all products, sorted by warehouse name and quantity.
items.sql: SELECT t3.wh_nm, t2.prod_nm, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN warehouse AS t3 ON t1.wh_id = t3.wh_id WHERE t1.on_hand_qty < (SELECT AVG(t4.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory AS t4 WHERE t4.wh_id = t1.wh_id) ORDER BY t3.wh_nm ASC, t1.on_hand_qty ASC, t2.prod_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the product name, supplier name, and lead days for products where the lead days match the maximum lead days recorded for that product across any supplier.
items.sql: SELECT t2.prod_nm, t3.sup_nm, t1.lead_days FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN supplier AS t3 ON t1.sup_id = t3.sup_id WHERE t1.lead_days = (SELECT MAX(t4.lead_days) FROM prod_supplier AS t4 WHERE t4.sku = t1.sku);

items.question: Find the stock keeping unit and product name for products that have never experienced a stock movement of type stock count correction.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ');

items.question: For each sales region, show the warehouse name and the total inventory on hand quantity held in that region, for warehouses located in regions starting with an evaluation of regions having total inventory over 1000 units.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, t1.wh_nm, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) AS region_inv FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.region_cd, t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm HAVING SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) > 1000 ORDER BY region_inv DESC, t1.wh_nm ASC;

items.question: List the order id, product name, and line total amount calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price for order lines belonging to orders placed through the application channel, ordered by the line total descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t2.prod_nm, (t1.qty * t1.unit_prc) AS line_total FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY line_total DESC, t1.ord_id ASC, t2.prod_nm ASC;

items.question: Identify the supplier name, product name, and lead days for products supplied by the supplier with the overall longest lead time in the database.
items.sql: SELECT t3.sup_nm, t2.prod_nm, t1.lead_days FROM prod_supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN supplier AS t3 ON t1.sup_id = t3.sup_id WHERE t1.lead_days = (SELECT MAX(lead_days) FROM prod_supplier);

items.question: Which supplier had the highest delivery delay penalty fees assessed last quarter?

items.question: List all active customers (where the inactive soft-delete flag is zero, meaning active) in the EU sales region, returning their customer id and customer name, ordered alphabetically by customer name with customer id as a tie-breaker.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'EU' ORDER BY cust_nm ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Pull all orders placed through the web channel (WEB) that have an order status of shipped (S) during November 2025 (from 2025-11-01 through 2025-11-30). Return the order id, order date, and order total amount, sorted by order date descending and order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_status = 'S' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Find all products in the electronics category (ELC) that are currently discontinued (disc_flag = 1). Return their SKU and product name, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Retrieve all customer records who signed up between 2022-07-01 and 2022-07-31 in the NA region and who are active (is_actv = 1). Show customer id, signup date, and customer name, ordered by signup date ascending, then customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-07-01' AND '2022-07-31' AND region_cd = 'NA' AND is_actv = 1 ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Show all order lines for order O-5001, displaying the line number, SKU, quantity ordered, and unit price, sorted by line number ascending.
items.sql: SELECT line_no, sku, qty, unit_prc FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001' ORDER BY line_no ASC

items.question: List all exchange rates for the USD currency effective on or after 2026-01-01. Return the effective date and the rate to USD, sorted by effective date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT eff_dt, rate_to_usd FROM fx_rate WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND eff_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY eff_dt ASC

items.question: Identify all top-level managers in the employee table by checking where the direct manager ID is null. Return their employee ID, full name, and hire date, sorted by hire date ascending with employee ID as the tie-breaker.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, hire_dt FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL ORDER BY hire_dt ASC, emp_id ASC

items.question: List all support tickets that are still open, meaning their closed timestamp is NULL. Return the ticket ID, customer ID, opened timestamp, and severity level, ordered by severity level ascending then opened timestamp ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts, sev_lvl FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NULL ORDER BY sev_lvl ASC, opened_ts ASC

items.question: Find all inventory items where the on-hand quantity is less than or equal to the reorder point. Return the SKU, warehouse ID, on-hand quantity, and reorder point, sorted by on-hand quantity ascending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY on_hand_qty ASC, sku ASC

items.question: Retrieve all customer master records for customers in the platinum loyalty tier (P) who are currently inactive (is_actv = 0). Return the customer ID, customer name, signup date, and sales region code, ordered by signup date descending, then customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt, region_cd FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND is_actv = 0 ORDER BY signup_dt DESC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Pull all payment attempts that resulted in a failure status (F) with an amount greater than 100.00 in USD currency. Return the payment attempt ID, order ID, payment amount, and paid timestamp, sorted by paid timestamp descending, then payment ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt, paid_ts FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'F' AND pay_amt > 100.00 AND currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY paid_ts DESC, pay_id ASC

items.question: Identify all policy rules that are currently still in force, meaning their effective 'to' date is NULL. Return the rule row ID, rule key, rule value, and effective from date, ordered by rule key ascending, then effective from date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT rule_id, rule_key, rule_val, eff_from FROM policy_rule WHERE eff_to IS NULL ORDER BY rule_key ASC, eff_from ASC

items.question: Get all products from the kitchen category (KIT) with a list price between 50.00 and 150.00 USD that are not discontinued (disc_flag = 0). Return the SKU, product name, and list price, sorted by list price descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND list_prc BETWEEN 50.00 AND 150.00 AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Find all shipments that have been handed to the carrier but have not yet been delivered (where delivery date is NULL). Return the shipment ID, order ID, warehouse ID, carrier code, and ship date, ordered by ship date ascending, then shipment ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, wh_id, carrier_cd, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE deliv_dt IS NULL ORDER BY ship_dt ASC, ship_id ASC

items.question: List all refund requests that are in a pending status (P) and requested for an amount exceeding 200.00. Return the refund request ID, order ID, request date, and requested amount, sorted by request date ascending, then refund request ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, req_dt, rfd_amt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P' AND rfd_amt > 200.00 ORDER BY req_dt ASC, rfd_id ASC

items.question: Retrieve all inventory stock movements of type adjustment (ADJ) that occurred in warehouse W1. Return the movement ID, SKU, movement timestamp, quantity moved, and order ID, sorted by movement timestamp descending, then movement ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, mv_ts, qty, ord_id FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY mv_ts DESC, mv_id ASC

items.question: Show all support ticket events of type escalation (ESCAL). Return the event ID, ticket ID, event timestamp, and actor employee ID, sorted by event timestamp descending, then event ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, tkt_id, evt_ts, actor_emp_id FROM tkt_event WHERE evt_type = 'ESCAL' ORDER BY evt_ts DESC, evt_id ASC

items.question: Find all web clickstream events where the customer identifier is not provided (NULL) and the event type is a product view (VIEW) on the mobile app channel (APP). Return the event ID, session ID, event timestamp, and SKU, sorted by event timestamp descending, then event ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, session_id, evt_ts, sku FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NULL AND evt_type = 'VIEW' AND channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY evt_ts DESC, evt_id ASC

items.question: Show the sales region and the total number of customers in each region.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(cust_id) FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY COUNT(cust_id) DESC, region_cd ASC;

items.question: List each order status code and how many orders are currently in that status.

items.question: What is the average list price for products in each category code? Show the category code and average price.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY AVG(list_prc) DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the currency code and the maximum order total amount seen for each currency.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, MAX(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY MAX(ord_total_amt) DESC, currency_cd ASC;

items.question: For each sales channel code, calculate the total revenue generated from all orders.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY SUM(ord_total_amt) DESC, channel_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the minimum order total amount for each customer who has placed orders.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, MIN(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY MIN(ord_total_amt) ASC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the loyalty tier code and the count of active customers in each tier, filtered for active customers only.

items.question: Find the product category codes that have an average list price strictly greater than 70 USD. Show category and average price.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd HAVING AVG(list_prc) > 70.00 ORDER BY AVG(list_prc) DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: For orders placed in 2026, show each sales channel code and the total order amount sum.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY SUM(ord_total_amt) DESC, channel_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the top 3 SKUs by total quantity ordered across all order lines, including SKU and total quantity.

items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) DESC, channel_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the average unit price for each product SKU on order lines where no discount was applied (disc_pct = 0). Show SKU and average unit price.
items.sql: SELECT sku, AVG(unit_prc) FROM ord_line WHERE disc_pct = 0.00 GROUP BY sku ORDER BY AVG(unit_prc) DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the customer ID and total order value for customers whose total order value exceeds 500, ordered from highest to lowest.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING SUM(ord_total_amt) > 500.00 ORDER BY SUM(ord_total_amt) DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: For each customer tier, count how many distinct customers signed up after 2022-06-01. Show tier code and count.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt > '2022-06-01' GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) DESC, tier_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the product category name and category code, along with the count of products in each category, but only for categories that contain more than 1 product.
items.sql: SELECT t1.code_val, t1.code_desc, COUNT(p.sku) FROM code_lookup t1 JOIN prod_catalog p ON t1.code_val = p.categ_cd WHERE t1.code_type = 'TKT_CATEG' GROUP BY t1.code_val, t1.code_desc HAVING COUNT(p.sku) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(p.sku) DESC, t1.code_val ASC;

items.question: Show the top 5 customers by total order amount for orders placed in the 'NA' sales region. Include customer ID, customer name, and total amount.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY SUM(o.ord_total_amt) DESC, c.cust_id ASC LIMIT 5;

items.question: For each sales region, calculate the average order total amount for delivered orders (status code 'D'). Show region code and average amount.
items.sql: SELECT c.region_cd, AVG(o.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_status = 'D' GROUP BY c.region_cd ORDER BY AVG(o.ord_total_amt) DESC, c.region_cd ASC;

items.question: Identify the top 3 SKUs that have generated the highest total revenue (calculated as quantity times unit price minus line discount) across order lines. Show SKU and total revenue.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty * unit_prc * (1 - disc_pct / 100)) FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY SUM(qty * unit_prc * (1 - disc_pct / 100)) DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 3;

items.question: Show the product name and the total quantity ordered for products that belong to the 'ELC' category.
items.sql: SELECT p.prod_nm, SUM(l.qty) FROM prod_catalog p JOIN ord_line l ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY SUM(l.qty) DESC, p.sku ASC;

items.question: List each order ID and the count of distinct products (SKUs) included in that order, filtered to orders having more than 1 line item.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) FROM ord_line GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(line_no) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT sku) DESC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: Find the maximum list price for products in the product catalog grouped by their discontinued flag status. Show the disc_flag and max price.
items.sql: SELECT disc_flag, MAX(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY disc_flag ORDER BY MAX(list_prc) DESC, disc_flag ASC;

items.question: Show the customer name and the count of orders they placed, restricting to customers who have placed at least 1 order.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_nm, COUNT(o.ord_id) FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY COUNT(o.ord_id) DESC, c.cust_id ASC;

items.question: For each currency, calculate the average exchange rate to USD across all effective dates. Show currency code and average rate.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, AVG(rate_to_usd) FROM fx_rate GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY AVG(rate_to_usd) DESC, currency_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the top 5 order IDs with the highest total amount among orders that used the 'WEB' channel code. Show order ID and order total amount.
