items.sql: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, opened_ts, closed_ts)) FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00' AND closed_ts IS NOT NULL AND closed_ts <= '2026-04-30 23:59:59'

items.question: Find the SKU and product name of active products (disc_flag = 0) in the electronic category ('ELC') whose list price is strictly greater than 75.00 USD, ordered by list price descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 0 AND categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 75.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Show the region code and the total inventory on-hand quantity across all warehouses in that region, for regions where the total on-hand quantity exceeds 1500 units. Order by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.region_cd, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) FROM warehouse AS T1 INNER JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id GROUP BY T1.region_cd HAVING SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) > 1500 ORDER BY SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) DESC

items.question: For orders placed on 2026-04-03, list the order ID, payment amount, and payment status for every payment attempt made within 3 days of the order date (paid_ts between ord_dt and ord_dt + 3 days). Sort by order ID ascending, then payment ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T1.pay_amt, T1.pay_status FROM payment AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T2.ord_dt = '2026-04-03' AND T1.paid_ts >= '2026-04-03 00:00:00' AND T1.paid_ts < TIMESTAMP('2026-04-03', '00:00:00') + INTERVAL 4 DAY ORDER BY T1.ord_id ASC, T1.pay_id ASC

items.question: How many distinct customers placed an order that was shipped via the 'UPS' carrier between 2026-01-01 and 2026-12-31? Return the count.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.cust_id) FROM ord_hdr AS T1 INNER JOIN shipment AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T2.carrier_cd = 'UPS' AND T2.ship_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and list price of products that have had at least one inventory stock movement due to an adjustment ('ADJ') between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31. Sort by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN inv_move AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.mv_type = 'ADJ' AND T2.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND T2.mv_ts < '2025-11-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: What is the total sum of payment amounts for all payment attempts that resulted in a failed status ('F') during November 2025 (2025-11-01 to 2025-11-30)? Return the total.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(pay_amt) FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'F' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00'

items.question: Show the warehouse name and the number of shipments dispatched in Q1 2026 (2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31) that were delivered on or before 2026-04-15. Order by the shipment count descending, then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T2.wh_nm, COUNT(*) FROM shipment AS T1 INNER JOIN warehouse AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T1.ship_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' AND T1.deliv_dt <= '2026-04-15' GROUP BY T2.wh_id, T2.wh_nm ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, T2.wh_id ASC

items.question: Find the customer ID and name of customers who signed up before 2023-01-01 and have placed at least one order with an order total amount greater than 500.00 USD (in USD currency). Sort by customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.signup_dt < '2023-01-01' AND T2.currency_cd = 'USD' AND T2.ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY T1.cust_id ASC

items.question: List the order ID, order date, and channel code for all orders placed on days where the order date falls between 2026-04-01 and 2026-04-30 and the order status is shipped ('S'). Order by order date ascending, then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, channel_cd FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'S' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: For each payment method code, calculate the total settled payment amount (pay_status = 'S') for payments received between 2025-11-01 and 2026-01-31. Show the method code and total amount, ordered by total amount descending, then method code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts < '2026-02-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY SUM(pay_amt) DESC, method_cd ASC

items.question: Show the count of shipments for each month in 2026, ordered chronologically by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: List the total payment amount settled each month during the year 2025, sorted from earliest month to latest.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mth, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_paid FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Give me the number of orders placed in each quarter of 2026, ordered by quarter ascending.
items.sql: SELECT QUARTER(ord_dt) AS qtr, COUNT(*) AS ord_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY QUARTER(ord_dt) ORDER BY qtr ASC;

items.question: Show the weekly count of stock movements of type OUT for the second quarter of 2026, ordered by week starting date.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(mv_ts, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(mv_ts) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS wk_start, COUNT(*) AS out_cnt FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2026-06-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY wk_start ORDER BY wk_start ASC;

items.question: Break down the total order amount by month for the web sales channel in 2026, in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Show the count of shipments made through the DHL carrier per month for the year 2026, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, COUNT(*) AS ship_cnt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' AND ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: List the sum of payment amounts for each quarter of 2025 where the status was settled, ordered by quarter.
items.sql: SELECT QUARTER(paid_ts) AS qtr, SUM(pay_amt) AS settled_sum FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY QUARTER(paid_ts) ORDER BY qtr ASC;

items.question: Show the monthly count of new order headers created in 2025, sorted from January to December.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, COUNT(*) AS ord_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Provide the weekly breakdown of failed payment attempts in November 2025, ordered chronologically by week.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(paid_ts, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(paid_ts) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS wk_start, COUNT(*) AS failed_cnt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'F' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY wk_start ORDER BY wk_start ASC;

items.question: Show the total inventory stock movement quantity (sum of qty) grouped by movement type per month for late 2025, ordered by month then type.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mth, mv_type, SUM(qty) AS net_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m'), mv_type ORDER BY mth ASC, mv_type ASC;

items.question: What is the monthly count of shipments delivered from the Newark Hub (warehouse W1) during 2026, in date order?
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, COUNT(*) AS deliv_cnt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND ship_status = 'D' AND ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: List the total order amounts grouped by year and month for orders placed through the app channel, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Show the quarterly count of orders with status shipped in the year 2026, ordered by quarter.
items.sql: SELECT QUARTER(ord_dt) AS qtr, COUNT(*) AS shipped_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'S' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY QUARTER(ord_dt) ORDER BY qtr ASC;

items.question: For each month in 2025, show the count of payment attempts made via credit card (method CC), ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mth, COUNT(*) AS cc_count FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND paid_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Give the weekly count of shipments handled by UPS during the first quarter of 2026, sorted by week start date.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(ship_dt, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(ship_dt) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS wk_start, COUNT(*) AS ups_cnt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS' AND ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-03-31' GROUP BY wk_start ORDER BY wk_start ASC;

items.question: Show the sum of payment amounts grouped by month for refunds processed (status R) in 2025, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mth, SUM(pay_amt) AS refund_sum FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'R' AND paid_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: List the count of stock movements of type IN per quarter for the year 2025, ordered by quarter ascending.
items.sql: SELECT QUARTER(mv_ts) AS qtr, COUNT(*) AS in_cnt FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY QUARTER(mv_ts) ORDER BY qtr ASC;

items.question: Show the monthly average list price of products in the electronics category (ELC) introduced over time? Group by product list price creation isn't there, instead show monthly count of orders containing any ELC product in 2026, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, COUNT(DISTINCT h.ord_id) AS ord_cnt FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND h.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Break down the number of shipments by delivery status for each month in 2026, ordered by month and status.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, ship_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ship_dt, '%Y-%m'), ship_status ORDER BY mth ASC, ship_status ASC;

items.question: Show the total payment amount collected each quarter of 2026 for settled payments, ordered by quarter.
items.sql: SELECT QUARTER(paid_ts) AS qtr, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2026-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY QUARTER(paid_ts) ORDER BY qtr ASC;

items.question: Find the weekly count of inventory adjustments (mv_type = 'ADJ') during October 2025, ordered by week start date.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(mv_ts, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(mv_ts) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS wk_start, COUNT(*) AS adj_cnt FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY wk_start ORDER BY wk_start ASC;

items.question: Show the monthly total of order amounts for cancelled orders in 2026, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS cancelled_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: List the count of shipments per warehouse for shipments occurring in the first half of 2026, ordered by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS ship_count FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the weekly sum of settled payment amounts for November 2025, ordered chronologically by week.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(paid_ts, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(paid_ts) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS wk_start, SUM(pay_amt) AS weekly_sum FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY wk_start ORDER BY wk_start ASC;

items.question: Can you list the warehouses in the AP region showing their warehouse ID and name?
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and on-hand quantity for items in warehouse W1 where the stock is at or below the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Give me the payment ID, order ID, and payment amount for all successful payments made in USD.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND pay_status = 'S' ORDER BY pay_id ASC

items.question: List all shipment IDs and their shipment dates handled by the carrier DHL.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' ORDER BY ship_dt ASC, ship_id ASC

items.question: Show the product SKU, warehouse ID, and units moved for inventory movements of type OUT.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' ORDER BY mv_id ASC

items.question: Display the order ID, order date, and total amount for orders placed through the WEB channel on 2026-04-03.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY ord_id ASC

items.question: Provide a ranking of warehouses by their total current on-hand inventory across all products, showing warehouse ID, total inventory, and the rank.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_inv, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(on_hand_qty) DESC) AS inv_rank FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY inv_rank ASC, wh_id ASC

items.question: For each warehouse, rank its inventory items from highest to lowest on-hand quantity, displaying warehouse ID, SKU, on_hand_qty, and the row number.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC) AS stock_rn FROM inventory ORDER BY wh_id ASC, stock_rn ASC

items.question: Show the cumulative running total of payment amounts for successful USD payments ordered by their paid timestamp, returning pay ID, paid timestamp, pay amount, and the running total.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, paid_ts, pay_amt, SUM(pay_amt) OVER (ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC) AS running_total FROM payment WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND pay_status = 'S' ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC

items.question: For each payment attempt in USD, display the payment ID, paid timestamp, current payment amount, and the amount of the previous payment attempt using a lag function.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, paid_ts, pay_amt, LAG(pay_amt, 1) OVER (ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC) AS prev_pay_amt FROM payment WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC

items.question: List each shipment date, the shipment ID, and use a lead function to show the next shipment date for the same warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ship_dt, LEAD(ship_dt, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ship_dt ASC, ship_id ASC) AS next_ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY ship_dt ASC, ship_id ASC

items.question: Find the top 2 products with the highest list price within each product category code, showing category code, SKU, product name, list price, and dense rank.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, dense_rpk FROM (SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC) AS dense_rpk FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE dense_rpk <= 2 ORDER BY categ_cd ASC, dense_rpk ASC, sku ASC

items.question: Calculate each successful payment amount's percentage contribution to the total successful payments in USD, showing payment ID, payment amount, and the percentage.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, pay_amt, (pay_amt * 100.0 / SUM(pay_amt) OVER ()) AS pct_of_total FROM payment WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND pay_status = 'S' ORDER BY pct_of_total DESC, pay_id ASC

items.question: For warehouse W2, show every inventory movement date-time and SKU along with the running sum of moved quantities ordered by movement timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT mv_ts, sku, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC) AS running_qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W2' ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC

items.question: Rank orders by their total amount within each sales channel, displaying channel code, order ID, order total amount, and the rank.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, ord_total_amt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC) AS ord_rank FROM ord_hdr ORDER BY channel_cd ASC, ord_rank ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Show all shipments from warehouse W1, and include the previous delivery date for shipments from that warehouse using lag.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ship_dt, deliv_dt, LAG(deliv_dt, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ship_dt ASC, ship_id ASC) AS prev_deliv_dt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY ship_dt ASC, ship_id ASC

items.question: Identify the single product with the highest on-hand quantity in each warehouse, showing warehouse ID, SKU, on_hand_qty, and row number.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, rn FROM (SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC) AS rn FROM inventory) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: For USD orders placed in 2026, compute a running total of order amounts ordered by order date, returning order ID, order date, order total amount, and the running total.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC) AS running_ord_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Rank products by list price across the entire catalog and return the top 3 most expensive products, showing SKU, product name, list price, and the dense rank.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc, drp FROM (SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC) AS drp FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE drp <= 3 ORDER BY drp ASC, sku ASC

items.question: For each inventory movement in warehouse W1, display movement ID, movement timestamp, quantity, and the difference in quantity compared to the immediately preceding movement in that warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty, qty - LAG(qty, 1) OVER (ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC) AS qty_diff FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC

items.question: For each order in the WEB channel, show order ID, order date, order total amount, and calculate what percentage each order's total amount represents of the total WEB channel sales.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, (ord_total_amt * 100.0 / SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_cd)) AS channel_pct FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' ORDER BY channel_pct DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Using dense rank, rank shipments by delivery date for carrier DHL, outputting shipment ID, warehouse ID, delivery date, and the dense rank.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, wh_id, deliv_dt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY deliv_dt ASC, ship_id ASC) AS deliv_dense_rank FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' AND deliv_dt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY deliv_dense_rank ASC, ship_id ASC

items.question: For each successful payment in USD, compute the running sum of payment amounts and compare each payment to the next payment amount using lead, returning payment ID, paid timestamp, payment amount, running total, and next payment amount.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, paid_ts, pay_amt, SUM(pay_amt) OVER (ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC) AS running_total, LEAD(pay_amt, 1) OVER (ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC) AS next_pay_amt FROM payment WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND pay_status = 'S' ORDER BY paid_ts ASC, pay_id ASC

items.question: Find the top 3 inventory items by on-hand quantity for each warehouse, returning warehouse ID, SKU, on_hand_qty, and the assigned row number.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, rn FROM (SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC) AS rn FROM inventory) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY wh_id ASC, rn ASC, sku ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the count of shipments sent from each warehouse for orders placed in April 2026, ordered by count descending then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH apr_ship AS (SELECT s.wh_id, s.ship_id FROM shipment s JOIN ord_hdr o ON s.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30') SELECT wh_id, COUNT(ship_id) AS shipment_count FROM apr_ship GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: List the carrier code and total payment amount collected for all shipments handled by each carrier in USD during the first half of 2026, highest total first then carrier code alphabetically.
items.sql: WITH h1_pay AS (SELECT s.carrier_cd, p.pay_amt FROM shipment s JOIN payment p ON s.ord_id = p.ord_id WHERE p.currency_cd = 'USD' AND p.pay_status = 'S' AND s.ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND s.ship_dt <= '2026-06-30') SELECT carrier_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_collected FROM h1_pay GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY total_collected DESC, carrier_cd ASC;

items.question: What is the SKU and current on-hand quantity for products stored in the Newark Hub warehouse where the current inventory is below its reorder point? Order by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' AND i.on_hand_qty <= i.reorder_pt ORDER BY i.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse name and the total positive stock movements (IN) recorded at each warehouse during October 2025, highest total quantity first.
items.sql: WITH in_moves AS (SELECT m.wh_id, m.qty FROM inv_move m WHERE m.mv_type = 'IN' AND m.qty > 0 AND m.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND m.mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59') SELECT w.wh_nm, SUM(m.qty) AS total_in_qty FROM in_moves m JOIN warehouse w ON m.wh_id = w.wh_id GROUP BY w.wh_nm ORDER BY total_in_qty DESC;

items.question: Find the SKU and product name of items that had more than 1 negative stock movement (OUT) in October 2025, sorted by SKU alphabetically.
items.sql: WITH out_counts AS (SELECT sku, COUNT(*) AS out_cnt FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM out_counts oc JOIN prod_catalog p ON oc.sku = p.sku ORDER BY p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the payment method code and the count of successful payment attempts using that method in November 2025, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, COUNT(*) AS success_count FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY success_count DESC;

items.question: Calculate the average order total amount for web-channel orders placed in the first quarter of 2026.
items.sql: SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_web_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-03-31';

items.question: Which warehouses have a total current on-hand inventory across all SKUs exceeding 1,000 units? Show the warehouse ID and total on-hand quantity, sorted from largest to smallest.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id HAVING SUM(on_hand_qty) > 1000 ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC;

items.question: For each sales channel, find the total revenue from delivered orders during 2026. Show channel code and total revenue, ordered by revenue descending.
items.sql: WITH delivered_rev AS (SELECT channel_cd, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM delivered_rev GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

items.question: Identify SKUs that appear in more than 3 order lines across all orders. Show the SKU and the number of order lines, sorted by count descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY line_count DESC;

items.question: Find products whose list price is strictly greater than the average list price of all products in the electronics category ('ELC'). Show SKU, product name, and list price, highest price first.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > (SELECT AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC') ORDER BY list_prc DESC;

items.question: Show the carrier code and average days to delivery for shipments delivered in 2026 where a delivery date is recorded, ordered by average delivery time ascending.
items.sql: WITH ship_dur AS (SELECT carrier_cd, DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt) AS days_to_deliv FROM shipment WHERE deliv_dt IS NOT NULL AND ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-12-31') SELECT carrier_cd, AVG(days_to_deliv) AS avg_delivery_days FROM ship_dur GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY avg_delivery_days ASC;

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and list price for discontinued products in the kitchen ('KIT') category, sorted by list price ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY list_prc ASC;

items.question: Show the order ID, payment amount, and currency for payment attempts that failed ('F') during November 2025, ordered by payment amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, pay_amt, currency_cd FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'F' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY pay_amt DESC;

items.question: Find the warehouse ID and count of distinct SKUs held in inventory that have zero or negative stock on hand today, ordered by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS low_stock_skus FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= 0 GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC;

items.question: What is the total order amount placed through the mobile app ('APP') in USD currency during the first half of 2026?
items.sql: SELECT SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_app_usd FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30';

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the number of shipments dispatched by the 'DHL' carrier from each warehouse, ordered by shipment count descending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(ship_id) AS dhl_shipment_count FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY dhl_shipment_count DESC;

items.question: For each product category, what is the maximum list price among products that are currently active (not discontinued)? Show category code and maximum price, highest price first.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, MAX(list_prc) AS max_price FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 0 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY max_price DESC;

items.question: Find the top 5 warehouses by total number of stock movements recorded in October 2025. Show warehouse ID and movement count.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY movement_count DESC LIMIT 5;

items.question: Calculate the percentage of orders placed in 2026 that were cancelled ('C'). Return the percentage value as cancelled_pct.
items.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS cancelled_pct FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31';

items.question: List the order ID and total payment amount for orders that had more than one payment attempt recorded, sorted by total payment amount descending.
items.sql: WITH multi_pay AS (SELECT ord_id, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_paid FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT ord_id, total_paid FROM multi_pay ORDER BY total_paid DESC;

items.question: Show the region code and the count of warehouses located in each region, ordered alphabetically by region code.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS warehouse_count FROM warehouse GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the SKU, product name, and total units ordered across all order lines for products belonging to the home ('HOM') category, ordered by total units descending.
items.sql: WITH hom_lines AS (SELECT l.sku, l.qty FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'HOM') SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, SUM(hl.qty) AS total_units FROM hom_lines hl JOIN prod_catalog p ON hl.sku = p.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm ORDER BY total_units DESC;

items.question: For orders shipped in 2026, compute the ratio of shipments handled by 'UPS' compared to all shipments, expressed as a percentage named ups_share.
items.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN carrier_cd = 'UPS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS ups_share FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2026-12-31';

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name for all warehouses located in the EU region.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'EU'

items.question: List the SKU and on-hand quantity for items where the current stock is at or below the reorder point at warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku

items.question: Show the shipment ID and order ID for all shipments handled by carrier DHL.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' ORDER BY ship_id

items.question: List the distinct payment method codes that had at least one settled payment attempt.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT method_cd FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' ORDER BY method_cd

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for all products in the electronics category (ELC).
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY sku

items.question: List the order ID and payment amount for payments made using credit card (CC) with an amount over 500.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, ord_id

items.question: Show the shipment ID, order ID, and shipment date for shipments made in January 2026 (from '2026-01-01' to '2026-01-31') by UPS.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS' AND ship_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' ORDER BY ship_dt, ship_id

items.question: List SKUs that have been moved out due to customer orders (mv_type = 'OUT') from warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND mv_type = 'OUT' ORDER BY sku

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and total on-hand quantity across all their inventory items, sorted by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, wh_id

items.question: Find the SKU and product name for products that are held in warehouse W1 and also held in warehouse W2.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' INTERSECT SELECT T3.sku, T4.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T3 JOIN prod_catalog AS T4 ON T3.sku = T4.sku WHERE T3.wh_id = 'W2'

items.question: Show the carrier code and the count of shipments handled by each carrier for shipments delivered on or after '2026-01-01'.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_cnt FROM shipment WHERE deliv_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_cnt DESC, carrier_cd

items.question: List the order IDs that have at least one settled payment and also have at least one refund request.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' INTERSECT SELECT ord_id FROM refund_req ORDER BY ord_id

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for items that have an inventory movement of type 'ADJ' recorded in warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM inv_move AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' AND T1.mv_type = 'ADJ' ORDER BY T1.sku

items.question: List the warehouse ID and name of warehouses that hold product 'ELC-024'.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm FROM warehouse AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T2.sku = 'ELC-024' ORDER BY T1.wh_id

items.question: Show the order ID and order total amount for web channel orders placed in 2026 that have a status of delivered ('D').
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_status = 'D' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id

items.question: List SKUs that had stock movements of type 'IN' (restock) but have never had any stock movements of type 'OUT'.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' ORDER BY sku

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name for warehouses that hold every SKU present in the product catalog.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm FROM warehouse AS T1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_catalog WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory AS T2 WHERE T2.wh_id = T1.wh_id AND T2.sku = prod_catalog.sku)) ORDER BY T1.wh_id

items.question: List order IDs that have a shipment managed by carrier 'UPS' combined using UNION with order IDs that have a payment method of 'PP'.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS' UNION SELECT ord_id FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'PP' ORDER BY ord_id

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products that appear in inventory at warehouse W1 but do not appear in inventory at warehouse W3.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' EXCEPT SELECT T3.sku, T4.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T3 JOIN prod_catalog AS T4 ON T3.sku = T4.sku WHERE T3.wh_id = 'W3'

items.question: List the customer IDs of customers who have placed orders via the WEB channel but have never placed an order via the APP channel.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY cust_id

items.question: Show the SKU and average moved quantity (absolute value of qty) for stock movements of type 'ADjan' where the movement quantity is recorded, grouped by SKU for warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT sku, AVG(ABS(qty)) AS avg_moved_qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND mv_type = 'ADJ' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY avg_moved_qty DESC, sku

items.question: List the shipment ID and order ID for shipments where the associated order was placed through the 'WEB' channel and shipped via 'DHL'.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ship_id, T1.ord_id FROM shipment AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id WHERE T2.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND T1.carrier_cd = 'DHL' ORDER BY T1.ship_id

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and count of distinct SKUs held in inventory where the on-hand quantity is greater than 300.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS sku_count FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty > 300 GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY sku_count DESC, wh_id

items.question: List SKUs that are stocked in all four warehouses (W1, W2, W3, W4).
items.sql: SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' INTERSECT SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W2' INTERSECT SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W3' INTERSECT SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W4' ORDER BY sku

items.question: Can you list the shipment ID and order ID for all shipments sent using DHL?
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' ORDER BY ship_id

items.question: What is the warehouse name and region code for the warehouse with ID W1?
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE wh_id = 'W1'

items.question: Show me the SKU, on-hand quantity, and reorder point for products stored in warehouse W2 where the current stock is at or below the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku

items.question: Find the payment ID, order ID, and payment amount for all payment attempts that settled successfully using credit cards.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_status = 'S' ORDER BY pay_id

items.question: Give me the SKU and product name for all items in the electronics category.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY sku

items.question: List the order ID, order date, and order total amount for orders placed through the web channel in USD currency.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY ord_id

items.question: What is the movement ID, movement timestamp, and moved quantity for all inventory adjustments recorded for SKU ELC-026?
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE sku = 'ELC-026' AND mv_type = 'ADJ' ORDER BY mv_id

items.question: Show the shipment ID and shipment date for orders dispatched from the Newark Hub warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT s.ship_id, s.ship_dt FROM shipment s JOIN warehouse w ON s.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' ORDER BY s.ship_id

items.question: Which products have an on-hand quantity in warehouse W1 that is strictly greater than the average on-hand quantity across all products in that warehouse? Return the SKU and on-hand quantity.
items.sql: SELECT i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i WHERE i.wh_id = 'W1' AND i.on_hand_qty > (SELECT AVG(i2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory i2 WHERE i2.wh_id = 'W1') ORDER BY i.sku

items.question: Find all products in the catalog that have never had any inventory movement recorded. Show the SKU and product name.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move m WHERE m.sku = p.sku) ORDER BY p.sku

items.question: For each warehouse, list the warehouse ID and the total count of inventory movement transactions recorded.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id

items.question: Retrieve the order ID and payment amount for the single latest payment attempt made for each order.
items.sql: SELECT p.ord_id, p.pay_amt FROM payment p WHERE p.paid_ts = (SELECT MAX(p2.paid_ts) FROM payment p2 WHERE p2.ord_id = p.ord_id) ORDER BY p.ord_id

items.question: Show the SKU and list price for products whose list price is higher than the average list price of all products in their respective category.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p WHERE p.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(p2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog p2 WHERE p2.categ_cd = p.categ_cd) ORDER BY p.sku

items.question: List the order ID, shipment date, and delivery date for orders where the shipment delivery date is known and occurred before or on 2026-04-02.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ship_dt, deliv_dt FROM shipment WHERE deliv_dt IS NOT NULL AND deliv_dt <= '2026-04-02' ORDER BY ord_id

items.question: Find the SKU, product name, and list price of the most expensive product in the catalog.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc = (SELECT MAX(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog)

items.question: Identify all warehouses that hold zero inventory records in the inventory table. Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm FROM warehouse w WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i WHERE i.wh_id = w.wh_id) ORDER BY w.wh_id

items.question: Find the latest inventory movement record for each SKU. Return the SKU, movement ID, and movement timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT m.sku, m.mv_id, m.mv_ts FROM inv_move m WHERE m.mv_ts = (SELECT MAX(m2.mv_ts) FROM inv_move m2 WHERE m2.sku = m.sku) ORDER BY m.sku

items.question: Which products have an on-hand quantity in their assigned warehouse that exceeds the reorder point by more than 50 units? Return the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty > reorder_pt + 50 ORDER BY sku

items.question: List the order ID and order total amount for orders whose total amount is greater than the average order total amount for orders placed through the same sales channel.
items.sql: SELECT o.ord_id, o.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(o2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr o2 WHERE o2.channel_cd = o.channel_cd) ORDER BY o.ord_id

items.question: Identify products that have an inventory movement with negative quantity (outbound or reduction) greater in magnitude than any outbound movement for SKU ELC-024. Return the SKU, movement ID, and quantity.
items.sql: SELECT m.sku, m.mv_id, m.qty FROM inv_move m WHERE m.qty < (SELECT MIN(m2.qty) FROM inv_move m2 WHERE m2.sku = 'ELC-024' AND m2.qty < 0) ORDER BY m.sku, m.mv_id

items.question: Find orders that have multiple payment attempts recorded in the payment table. Return the order ID and the count of payment attempts, ordered by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ord_id

items.question: List products whose list price is higher than the maximum list price of all products in the home (HOM) category. Return the SKU, product name, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > (SELECT MAX(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM') ORDER BY sku

items.question: Find all warehouses that currently stock every single product listed in the product catalog. Return the warehouse ID and warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm FROM warehouse w WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT p.sku FROM prod_catalog p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT i.sku FROM inventory i WHERE i.wh_id = w.wh_id AND i.sku = p.sku)) ORDER BY w.wh_id

items.question: Retrieve the shipment ID, order ID, and carrier code for shipments where the carrier code matches the alphabetical maximum carrier code present in the shipment table.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, carrier_cd FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = (SELECT MAX(carrier_cd) FROM shipment) ORDER BY ship_id

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the total inventory quantity currently on hand for items where the stock level is at or below the reorder point versus items above it, returning two separate sum columns side by side.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN on_hand_qty ELSE 0 END) AS low_stock_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty > reorder_pt THEN on_hand_qty ELSE 0 END) AS healthy_stock_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id

items.question: For shipments in the Newark Hub warehouse (W1), give me the total number of shipments and the count of those that were successfully delivered, both displayed in a single row.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_shipments, SUM(CASE WHEN ship_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_shipments FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W1'

items.question: Calculate the total payment amount collected in USD separated by payment status, showing the settled amount and the refunded amount side by side for all payment attempts.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'S' THEN pay_amt ELSE 0 END) AS settled_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'R' THEN pay_amt ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_usd FROM payment WHERE currency_cd = 'USD'

items.question: For each payment method code, list the method code, the total count of payment attempts, and the proportion of attempts that resulted in a failed status expressed as a decimal ratio.
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS failure_ratio FROM payment GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY failure_ratio DESC, method_cd ASC

items.question: Break down orders placed in 2026 by sales channel code, displaying the channel code, the total order count, and the count of orders that reached delivered status versus those that were cancelled in two distinct columns.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd

items.question: Give me the total number of stock movements recorded for each movement type across all warehouses.
items.sql: SELECT mv_type, COUNT(*) AS move_count FROM inv_move GROUP BY mv_type

items.question: For warehouse W2, show the total quantity moved for incoming restocks versus outgoing customer shipments using conditional aggregation in one row.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'IN' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS total_in_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'OUT' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS total_out_qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W2'

items.question: For each product category in the catalog, report the total number of SKUs and how many of those SKUs are currently flagged as discontinued, side by side.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_skus, SUM(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discontinued_skus FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd

items.question: List each carrier code along with the total number of shipments handled and the count of shipments that are currently in transit versus delivered.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_shipments, SUM(CASE WHEN ship_status = 'I' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_transit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ship_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_count FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY total_shipments DESC, carrier_cd ASC

items.question: For orders placed in July 2026, compute the total order amount originating from the WEB channel compared to all other channels combined, returning both figures side by side.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS web_total, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_cd <> 'WEB' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS other_channel_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-07-31'

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the ratio of items currently at or below their reorder point relative to the total number of tracked inventory items in that warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS low_stock_item_ratio FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY low_stock_item_ratio DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Count the total number of payment attempts grouped by currency code.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment GROUP BY currency_cd

items.question: For each product category, calculate the average list price of active products and the average list price of discontinued products in two separate columns.
items.sql: SELECT p.categ_cd, AVG(CASE WHEN p.disc_flag = 0 THEN p.list_prc END) AS active_avg_price, AVG(CASE WHEN p.disc_flag = 1 THEN p.list_prc END) AS discontinued_avg_price FROM prod_catalog p GROUP BY p.categ_cd

items.question: Give me the total sales amount for orders in currency EUR, broken down by order status (shipped, delivered, cancelled) across three columns side by side.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'S' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS shipped_eur, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'D' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_eur, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'C' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_eur FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'EUR'

items.question: For shipments dispatched by carrier 'DHL', show the total number of shipments and the count of those that have a recorded delivery date.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_dhl_shipments, SUM(CASE WHEN deliv_dt IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_dhl_count FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL'

items.question: Display each warehouse region code alongside the total number of warehouses in that region and the total inventory units on hand across those warehouses.
items.sql: SELECT w.region_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT w.wh_id) AS warehouse_count, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id GROUP BY w.region_cd

items.question: Calculate the total payment amount processed through credit cards (CC) versus all other payment methods combined for the entire payment table.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN method_cd = 'CC' THEN pay_amt ELSE 0 END) AS cc_total, SUM(CASE WHEN method_cd <> 'CC' THEN pay_amt ELSE 0 END) AS non_cc_total FROM payment

items.question: For every product category, report the count of SKUs that are priced above 50 USD versus those priced at or below 50 USD.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN list_prc > 50.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_price_skus, SUM(CASE WHEN list_prc <= 50.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_price_skus FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd

items.question: Compute the percentage of payment attempts that successfully settled versus those that failed or were refunded, grouped by currency code.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS settled_ratio, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status <> 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS unsuccess_ratio FROM payment GROUP BY currency_cd

items.question: List each sales channel code and the total count of orders placed through it, along with the percentage share each channel represents out of all orders.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS channel_orders, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr) AS order_percentage FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY order_percentage DESC, channel_cd ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the sum of positive inventory adjustments versus the absolute sum of negative adjustment quantities in two separate columns.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'ADJ' AND qty > 0 THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS positive_adj_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'ADJ' AND qty < 0 THEN ABS(qty) ELSE 0 END) AS negative_adj_sum FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id

items.question: For all orders placed in 2026, count how many orders used USD currency versus non-USD currencies.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN currency_cd = 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usd_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN currency_cd <> 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_usd_orders FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31'

items.question: For each warehouse, list the warehouse ID and the count of stock movements that were triggered by an order (having an order ID) versus manual adjustments or restocks.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_driven_moves, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_order_moves FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id

items.question: Calculate the overall ratio of delivered shipments to total shipments across the entire company.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ship_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS overall_delivery_rate FROM shipment

items.question: A delivered shipment is considered delayed if its delivery date is after 2026-05-01. Show the shipment id and carrier code for all such delayed shipments.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, carrier_cd FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' AND deliv_dt > '2026-05-01'

items.question: An active inventory item at risk of stockout is one where the on hand quantity is less than or equal to its reorder point. List the product SKU and warehouse id for all such inventory records in warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt

items.question: A settled payment attempt is one with a payment status of S. Show the payment attempt id and payment amount for all settled payments made on currency USD.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND currency_cd = 'USD'

items.question: A shipped order header is one where the order status is S. Show the order id and order total amount for all shipped orders placed through the web channel.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'S' AND channel_cd = 'WEB'

items.question: A discontinued product is flagged with a disc flag value of 1. Show the product SKU and product name for all discontinued products in the electronics category code ELC.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 AND categ_cd = 'ELC'

items.question: A stock adjustment movement is recorded with movement type ADJ. Show the movement id and quantity moved for all adjustment movements in warehouse W2.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND mv_type = 'ADJ'

items.question: An international warehouse serves any region other than North America code NA. Show the warehouse id and warehouse name for all warehouses serving regions other than NA, ordered by warehouse name ascending, then warehouse id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd <> 'NA' ORDER BY wh_nm ASC, wh_id ASC

items.question: A credit card payment method is represented by code CC. Show the payment id and order id for all credit card payments where the payment amount exceeds 500.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_amt > 500.00

items.question: A delivered shipment is one with shipment status D. For each carrier code, show the carrier code and the count of delivered shipments, ordered by the count descending, then carrier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_cnt FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_cnt DESC, carrier_cd ASC

items.question: A restock stock movement has movement type IN. For each warehouse id, show the warehouse id and the sum of positive quantities moved for restock movements, ordered by the sum descending, then warehouse id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(qty) AS total_restock_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_restock_qty DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: A high-value order is one where the order total amount in USD is greater than 500. Show the order id, order date, and order total amount for orders placed in currency USD that are high-value, ordered by order total amount descending, then order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: An active inventory risk item is one where the current on hand quantity is less than its reorder point. Show the product SKU, product name, and on hand quantity by joining inventory and product catalog for warehouse W3, ordered by on hand quantity ascending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.wh_id = 'W3' AND t1.on_hand_qty < t1.reorder_pt ORDER BY t1.on_hand_qty ASC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: A completed delivery shipment is one where the shipment status is D and delivery date is not null. For each warehouse, show the warehouse id and the average delivery duration in days computed as delivery date minus ship date, ordered by average duration descending, then warehouse id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, AVG(DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt)) AS avg_transit_days FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' AND deliv_dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY avg_transit_days DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: A high-price product is one with a list price strictly greater than 80. For each product category code, show the category code and the count of high-price products, ordered by the count descending, then category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_cnt FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 80.00 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY prod_cnt DESC, categ_cd ASC

items.question: A settled payment attempt has payment status S. For each payment method code, show the method code, the count of settled payment attempts, and the total settled payment amount, ordered by total settled amount descending, then method code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, COUNT(*) AS pay_cnt, SUM(pay_amt) AS total_paid FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY total_paid DESC, method_cd ASC

items.question: A customer order shipment is linked via order header. Show the shipment id, order id, warehouse name, and carrier code for shipments handled by carrier DHL, ordered by ship date ascending, then shipment id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ship_id, t1.ord_id, t2.wh_nm, t1.carrier_cd FROM shipment AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.carrier_cd = 'DHL' ORDER BY t1.ship_dt ASC, t1.ship_id ASC

items.question: A high-volume warehouse activity log records stock movements. Show the warehouse id, movement type, and total absolute quantity moved for movements where the absolute quantity moved is greater than 50, ordered by total absolute quantity descending, then warehouse id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, mv_type, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_abs_qty FROM inv_move WHERE ABS(qty) > 50 GROUP BY wh_id, mv_type ORDER BY total_abs_qty DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: A multi-payment order is an order header that has more than one payment attempt recorded. Show the order id and the count of payment attempts for such orders, ordered by the count descending, then order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(*) AS attempt_cnt FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY attempt_cnt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A critical inventory stock shortage is defined as an item where the current on hand quantity is less than half of its reorder point. Show the warehouse id, product SKU, product name, on hand quantity, and reorder point by joining inventory, warehouse, and product catalog for such shortage items, ordered by on hand quantity ascending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, t1.on_hand_qty, t1.reorder_pt FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN warehouse AS t3 ON t1.wh_id = t3.wh_id WHERE t1.on_hand_qty < (t1.reorder_pt / 2.0) ORDER BY t1.on_hand_qty ASC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: A fully paid order is one where the sum of settled payment amounts equals or exceeds the order total amount. For orders placed in currency USD in the year 2026, show the order id, order total amount, and total settled amount, ordered by order total amount descending, then order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt, SUM(t2.pay_amt) AS settled_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN payment AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.currency_cd = 'USD' AND t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t2.pay_status = 'S' GROUP BY t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt HAVING SUM(t2.pay_amt) >= t1.ord_total_amt ORDER BY t1.ord_total_amt DESC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: A high-revenue product line is determined by total order revenue. For each product SKU, show the SKU, product name, and total revenue calculated as quantity times unit price minus line discount, for delivered orders, ordered by total revenue descending, then SKU ascending limit 5.
items.sql: SELECT t2.sku, t3.prod_nm, SUM(t2.qty * t2.unit_prc * (1 - t2.disc_pct / 100.0)) AS total_rev FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN ord_line AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog AS t3 ON t2.sku = t3.sku WHERE t1.ord_status = 'D' GROUP BY t2.sku, t3.prod_nm ORDER BY total_rev DESC, t2.sku ASC LIMIT 5

items.question: A delayed shipping hub is a warehouse where more than 2 shipments were delivered after 2026-04-01. Show the warehouse id, warehouse name, and count of delayed shipments for such warehouses, ordered by the count descending, then warehouse id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t2.wh_nm, COUNT(*) AS delayed_cnt FROM shipment AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.ship_status = 'D' AND t1.deliv_dt > '2026-04-01' GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t2.wh_nm HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY delayed_cnt DESC, t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: An active stock movement product is one that has experienced both IN and OUT movement types. Show the product SKU and product name for such products by joining inventory movements and product catalog, ordered by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN') AND t1.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT') ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: A high-discrepancy warehouse is one where the absolute sum of adjustment movement quantities exceeds 100. Show the warehouse id, warehouse name, and total adjustment quantity absolute sum, ordered by the total adjustment sum descending, then warehouse id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t2.wh_nm, SUM(ABS(t1.qty)) AS total_adj_qty FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.mv_type = 'ADJ' GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t2.wh_nm HAVING SUM(ABS(t1.qty)) > 100 ORDER BY total_adj_qty DESC, t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Which warehouses are located in the North America region? Show the warehouse ID and warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: Give me the IDs and names of all employees who report directly to Beatrice Owusu (emp ID E-002). Sort by employee ID.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-002' ORDER BY emp_id ASC

items.question: Show me all shipments handled by the carrier 'DHL' on or after 2026-01-01. List the shipment ID and order ID.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' AND ship_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY ship_id ASC

items.question: List every product SKU and its inventory on-hand quantity at the Newark Hub warehouse (wh_id 'W1').
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Find all payment attempts made using PayPal ('PP') that successfully settled ('S'). Show the payment ID and the amount paid.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'PP' AND pay_status = 'S' ORDER BY pay_id ASC

items.question: List the total number of stock movements recorded for each movement type. Show the movement type and the count of movements.
items.sql: SELECT mv_type, COUNT(*) FROM inv_move GROUP BY mv_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, mv_type ASC

items.question: List the full names of all staff members in the engineering department ('ENG'). Sort alphabetically by employee name.
items.sql: SELECT emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'ENG' ORDER BY emp_nm ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for all items in the electronics category ('ELC') that are not discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Who are the direct reports of Amara Singh (emp_id 'E-001')? Return their employee IDs and names.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001' ORDER BY emp_id ASC

items.question: For each carrier, count how many shipments left from the Newark Hub (wh_id 'W1'). Show carrier code and shipment count.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W1' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, carrier_cd ASC

items.question: What is the total on-hand inventory quantity for each warehouse? Show the warehouse ID and total quantity, ordered from highest to lowest quantity.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY SUM(on_hand_qty) DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Find all orders placed through the web channel ('WEB') with an order status of delivered ('D') on 2026-04-03. Show the order ID and total amount.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_status = 'D' AND ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY ord_id ASC

items.question: Give me a breakdown of payment amounts by payment method for all successful payments ('S') in USD currency. Return the method code and total amount.
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY SUM(pay_amt) DESC, method_cd ASC

items.question: List all products where the current on-hand inventory across all warehouses is at or below the reorder point. Return SKU and warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Show all employees who sit under Chloe Whitaker (emp_id 'E-003') anywhere in the reporting tree, using a recursive CTE. Return their employee IDs and full names.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE subordinates AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-003' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN subordinates s ON e.mgr_emp_id = s.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM subordinates ORDER BY emp_id ASC

items.question: Find the complete management chain going upwards from employee 'E-007' to the top of the company tree. Return the employee IDs and names in order from direct manager up to top level.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE management_chain AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-007' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id FROM emp e JOIN management_chain mc ON e.emp_id = mc.mgr_emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM management_chain WHERE emp_id <> 'E-007' ORDER BY emp_id ASC

items.question: Calculate the total depth of each employee reporting path starting from top-level managers (those with NULL manager) down to their deepest descendant. Show employee ID, name, and reporting depth.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE emp_depth AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, 1 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, ed.depth + 1 FROM emp e JOIN emp_depth ed ON e.mgr_emp_id = ed.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, depth FROM emp_depth ORDER BY depth DESC, emp_id ASC

items.question: List all employees who belong to the same department as their direct manager. Show the employee ID, name, and department code.
items.sql: SELECT e1.emp_id, e1.emp_nm, e1.dept_cd FROM emp e1 JOIN emp e2 ON e1.mgr_emp_id = e2.emp_id WHERE e1.dept_cd = e2.dept_cd ORDER BY e1.emp_id ASC

items.question: Find the total salary budget (using salary_amt) for each department, but only include departments where the total exceeds 200000. Return department code and total salary, ordered highest first.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, SUM(salary_amt) FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd HAVING SUM(salary_amt) > 200000 ORDER BY SUM(salary_amt) DESC, dept_cd ASC

items.question: For each manager employee, count the total number of staff reporting to them either directly or indirectly across all management tiers. Return manager employee ID and total subordinate count.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE all_reports AS (SELECT mgr_emp_id AS manager_id, emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT ar.manager_id, e.emp_id FROM emp e JOIN all_reports ar ON e.mgr_emp_id = ar.emp_id) SELECT manager_id, COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id) FROM all_reports GROUP BY manager_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT emp_id) DESC, manager_id ASC

items.question: Identify all shipments that were dispatched from warehouses in the Asia Pacific ('AP') region. Return the shipment ID, order ID, and warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT s.ship_id, s.ord_id, s.wh_id FROM shipment s JOIN warehouse w ON s.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY s.ship_id ASC

items.question: Retrieve the order ID, payment amount, and payment date for all payment attempts associated with orders placed in 2026 that had a settled status ('S').
items.sql: SELECT p.ord_id, p.pay_amt, p.paid_ts FROM payment p JOIN ord_hdr o ON p.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND p.pay_status = 'S' ORDER BY p.paid_ts ASC, p.ord_id ASC

items.question: List the SKUs, product names, and total moved quantities for all OUT stock movements that occurred in October 2025.
items.sql: SELECT im.sku, pc.prod_nm, im.qty FROM inv_move im JOIN prod_catalog pc ON im.sku = pc.sku WHERE im.mv_type = 'OUT' AND im.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND im.mv_ts < '2025-11-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY im.mv_ts ASC, im.sku ASC

items.question: Find all orders where the total amount in the order header is greater than 500 and the order currency is USD. Show order ID and order total amount.

items.question: Can you list the names and region codes of all warehouses in the Europe sales region?

items.question: Show the total payment amount for each payment method code where the status is settled.

items.question: Give me the SKU and on-hand quantity for every product stored in the Newark Hub warehouse.

items.question: What is the shipment ID and order ID for all shipments handled by the UPS carrier?

items.question: Find the order ID and order total amount for every order placed through the mobile app sales channel code.

items.question: Show the carrier code and the total number of shipments delivered on or after 2026-04-01.

items.question: For orders placed in USD currency during the first half of 2026, what is the total order amount grouped by order status?

items.question: List the SKU and product name for items belonging to the kitchen category that are not discontinued.

items.question: Calculate the average payment amount for each payment method using US Dollars since 2025-11-01.

items.question: Find the order ID, payment amount, and payment timestamp for all credit card payment attempts that settled successfully in November 2025.

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the total sum of positive inventory movements (restocks) recorded across all warehouses.

items.question: Which product SKUs have had more than 2 inventory movement records of type OUT?

items.question: For orders shipped via DHL, give me the shipment ID, order date, and delivery date for those delivered in the year 2026.

items.question: List the warehouse name and the total inventory on-hand quantity for all products in each warehouse.

items.question: Identify the top 3 warehouses with the highest total on-hand inventory quantity across all their stored SKUs.

items.question: Find all orders placed through the web channel that have a total amount greater than the average order total of all web orders.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB') ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products whose list price is strictly higher than the average list price of all items in their respective product category code.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE t1.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(t2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS t2 WHERE t2.categ_cd = t1.categ_cd) ORDER BY t1.categ_cd ASC, t1.list_prc DESC;

items.question: List each carrier code and the percentage of their shipments that have a delivery date recorded out of all shipments handled by that carrier.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, (SUM(CASE WHEN deliv_dt IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY carrier_cd ASC;

items.question: Retrieve the order ID and payment amount for orders where the total payment attempts equal or exceed 500 in currency value, using only settled payments.

items.question: What are the sales figures for electronics?
items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Should I calculate sales using order totals linked to electronic products or total list prices for the ELC category over a specific period?

items.question: Pull up payment records.
items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Which payment status or date range should I pull records for?

items.question: How many items are in transit?
items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Are you referring to shipments with an in-transit status or outbound stock movements?

items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Should I calculate the total using list prices of active products, discontinued items, or include current inventory quantities?

items.question: Pull up the full customer record for C-1001 so I can check their contact details.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd, region_cd, signup_dt, is_actv FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001'

items.question: Which orders are currently sitting in new status? Return the order ID, customer ID, order date, total amount, and channel code.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, channel_cd FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'N' ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id

items.question: List all active customers in the NA sales region showing their customer ID and customer name.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'NA' AND is_actv = 1 ORDER BY cust_nm, cust_id

items.question: Show me all details for the promotion with promotion ID 1.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, promo_nm, disc_pct, starts_dt, ends_dt FROM promo WHERE promo_id = 1

items.question: Find all clickstream web events that happened during session sess000001, listing event ID, customer ID, event timestamp, and event type.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, cust_id, evt_ts, evt_type FROM web_event WHERE session_id = 'sess000001' ORDER BY evt_ts, evt_id

items.question: Get the customer segment history for customer C-1001, ordering by the month date descending, and show month date along with the segment code.
items.sql: SELECT month_dt, segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001' ORDER BY month_dt DESC, segment_cd

items.question: Retrieve the promotion ID and promotion code for any promotions that offer a discount percentage greater than 15 percent, sorted by discount percentage descending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_id

items.question: Show the order ID and order total amount for all orders placed through the mobile app channel during the month of April 2026 (from 2026-04-01 through 2026-04-30).
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id

items.question: Which customers signed up between 2022-07-01 and 2022-07-31 and are still active? Give me their customer ID, name, and signup date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-07-01' AND '2022-07-31' ORDER BY signup_dt, cust_id

items.question: List all web events of type 'CART' that occurred between 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-30, showing the event ID, session ID, SKU, and event timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, session_id, sku, evt_ts FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY evt_ts, evt_id

items.question: Find all Platinum tier customers located in the Europe (EU) region. Show their customer ID, name, and signup date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'EU' ORDER BY signup_nm, cust_id

items.question: Get the promotion name and discount percentage for all promotions that were active on 2026-03-15 (meaning starts_dt <= 2026-03-15 and ends_dt >= 2026-03-15).
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt <= '2026-03-15' AND ends_dt >= '2026-03-15' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_nm

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for any inactive (soft deleted) customers whose signup date is prior to 2022-08-01.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 0 AND signup_dt < '2022-08-01' ORDER BY signup_dt, cust_id

items.question: Find all web events where a customer was logged in (cust_id is not null) and performed a PURCHASE event using the web channel on 2025-11-01. Return the event ID, session ID, customer ID, and order ID.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, session_id, cust_id, ord_id FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-11-02 00:00:00' ORDER BY evt_ts, evt_id

items.question: Which orders placed in currency EUR had an order total amount greater than 100.00? List the order ID, customer ID, order date, and order total amount.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'EUR' AND ord_total_amt > 100.00 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id

items.question: Identify all customer segments recorded for the month of July 2026 (month_dt = '2026-07-01') where the segment code was 'RISK'. Return the customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND segment_cd = 'RISK' ORDER BY cust_id

items.question: List the order IDs of all orders that applied the promotion with promotion ID 3.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id FROM ord_promo WHERE promo_id = 3 ORDER BY ord_id

items.question: Show the customer ID, name, and signup date for customers who belong to either the Gold ('G') or Platinum ('P') tier and are in the Asia Pacific ('AP') region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd IN ('G', 'P') AND region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY cust_nm, cust_id

items.question: Retrieve session IDs and event timestamps for all web events that were browsing product 'ELC-026' during view events.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, evt_ts FROM web_event WHERE sku = 'ELC-026' AND evt_type = 'VIEW' ORDER BY evt_ts, session_id

items.question: Which orders in the web channel had a status of either cancelled ('C') or returned ('R') during the first half of 2026 (between 2026-01-01 and 2026-06-30)? Return order ID, customer ID, order date, and order status.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_status FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_status IN ('C', 'R') AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id

items.question: Find all customer segment history records for customers whose segment code changed to 'VIP' on 2026-10-01. Return the customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY cust_id

items.question: List promotion codes and their names for any promotion starting on or after 2026-01-01 and ending on or before 2026-12-31, sorted by start date.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ends_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY starts_dt, promo_cd
