items.question: Get the customer ID and order ID for all purchases tracked in web events where the channel code was 'APP'.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, ord_id FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL AND ord_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY evt_ts, ord_id

items.question: Find all orders placed via the store ('STR') channel where the order total amount is between 200.00 and 600.00 USD. Show order ID, customer ID, order date, and order total amount.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'STR' AND currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_total_amt BETWEEN 200.00 AND 600.00 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id

items.question: How many customers do we have in each sales region? Show the region code and customer count, ordered by region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC, customer_count DESC;

items.question: Give me the total number of website and app events logged by each event type. Return the event type and total count, ordered by count descending then event type ascending.
items.sql: SELECT evt_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM web_event GROUP BY evt_type ORDER BY event_count DESC, evt_type ASC;

items.question: What is the average discount percentage across all our promotional campaigns? List just the average discount.
items.sql: SELECT AVG(disc_pct) AS avg_discount_pct FROM promo;

items.question: Show me the count of active versus inactive customers. Output the active flag and customer count, sorted by active flag ascending.
items.sql: SELECT is_actv, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM cust_master GROUP BY is_actv ORDER BY is_actv ASC, customer_count DESC;

items.question: How many orders were placed through each sales channel? Show the channel code and order count, sorted by order count descending then channel code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY order_count DESC, channel_cd ASC;

items.question: What is the maximum order total amount recorded in USD? Return the highest amount.
items.sql: SELECT MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_order_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD';

items.question: List each loyalty tier code and the number of customers in it. Show tier code and count, ordered by tier code.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC, customer_count DESC;

items.question: How many unique customers have placed at least one order? Give me the distinct customer count.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS active_ordering_customers FROM ord_hdr;

items.question: Find the total order amount for orders placed in USD currency. Return the sum of order totals.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_usd_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD';

items.question: For each promotion name, how many orders had that promotion applied? Return the promotion name and order count, ordered by count descending then promo name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS order_count FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id GROUP BY t1.promo_nm ORDER BY order_count DESC, t1.promo_nm ASC;

items.question: Show me the average order total amount for each order status in 2026. Return order status and average total, ordered by status ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY ord_status ASC, avg_total DESC;

items.question: Which customer segments have more than 1 customer recorded for the month of July 2026? Return segment code and customer count, sorted by count descending then segment code.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS customer_count FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' GROUP BY segment_cd HAVING COUNT(cust_id) > 1 ORDER BY customer_count DESC, segment_cd ASC;

items.question: What is the total order value generated by customers in the NA region during the year 2026? Return the total sum.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(t1.ord_total_amt) AS total_na_sales FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.region_cd = 'NA' AND t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31';

items.question: How many clickstream sessions were initiated on the APP channel compared to WEB? Show channel code and session count, ordered by channel code.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS session_count FROM web_event GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY channel_cd ASC, session_count DESC;

items.question: What are the minimum and maximum start dates among all promotional campaigns?
items.sql: SELECT MIN(starts_dt) AS earliest_promo, MAX(starts_dt) AS latest_promo FROM promo;

items.question: For orders placed in 2026, show the count of orders for each combination of currency and channel. Return currency code, channel code, and order count, ordered by currency and channel.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY currency_cd, channel_cd ORDER BY currency_cd ASC, channel_cd ASC, order_count DESC;

items.question: Which customers have placed more than 1 order in total? Return customer ID and order count, sorted by order count descending then customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY order_count DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the top 3 promotions by the number of distinct orders they were applied to. Return promotion code and order count, ordered by count descending then promo code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS ord_count FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id GROUP BY t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_id ORDER BY ord_count DESC, t1.promo_cd ASC LIMIT 3;

items.question: What is the average order total amount for each customer tier among active customers who signed up in 2022? Return tier code and average order amount, sorted by tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.tier_cd, AVG(t2.ord_total_amt) AS avg_order_amt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 AND t1.signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND t1.signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY t1.tier_cd ORDER BY t1.tier_cd ASC, avg_order_amt DESC;

items.question: For each customer segment in July 2026, what is the total order amount placed by its customers during that same month? Return segment code and total sales, ordered by total sales descending then segment code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.segment_cd, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) AS total_sales FROM cust_segment_hist AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY t1.segment_cd ORDER BY total_sales DESC, t1.segment_cd ASC;

items.question: Count how many web events resulted in a purchase order for each sales region of the customer. Return region code and purchase event count, ordered by count descending then region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.region_cd, COUNT(t1.evt_id) AS purchase_count FROM web_event AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' GROUP BY t2.region_cd ORDER BY purchase_count DESC, t2.region_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the average order amount for orders that used promotions with a discount percentage strictly greater than 15 percent. Return the promotion name and average order amount, sorted by average amount descending then promotion name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, AVG(t3.ord_total_amt) AS avg_ord_amt FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.disc_pct > 15.00 GROUP BY t1.promo_nm, t1.promo_id ORDER BY avg_ord_amt DESC, t1.promo_nm ASC;

items.question: Which sales channels generated more than 5 total orders in the year 2026? Return channel code and order count, ordered by order count descending then channel code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY order_count DESC, channel_cd ASC;

items.question: For each customer tier, what is the count of unique customers who had at least one web event recorded? Return tier code and unique customer count, ordered by tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.tier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id) AS active_web_cust_count FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id GROUP BY t1.tier_cd ORDER BY t1.tier_cd ASC, active_web_cust_count DESC;

items.question: Show the promotion code and promotion name for all active promotions.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt <= '2026-04-01' AND ends_dt >= '2026-04-01';

items.question: List the customer id and signup date for all active customers in the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA';

items.question: Retrieve the event id and session id for all website events that used the app channel.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, session_id FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP';

items.question: Show the order id and order total amount for orders placed using the mobile app channel.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP';

items.question: List the customer id and segment code for customers whose segment was recorded as VIP in January 2026.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-01-01' AND segment_cd = 'VIP';

items.question: Show the promotion name and the count of orders that used each promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t2.ord_id) DESC, t1.promo_nm ASC;

items.question: List the customer name and order date for all orders placed by customers in the VIP segment during May 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.ord_dt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t3.month_dt = '2026-05-01' AND t3.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-05-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-05-31';

items.question: Show the promotion code and the average order total amount for each promotion applied to orders.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, AVG(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd ORDER BY AVG(t3.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.promo_cd ASC;

items.question: List the customer id and the count of web events of type view for each customer.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, COUNT(t2.evt_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.evt_type = 'VIEW' GROUP BY t1.cust_id ORDER BY COUNT(t2.evt_id) DESC, t1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the session id and customer name for web events that resulted in a purchase order.
items.sql: SELECT t1.session_id, t2.cust_nm FROM web_event AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_id IS NOT NULL AND t1.evt_type = 'PURCHASE';

items.question: List the promotion name and total order amount for all orders that used the Black Friday promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.promo_nm = 'Black Friday' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm;

items.question: Show the customer name and segment code for customers whose segment was at risk in July 2026 and who signed up after June 2022.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.segment_cd FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND t1.signup_dt > '2022-06-30';

items.question: List the order id, order total amount, and promotion name for orders placed in April 2026 that used a promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt, t3.promo_nm FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id JOIN promo AS t3 ON t2.promo_id = t3.promo_id WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-04-30';

items.question: Show the region code and the count of customers who were in the new segment in September 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, COUNT(t1.cust_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-09-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'NEW' GROUP BY t1.region_cd ORDER BY COUNT(t1.cust_id) DESC, t1.region_cd ASC;

items.question: List the customer name, loyalty tier code, and the count of web browsing sessions for each active customer.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t1.tier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.session_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, t1.tier_cd ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t2.session_id) DESC, t1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the promotion name and the maximum order total amount among orders that used each promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, MAX(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY MAX(t3.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.promo_nm ASC;

items.question: List the customer id, customer name, and the total order amount for all orders placed by platinum tier customers using the web channel in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'P' AND t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the segment code and the total sum of order amounts for orders placed by customers in that segment during June 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.segment_cd, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_segment_hist AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t1.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND t3.ord_dt >= '2026-06-01' AND t3.ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY t1.segment_cd ORDER BY SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.segment_cd ASC;

items.question: List the customer name, order id, order total amount, and promotion name for orders placed by gold tier customers in the European region who applied a promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.ord_id, t2.ord_total_amt, t4.promo_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id JOIN promo AS t4 ON t3.promo_id = t4.promo_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'G' AND t1.region_cd = 'EU';

items.question: Show the promotion code, discount percentage, and the count of distinct customers who used each promotion on their orders.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, t1.disc_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT t3.cust_id) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd, t1.disc_pct ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t3.cust_id) DESC, t1.promo_cd ASC;

items.question: List the customer name, segment code, and count of web events for customers whose segment was recorded as regular in August 2026 and who performed purchase events.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t2.segment_cd, COUNT(t3.evt_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN web_event AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-08-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'REG' AND t3.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, t2.segment_cd ORDER BY COUNT(t3.evt_id) DESC, t1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the region code, customer name, and the sum of order amounts for active customers in Asia Pacific who placed orders in July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 AND t1.region_cd = 'AP' AND t2.ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND t2.ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.region_cd, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the promotion name, order id, order date, and order total amount for orders over 300 USD equivalent that used a promotion starting in November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, t2.ord_id, t2.ord_dt, t2.ord_total_amt FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t1.promo_id = t3.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t3.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.starts_dt = '2025-11-01' AND t2.ord_total_amt > 300.00;

items.question: Show the customer name, loyalty tier code, promotion name, and order total amount for orders placed by platinum customers using promotions with a discount greater than 15 percent.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t1.tier_cd, t3.promo_nm, t2.ord_total_amt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t4 ON t2.ord_id = t4.ord_id JOIN promo AS t3 ON t4.promo_id = t3.promo_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'P' AND t3.disc_pct > 15.00;

items.question: Show the promotion code and the count of orders that used it for promotions starting after 2026-01-01, ordered by count descending and code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, COUNT(T2.ord_id) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id WHERE T1.starts_dt > '2026-01-01' GROUP BY T1.promo_cd ORDER BY COUNT(T2.ord_id) DESC, T1.promo_cd ASC

items.question: Show the count of distinct customers who had a website event of type PURCHASE in November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00'

items.question: Show the promotion name and the total order amount associated with orders that used each promotion in 2025.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_nm, SUM(T3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND T3.ord_dt <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY T1.promo_nm

items.question: Show the segment code and the count of customer segment history records for the month of July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' GROUP BY segment_cd

items.question: Show the customer name and the count of distinct orders for customers in the AP region who placed orders in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ord_id) FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.region_cd = 'AP' AND T2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND T2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm

items.question: Show the channel code and the count of distinct web events for session records that occurred on 2025-11-01.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT evt_id) FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-11-02 00:00:00' GROUP BY channel_cd

items.question: Show the promotion code and the average order total amount for orders using promotions that end after 2026-01-01, ordered by average amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, AVG(T3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T1.ends_dt > '2026-01-01' GROUP BY T1.promo_cd ORDER BY AVG(T3.ord_total_amt) DESC

items.question: Show the customer name and the count of distinct orders for customers who signed up in July 2022 and were active.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ord_id) FROM cust_master AS T1 LEFT JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.signup_dt >= '2022-07-01' AND T1.signup_dt <= '2022-07-31' AND T1.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm

items.question: Show the promotion name and the count of distinct orders that used each promotion during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ord_id) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND T3.ord_dt <= '2025-11-30' GROUP BY T1.promo_nm

items.question: Show the tier code and the count of customers in each tier.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd

items.question: Show the segment code and the count of distinct customers who held that segment in September 2026.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-09-01' GROUP BY segment_cd

items.question: Show the customer id and the total ord_total_amt for orders placed via WEB channel by customers in the NA region during 2026.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, SUM(T1.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND T2.region_cd = 'NA' AND T1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND T1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY T1.cust_id

items.question: Show the promotion name and the maximum order total amount among orders that used the promotion.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_nm, MAX(T3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id GROUP BY T1.promo_nm

items.question: Show the event type and the count of web events recorded in the app channel.
items.sql: SELECT evt_type, COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' GROUP BY evt_type

items.question: Show the customer name and the total ord_total_amt of all orders for VIP customers in 2026, using their segment history for June 2026.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, SUM(T3.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T1.cust_id = T3.cust_id WHERE T2.month_dt = '2026-06-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND T3.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND T3.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm

items.question: Show the region code and the count of distinct customers who signed up after 2022-06-01.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt > '2022-06-01' GROUP BY region_cd

items.question: Show the promotion code and the count of distinct orders that used promotions with a discount percentage greater than 15.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ord_id) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id WHERE T1.disc_pct > 15.00 GROUP BY T1.promo_cd

items.question: Show the customer name and the count of distinct web events of type VIEW for customers in the EU region during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.evt_id) FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN web_event AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T1.region_cd = 'EU' AND T2.evt_type = 'VIEW' AND T2.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND T2.evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm

items.question: Show the channel code and the count of distinct orders placed in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT ord_id) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd

items.question: Show the promotion name and the sum of order amounts for orders that used promotions starting on or after 2025-11-01, ordered by total amount descending and promotion name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_nm, SUM(T3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T1.starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' GROUP BY T1.promo_nm ORDER BY SUM(T3.ord_total_amt) DESC, T1.promo_nm ASC

items.question: Show the region code and the count of customers who are active.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY region_cd

items.question: Show the promotion code and the count of distinct orders that applied the promotion, restricted to promotions with a discount percentage of 20 or higher.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ord_id) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id WHERE T1.disc_pct >= 20.00 GROUP BY T1.promo_cd

items.question: Show the customer name and the count of distinct web events for customers who are in the RISK segment in August 2026.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.evt_id) FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN web_event AS T3 ON T1.cust_id = T3.cust_id WHERE T2.month_dt = '2026-08-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'RISK' GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm

items.question: Show the order status and the count of orders for each status in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY ord_status

items.question: Show the promotion code and promotion name for all promotions that started between '2025-11-01' and '2026-03-31', ordered by the promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2026-03-31' ORDER BY promo_cd ASC;

items.question: List the customer id and signup date for customers who signed up in the month of July 2022, sorted by signup date ascending, then customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-07-01' AND signup_dt < '2022-08-01' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the order id and order date for orders placed on '2026-04-03', sorted by order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY ord_id ASC;

items.question: List the promotion code and discount percentage for promotions where the end date is on or after '2026-09-01', ordered by discount percentage descending, then promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE ends_dt >= '2026-09-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the customer id and month date for customers whose segment history was recorded in the month of July 2026, ordered by customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, month_dt FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-07-01' ORDER BY cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the session id and event timestamp for web events that occurred on '2025-11-09', ordered by event timestamp ascending, then session id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, evt_ts FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2025-11-09 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-09 23:59:59' ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, session_id ASC;

items.question: Show the order id and order total amount for orders placed in Q2 2026 (from '2026-04-01' to '2026-06-30') that used the WEB channel, ordered by order total amount descending, then order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: List the customer id, customer name, and signup date for platinum tier customers ('P') who signed up between '2022-01-01' and '2022-12-31', ordered by signup date ascending, then customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the promotion code and the count of orders that used each promotion for promotions active in the year 2026 (starts_dt <= '2026-12-31' and ends_dt >= '2026-01-01'), ordered by the order count descending, then promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id WHERE t1.starts_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND t1.ends_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t1.promo_cd ORDER BY COUNT(t2.ord_id) DESC, t1.promo_cd ASC;

items.question: List the customer id and the count of web events of type 'PURCHASE' that occurred between '2025-11-01' and '2025-12-31', ordered by the event count descending, then customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-12-31 23:59:59' AND cust_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the segment code and the count of unique customers who were in that segment during the month of October 2026 ('2026-10-01'), ordered by the customer count descending, then segment code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-10-01' GROUP BY segment_cd ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) DESC, segment_cd ASC;

items.question: List the order id, order date, and the difference in days between '2026-10-31' and the order date (as age_in_days) for orders placed in July 2026 ('2026-07-01' to '2026-07-31'), ordered by order date ascending, then order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, DATEDIFF('2026-10-31', ord_dt) AS age_in_days FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the customer id, customer name, and the count of orders placed by each customer in the year 2026 (between '2026-01-01' and '2026-12-31'), restricted to active customers (is_actv = 1), ordered by the order count descending, then customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY COUNT(t2.ord_id) DESC, t1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the promotion name, promotion code, and total order amount across all orders that used the promotion, for promotions starting on or after '2025-11-01' where total order amount exceeds 300 USD, ordered by total order amount descending, then promotion name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, t1.promo_cd, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm, t1.promo_cd HAVING SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) > 300.00 ORDER BY SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.promo_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the customer id, customer name, and the number of days between their signup date and '2026-10-31' (as membership_days) for active customers in the 'NA' region who signed up before '2022-08-01', ordered by membership_days descending, then customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, DATEDIFF('2026-10-31', signup_dt) AS membership_days FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA' AND signup_dt < '2022-08-01' ORDER BY membership_days DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the promotion code, promotion name, and average order total amount for orders placed between '2025-11-01' and '2026-06-30' that used promotions with a discount percentage greater than or equal to 15.00, ordered by average order amount descending, then promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm, AVG(t3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.disc_pct >= 15.00 AND t3.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY AVG(t3.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.promo_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the customer id, customer name, and the count of distinct web browsing sessions between '2025-11-01' and '2025-12-31' for customers who were in the 'VIP' segment on '2025-12-01', ordered by session count descending, then customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.session_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t3.month_dt = '2025-12-01' AND t3.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND t2.evt_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t2.session_id) DESC, t1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the segment code and the count of customers who transitioned through that segment across all months between '2026-01-01' and '2026-06-30', ordered by the total transition count descending, then segment code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY segment_cd ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, segment_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the customer id and customer name for customers who placed an order in Q1 2026 ('2026-01-01' to '2026-03-31') AND also placed an order in Q2 2026 ('2026-04-01' to '2026-06-30'), ordered by customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' AND t1.cust_id IN (SELECT t3.cust_id FROM ord_hdr AS t3 WHERE t3.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30') ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the promotion code, promotion name, and the count of distinct customers who used the promotion on orders placed between '2025-11-01' and '2026-10-31', ordered by the customer count descending, then promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t3.cust_id) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t3.cust_id) DESC, t1.promo_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the customer id, customer name, and the maximum order total amount for orders placed between '2026-01-01' and '2026-07-31' by customers in the 'AP' region, ordered by maximum order amount descending, then customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, MAX(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.region_cd = 'AP' AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY MAX(t2.ord_total_amt) DESC, t1.cust_id ASC;

items.question: List the order id, order date, and order total amount for orders placed in July 2026 ('2026-07-01' to '2026-07-31') that had web events recorded on the exact same date as the order date, ordered by order date ascending, then order id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' AND DATE(t2.evt_ts) = t1.ord_dt ORDER BY t1.ord_dt ASC, t1.ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the segment code and the average order total amount for orders placed by customers during the month they were in that segment (matching ord_hdr.ord_dt year and month with cust_segment_hist.month_dt), for segments in the year 2026, ordered by average order amount descending, then segment code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.segment_cd, AVG(t1.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id AND YEAR(t1.ord_dt) = YEAR(t2.month_dt) AND MONTH(t1.ord_dt) = MONTH(t2.month_dt) WHERE t2.month_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY t2.segment_cd ORDER BY AVG(t1.ord_total_amt) DESC, t2.segment_cd ASC;

items.question: List the promotion code, promotion name, and total sum of discounts (calculated as ord_total_amt * disc_pct / 100) for orders placed between '2025-11-01' and '2026-03-31', ordered by total discount sum descending, then promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt * t1.disc_pct / 100) FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY SUM(t3.ord_total_amt * t1.disc_pct / 100) DESC, t1.promo_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the order month as YYYY-MM and the total number of orders placed in each month during 2026, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC, order_cnt DESC;

items.question: List each calendar month of 2026 in format YYYY-MM along with the count of new customers who signed up that month, in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') AS signup_month, COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY signup_month ASC, cust_cnt DESC;

items.question: Provide the year and quarter (e.g. 2026-Q1) and the total sum of order amounts in USD for web orders, grouped by quarter in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(h.ord_dt), '-Q', QUARTER(h.ord_dt)) AS ord_quarter, SUM(h.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS total_usd FROM ord_hdr h JOIN fx_rate f ON h.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND h.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE h.channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY YEAR(h.ord_dt), QUARTER(h.ord_dt) ORDER BY ord_quarter ASC, total_usd DESC;

items.question: For web events in 2026, break down the clickstream counts by month (YYYY-MM) and event type, sorted by month ascending then event type ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') AS evt_month, evt_type, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND evt_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m'), evt_type ORDER BY evt_month ASC, evt_type ASC, event_cnt DESC;

items.question: Show each month in 2026 and the count of active VIP customers tracked in the customer segment history for that month, in time order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') AS seg_month, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS vip_cnt FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'VIP' AND month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY seg_month ASC, vip_cnt DESC;

items.question: Calculate the monthly total revenue in USD from app orders across all months in 2026, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, SUM(h.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS monthly_rev_usd FROM ord_hdr h JOIN fx_rate f ON h.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND h.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE h.channel_cd = 'APP' AND h.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC, monthly_rev_usd DESC;

items.question: List the promotion ID, promotion code, and the count of orders that used each promotion, ordered by order count descending then promotion ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_cd, COUNT(op.ord_id) AS usage_cnt FROM promo p LEFT JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_cd ORDER BY usage_cnt DESC, p.promo_id ASC;

items.question: Show the count of customer support tickets opened each month during 2026, formatted as YYYY-MM, in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') AS open_month, COUNT(*) AS tkt_cnt FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND opened_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(opened_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY open_month ASC, tkt_cnt DESC;

items.question: Provide the weekly breakdown of order counts for 2026, showing the year and week number (using YEARWEEK) and the count of orders, ordered by week ascending.
items.sql: SELECT YEARWEEK(ord_dt, 3) AS yr_week, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY YEARWEEK(ord_dt, 3) ORDER BY yr_week ASC, order_cnt DESC;

items.question: For each quarter in 2026, report the average order total amount in USD for orders placed through the store channel, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(h.ord_dt), '-Q', QUARTER(h.ord_dt)) AS ord_quarter, AVG(h.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS avg_amt_usd FROM ord_hdr h JOIN fx_rate f ON h.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND h.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE h.channel_cd = 'STR' AND h.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY YEAR(h.ord_dt), QUARTER(h.ord_dt) ORDER BY ord_quarter ASC, avg_amt_usd DESC;

items.question: List each month in 2026 along with the number of unique customers who placed at least one order in that month, in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS active_cust_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC, active_cust_cnt DESC;

items.question: Show the count of website viewing events recorded each month in 2026, formatted as YYYY-MM, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') AS evt_month, COUNT(*) AS view_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND evt_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY evt_month ASC, view_cnt DESC;

items.question: For each month of 2026, calculate the total refund request amount in USD and list in time order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.req_dt, '%Y-%m') AS rfd_month, SUM(r.rfd_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS total_rfd_usd FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr h ON r.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN fx_rate f ON h.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND r.req_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE r.req_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND r.req_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.req_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY rfd_month ASC, total_rfd_usd DESC;

items.question: Display the sales region code, customer loyalty tier code, and the count of customers, grouped by region and tier, sorted by region ascending then tier ascending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd, tier_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC, tier_cd ASC, cust_cnt DESC;

items.question: For every month in 2026, show the count of newly registered customer segments (segment_cd = 'NEW') in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') AS seg_month, COUNT(*) AS new_seg_cnt FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'NEW' AND month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY seg_month ASC, new_seg_cnt DESC;

items.question: List the promotion name and the total USD value of orders that applied each promotion during 2026, ordered by total USD descending then promotion name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.promo_nm, SUM(h.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS promo_rev_usd FROM promo p JOIN ord_promo op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr h ON op.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN fx_rate f ON h.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND h.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_nm ORDER BY promo_rev_usd DESC, p.promo_nm ASC;

items.question: Provide a monthly summary for 2026 showing the YYYY-MM and the count of distinct sessions that reached the checkout stage on the web, in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') AS sess_month, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS checkout_sess_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND evt_ts < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(evt_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY sess_month ASC, checkout_sess_cnt DESC;

items.question: Show each month in 2026 along with the count of orders that had a status of cancelled ('C'), ordered by month ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC, cancelled_cnt DESC;

items.question: For each sales channel, show the channel code and the total count of orders placed in 2026, sorted by order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY order_cnt DESC, channel_cd ASC;

items.question: List the customer ID and the count of orders for customers who placed more than 3 orders overall, ordered by order count descending then customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY order_cnt DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: Show the product category code and the count of products in each category from the product catalog, ordered by category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_cnt FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC;

items.question: For each month in 2026, calculate the count of customers who were flagged as at-risk ('RISK') in the segment history, in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') AS seg_month, COUNT(*) AS risk_cnt FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'RISK' AND month_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND month_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(month_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY seg_month ASC, risk_cnt DESC;

items.question: Provide the count of orders and the total order amount in USD grouped by order status code for all orders in 2026, ordered by status code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT h.ord_status, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, SUM(h.ord_total_amt * f.rate_to_usd) AS total_usd FROM ord_hdr h JOIN fx_rate f ON h.currency_cd = f.currency_cd AND h.ord_dt = f.eff_dt WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY h.ord_status ORDER BY h.ord_status ASC, total_usd DESC;

items.question: List every month in 2026 (YYYY-MM) with the total quantity of items ordered across all order lines in that month, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND h.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC, total_qty DESC;

items.question: Show the customer id, signup date, and row number ordered by signup date for customers in the AP region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY signup_dt, cust_id) AS row_num FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP'

items.question: List each promotion ID, promotion code, discount percent, and the rank of promotions ordered by discount percent from highest to lowest, breaking ties by promotion ID.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, disc_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_id) AS disc_rank FROM promo

items.question: Show the customer ID, month date, segment code, and the previous month's segment code using LAG for customer C-1001, ordered by month date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, month_dt, segment_cd, LAG(segment_cd, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_dt) AS prev_segment FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001'

items.question: Display the order ID, order date, order total amount, and the next order date using LEAD for customer C-1038, ordered by order date and order ID.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, LEAD(ord_dt, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS next_ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1038'

items.question: Show the customer ID, order date, order total amount, and the running total of order amounts for customer C-1038 ordered by order date and order ID.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1038'

items.question: List the promotion ID, order ID, and a row number partitioned by promotion ID, ordered by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, ord_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_id ORDER BY ord_id) AS rn FROM ord_promo

items.question: Show the event ID, session ID, event timestamp, and the previous event timestamp within the same session for session sess000001, ordered by event timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, session_id, evt_ts, LAG(evt_ts, 1) OVER (ORDER BY evt_ts, evt_id) AS prev_evt_ts FROM web_event WHERE session_id = 'sess000001'

items.question: For each customer in region NA, show customer ID, customer name, signup date, and a dense rank of customers by signup date, breaking ties by customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY signup_dt, cust_id) AS signup_dense_rank FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'NA'

items.question: Show the order ID, order date, channel code, order total amount, and the average order total amount partitioned by channel code.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, channel_cd, ord_total_amt, AVG(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_cd) AS avg_channel_amt FROM ord_hdr

items.question: List customer ID, month date, segment code, and the next month's segment code using LEAD for customer C-1003, ordered by month date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, month_dt, segment_cd, LEAD(segment_cd, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_dt) AS next_segment FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE cust_id = 'C-1003'

items.question: Show the promotion ID, discount percent, and the maximum discount percent across all promotions using an over clause without partitioning.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, disc_pct, MAX(disc_pct) OVER () AS max_disc_pct FROM promo

items.question: For orders placed on 2026-04-03, list the order ID, customer ID, order total amount, and the rank of orders by order total amount descending, breaking ties by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id) AS amt_rank FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-04-03'

items.question: Find the single highest value order for each customer in the ord_hdr table. Show customer ID, order ID, and order total amount, ranked by order total amount descending per customer.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_total_amt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id) AS rnk FROM ord_hdr) t WHERE rnk = 1

items.question: Show each web event ID, session ID, event timestamp, and the time difference in seconds from the previous event within session sess000001, using TIMESTAMPDIFF.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, session_id, evt_ts, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, LAG(evt_ts, 1) OVER (ORDER BY evt_ts, evt_id), evt_ts) AS diff_seconds FROM web_event WHERE session_id = 'sess000001'

items.question: For each loyalty tier, list the tier code, customer ID, signup date, and the row number ordered by signup date.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, cust_id, signup_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tier_cd ORDER BY signup_dt, cust_id) AS tier_rn FROM cust_master

items.question: Show order ID, order date, order total amount, and the difference between the current order total and the previous order total for customer C-1038, ordered by order date and order ID.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, ord_total_amt - LAG(ord_total_amt, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) AS amt_diff FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1038'

items.question: List the promotion ID, promotion code, discount percent, and the cumulative sum of discount percentages ordered by promotion ID.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, disc_pct, SUM(disc_pct) OVER (ORDER BY promo_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_disc_pct FROM promo

items.question: For each promotion, display the promotion ID, order ID, and the total count of orders associated with that promotion using a window count function.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, ord_id, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_id) AS promo_order_count FROM ord_promo

items.question: Find the top 2 most recent web events for each session in the web event log. Show session ID, event ID, event timestamp, and row number.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, evt_id, evt_ts FROM (SELECT session_id, evt_id, evt_ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY evt_ts DESC, evt_id DESC) AS rn FROM web_event) t WHERE rn <= 2

items.question: Show order ID, order date, currency code, order total amount, and the running total of order amounts partitioned by currency code, ordered by order date and order ID.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, currency_cd, ord_total_amt, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY currency_cd ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_currency_total FROM ord_hdr

items.question: For customer C-1001, list month date, segment code, and the segment code from two months prior using LAG with an offset of 2, ordered by month date.
items.sql: SELECT month_dt, segment_cd, LAG(segment_cd, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_dt) AS segment_two_months_ago FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001'

items.question: Calculate the percentage contribution of each order's total amount relative to the total sum of all order amounts across the entire ord_hdr table. Show order ID, order total amount, and the percentage.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt, (ord_total_amt / SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER ()) * 100 AS pct_of_total FROM ord_hdr

items.question: For each customer segment history record in 2026, show customer ID, month date, segment code, and the dense rank of months within each customer's history ordered by month date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, month_dt, segment_cd, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY month_dt) AS month_rank FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt >= '2026-01-01'

items.question: Find the single latest web event for each customer who has logged in (where customer ID is not null). Show customer ID, session ID, event ID, and event timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, session_id, evt_id, evt_ts FROM (SELECT cust_id, session_id, evt_id, evt_ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY evt_ts DESC, evt_id DESC) AS rn FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL) t WHERE rn = 1

items.question: Show the promotion code and the number of orders it was applied to, ordered by the count descending then code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, COUNT(T2.ord_id) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id GROUP BY T1.promo_cd ORDER BY COUNT(T2.ord_id) DESC, T1.promo_cd ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for customers who are currently in the VIP segment as of 2026-10-01, sorted by customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.month_dt = '2026-10-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY T1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the event type and the total number of website and app events recorded in the system, ordered by event type ascending.
items.sql: SELECT evt_type, COUNT(*) FROM web_event GROUP BY evt_type ORDER BY evt_type ASC

items.question: What is the count of orders placed through the WEB channel that used the promotion code BF25? Show just the single count value.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.ord_id) FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id JOIN promo AS T3 ON T2.promo_id = T3.promo_id WHERE T1.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND T3.promo_cd = 'BF25'

items.question: Show the loyalty tier code and the count of customers in each tier, ordered by count descending then tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, tier_cd ASC

items.question: List the promotion name and the discount percentage for all promotions that started on or after 2026-01-01, ordered by discount percentage descending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC

items.question: Find the average order total amount for orders that used any promotion, grouped by order channel code. Show channel code and average amount, ordered by channel code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.channel_cd, AVG(T1.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id GROUP BY T1.channel_cd ORDER BY T1.channel_cd ASC

items.question: Show the promotion code and total order revenue generated by orders using each promotion, filtering for promotions that have generated over 500 total amount in USD equivalent or raw order total. Show promo code and sum of order total, ordered by sum descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_cd, SUM(T3.ord_total_amt) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id GROUP BY T1.promo_cd HAVING SUM(T3.ord_total_amt) > 500 ORDER BY SUM(T3.ord_total_amt) DESC

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for customers who have placed more than 2 orders using a promotion, ordered by customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm HAVING COUNT(T3.ord_id) > 2 ORDER BY T1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the segment code and the number of unique customers who were in that segment for the month of 2026-09-01, ordered by count descending then segment code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-09-01' GROUP BY segment_cd ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) DESC, segment_cd ASC

items.question: Find promotions that were applied to orders placed on or after 2026-04-01. Show the promotion name and the count of such orders, ordered by count descending then promotion name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.promo_nm, COUNT(T2.ord_id) FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' GROUP BY T1.promo_nm ORDER BY COUNT(T2.ord_id) DESC, T1.promo_nm ASC

items.question: For each customer tier, calculate the average number of web events per customer session that involved browsing products. Show tier code and average event count, ordered by tier code ascending.
items.sql: WITH SessionCounts AS (SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.session_id, COUNT(*) AS ev_cnt FROM web_event AS T1 WHERE T1.cust_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1.cust_id, T1.session_id) SELECT T2.tier_cd, AVG(T1.ev_cnt) FROM SessionCounts AS T1 JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id GROUP BY T2.tier_cd ORDER BY T2.tier_cd ASC

items.question: Identify customers who transitioned from segment REG in 2026-08-01 to VIP in 2026-09-01. Show their customer ID and customer name, ordered by customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T3 ON T1.cust_id = T3.cust_id WHERE T2.month_dt = '2026-08-01' AND T2.segment_cd = 'REG' AND T3.month_dt = '2026-09-01' AND T3.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY T1.cust_id ASC

items.question: What percentage of all active customers (is_actv = 1) were in the VIP segment as of 2026-07-01? Show the percentage value.
items.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.segment_cd = 'VIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(T1.cust_id) FROM cust_master AS T1 LEFT JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id AND T2.month_dt = '2026-07-01' WHERE T1.is_actv = 1

items.question: Find promotions that have a higher discount percentage than the average discount percentage of all promotions starting in 2026. Show promotion code, promotion name, and discount percentage, ordered by discount percentage descending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > (SELECT AVG(disc_pct) FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND starts_dt < '2027-01-01') ORDER BY disc_pct DESC

items.question: Using a CTE, find the total order amount per customer for orders placed after 2026-03-01, then list the customer ID, customer name, and total amount for customers whose total exceeds 400. Sort by total amount descending.
items.sql: WITH CustTotals AS (SELECT cust_id, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS tot_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt > '2026-03-01' GROUP BY cust_id) SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm, T2.tot_amt FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN CustTotals AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.tot_amt > 400 ORDER BY T2.tot_amt DESC

items.question: Compare order volume: find the count of orders placed in April 2026 versus June 2026. Show the month starting date and the order count, ordered by month starting date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT '2026-04-01' AS month_dt, COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' UNION ALL SELECT '2026-06-01' AS month_dt, COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-06-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-06-30' ORDER BY month_dt ASC

items.question: Find customers who have never used any promotion on any of their orders. Show their customer ID and customer name, ordered by customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_id FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.ord_id = T2.ord_id) ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Using a two-step CTE, first calculate the total number of web events per customer, then find the average event count across all customers who have at least one web event. Show just that single average value.
items.sql: WITH CustomerEvents AS (SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS ev_count FROM web_event WHERE cust_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cust_id) SELECT AVG(ev_count) FROM CustomerEvents

items.question: For each sales region, calculate the percentage of customers who are in the platinum tier (tier_cd = 'P'). Show region code, total customers in region, platinum customers count, and the percentage, ordered by region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_cust, SUM(CASE WHEN tier_cd = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS plat_cust, (SUM(CASE WHEN tier_cd = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS plat_pct FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC

items.question: Find the top 3 promotions by total order value generated using a CTE to aggregate first. Show promotion code and total order value, ordered by total value descending.
items.sql: WITH PromoRevenue AS (SELECT T1.promo_cd, SUM(T3.ord_total_amt) AS rev FROM promo AS T1 JOIN ord_promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id GROUP BY T1.promo_cd) SELECT promo_cd, rev FROM PromoRevenue ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 3

items.question: List sessions that recorded a PURCHASE event after viewing a product. Show session ID, customer ID, and the count of events in that session, ordered by session ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.session_id, T1.cust_id, COUNT(*) FROM web_event AS T1 WHERE T1.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE') GROUP BY T1.session_id, T1.cust_id ORDER BY T1.session_id ASC

items.question: Calculate the monthly retention/movement: find the count of customers in each segment for 2026-06-01 and compare with 2026-07-01 by listing segment code, month date, and customer count, ordered by segment code ascending then month date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT segment_cd, month_dt, COUNT(cust_id) FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt IN ('2026-06-01', '2026-07-01') GROUP BY segment_cd, month_dt ORDER BY segment_cd ASC, month_dt ASC

items.question: Find customers who placed orders totaling more than the overall average order total across all orders in the system. Show customer ID, customer name, and order ID for those orders, ordered by customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_id, T1.cust_nm, T2.ord_id FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY T1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer id and customer name for customers in the NA region who belong to the platinum loyalty tier.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'NA' AND tier_cd = 'P';

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for all active customers in the EU region who signed up before 2023-01-01.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'EU' AND signup_dt < '2023-01-01';

items.question: What are the promotion ID, promotion code, and promotion name for all promotions that offer a discount percentage greater than 15?
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00;

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name of all customers whose customer segment in July 2026 was VIP.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP';

items.question: List the customer ID, customer name, and signup date for customers who placed at least one order through the mobile app channel.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, t1.signup_dt FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'APP';

items.question: Find the promotion ID and promotion name for promotions that were applied to orders placed on 2026-04-03.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.ord_dt = '2026-04-03';

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name of customers who have ever placed an order using the 'BF25' promotion code.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id JOIN promo AS t4 ON t3.promo_id = t4.promo_id WHERE t4.promo_cd = 'BF25';

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who had website events with the 'CHECKOUT' event type during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t2.evt_type = 'CHECKOUT' AND t2.evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND t2.evt_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00';

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for customers who were segmented as 'NEW' in November 2025 and 'REG' in December 2025.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2025-11-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'NEW' INTERSECT SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2025-12-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'REG';

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name of active customers who placed an order in 2026 but have never requested a refund.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01') AND cust_id NOT IN (SELECT t1.cust_id FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN refund_req AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id);

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for gold tier customers who have used the 'BACK2SCH' promotion but have never used the 'SUMMER10' promotion.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id JOIN promo AS t4 ON t3.promo_id = t4.promo_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'G' AND t4.promo_cd = 'BACK2SCH' EXCEPT SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id JOIN promo AS t4 ON t3.promo_id = t4.promo_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'G' AND t4.promo_cd = 'SUMMER10';

items.question: Find the customer ID and customer name of platinum customers who placed orders through both the 'WEB' channel and the 'APP' channel.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'P' AND t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' INTERSECT SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'P' AND t2.channel_cd = 'APP';

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who viewed product 'ELC-024' on the web and also added product 'ELC-024' to their cart on the web.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t2.sku = 'ELC-024' AND t2.evt_type = 'VIEW' INTERSECT SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t2.sku = 'ELC-024' AND t2.evt_type = 'CART';

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for customers in the 'AP' region who placed orders in 2026 but do not have any support tickets recorded.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' AND cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01') AND cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM support_tkt);

items.question: Find all customer IDs and names for customers who were segmented as 'VIP' in July 2026 and also segmented as 'VIP' in August 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP' INTERSECT SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-08-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP';

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who placed orders using promotion code 'FLASH30' but never placed an order using 'NEWYEAR'.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id JOIN promo AS t4 ON t3.promo_id = t4.promo_id WHERE t4.promo_cd = 'FLASH30' EXCEPT SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id JOIN promo AS t4 ON t3.promo_id = t4.promo_id WHERE t4.promo_cd = 'NEWYEAR';

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for customers who have logged website purchase events originating from both 'WEB' and 'APP' channels.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND t2.channel_cd = 'WEB' INTERSECT SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND t2.channel_cd = 'APP';

items.question: Find the customer ID and customer name of standard tier customers who have placed orders with a total amount greater than 500 USD.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'S' AND t2.ord_total_amt > 500.00;

items.question: Show the promotion ID and promotion name for all promotions that started on or after 2026-01-01 and ended on or before 2026-12-31.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ends_dt <= '2026-12-31';

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for customers who have an active status and were segmented as 'RISK' at any point in their history.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 AND t2.segment_cd = 'RISK';

items.question: Find all customer IDs and names for customers who are in the LA region or whose tier is platinum.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'LA' UNION SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P';

items.question: Show the customer ID and customer name for customers who have placed orders in currency 'EUR' but never in currency 'GBP'.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.currency_cd = 'EUR' EXCEPT SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.currency_cd = 'GBP';

items.question: List the customer ID and customer name for customers who have web events for product 'ELC-025' but do not have any orders associated with them.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN web_event AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.sku = 'ELC-025' AND t1.cust_id NOT IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ord_hdr);

items.question: Find the customer ID and customer name for customers who placed orders on 2026-01-08 using the web channel.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.ord_dt = '2026-01-08' AND t2.channel_cd = 'WEB';

items.question: Which customer segment had the latest history record for customer 'C-1001'? Show the month date and segment code.
items.sql: SELECT month_dt, segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001' ORDER BY month_dt DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: What are the promotion code and name for promotion ID 3? Show the promo code and promo name.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE promo_id = 3

items.question: Show the order ID and order date for all orders placed by customer 'C-1006' sorted by order date descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1006' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: List the customer ID and sign-up date for all active customers in the North America region ('NA'). Show customer ID and signup date, ordered by sign-up date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Find all web events for session 'sess000001'. Show the event ID, event timestamp, and event type.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, evt_ts, evt_type FROM web_event WHERE session_id = 'sess000001' ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC

items.question: Show the promotion code and discount percentage for all promotions that give a discount strictly greater than 15 percent, ordered by discount percentage descending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_cd ASC

items.question: What is the order date and total amount for the most recent order placed through the web channel ('WEB')? Show order date and order total amount.
items.sql: SELECT ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Find all customers who have never placed an order. Show the customer ID and customer name ordered by customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr AS t2 WHERE t2.cust_id = t1.cust_id) ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find promotions that were never applied to any order. Show the promotion code and promotion name ordered by promotion ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, t1.promo_nm FROM promo AS t1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_promo AS t2 WHERE t2.promo_id = t1.promo_id) ORDER BY t1.promo_id ASC

items.question: Show the customer ID, customer name, and loyalty tier for customers whose signup date is later than the signup date of customer 'C-1002', ordered by customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt > (SELECT signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id = 'C-1002') ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Find all orders whose total amount is greater than the average order total amount for all orders placed on the exact same order date. Show order ID, order date, and order total amount, ordered by order date.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 WHERE t1.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(t2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS t2 WHERE t2.ord_dt = t1.ord_dt) ORDER BY t1.ord_dt ASC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: Find the web events that occurred during the latest browsing session for customer 'C-1001'. Show the event ID, event timestamp, and event type, sorted by event timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, evt_ts, evt_type FROM web_event WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001' AND session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM web_event WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001' ORDER BY evt_ts DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC

items.question: For each customer, find their latest segment history record (by month date). Show the customer ID, month date, and segment code for those whose latest segment is VIP ('VIP'), ordered by customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.month_dt, t1.segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist AS t1 WHERE t1.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND t1.month_dt = (SELECT MAX(t2.month_dt) FROM cust_segment_hist AS t2 WHERE t2.cust_id = t1.cust_id) ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Which customers have placed at least one order where the order total amount exceeds the overall average order total amount across all orders? Show customer ID and customer name, ordered by customer name.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS c JOIN ord_hdr AS o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY c.cust_nm ASC, c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find all products that have never been viewed on the web or app (no web_event with evt_type 'VIEW'). Show the SKU and product name, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event AS w WHERE w.sku = p.sku AND w.evt_type = 'VIEW') ORDER BY p.sku ASC

items.question: Identify orders that have a promotion applied, but the order total amount is less than or equal to the average order total amount of all orders that used the exact same promotion ID. Show the order ID and promotion ID, ordered by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT op.ord_id, op.promo_id FROM ord_promo AS op JOIN ord_hdr AS oh ON op.ord_id = oh.ord_id WHERE oh.ord_total_amt <= (SELECT AVG(oh2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_promo AS op2 JOIN ord_hdr AS oh2 ON op2.ord_id = oh2.ord_id WHERE op2.promo_id = op.promo_id) ORDER BY op.ord_id ASC, op.promo_id ASC

items.question: Find all web event sessions that include a PURCHASE event but never had any CART event in that same session. Show the session ID and channel code, ordered by session ID.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT w1.session_id, w1.channel_cd FROM web_event AS w1 WHERE w1.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_event AS w2 WHERE w2.session_id = w1.session_id AND w2.evt_type = 'CART') ORDER BY w1.session_id ASC

items.question: Find the highest total amount ever ordered by each customer tier. Show the tier code and the maximum order total amount, ordered by tier code.
items.sql: SELECT c.tier_cd, MAX(o.ord_total_amt) FROM cust_master AS c JOIN ord_hdr AS o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY c.tier_cd ASC

items.question: Find all customers who are currently in the 'RISK' segment as of their most recent segment history record, but whose first ever segment history record was 'VIP'. Show customer ID and customer name, ordered by customer ID.
