items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cust_segment_hist AS h WHERE h.cust_id = c.cust_id AND h.month_dt = (SELECT MAX(h2.month_dt) FROM cust_segment_hist AS h2 WHERE h2.cust_id = c.cust_id) AND h.segment_cd = 'RISK') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cust_segment_hist AS h WHERE h.cust_id = c.cust_id AND h.month_dt = (SELECT MIN(h2.month_dt) FROM cust_segment_hist AS h2 WHERE h2.cust_id = c.cust_id) AND h.segment_cd = 'VIP') ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find promotions that were used on orders whose total amount was strictly higher than the maximum order total amount of all orders that did NOT use any promotion. Show the promotion ID and promotion name, ordered by promotion ID.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.promo_id, p.promo_nm FROM promo AS p JOIN ord_promo AS op ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS oh ON op.ord_id = oh.ord_id WHERE oh.ord_total_amt > (SELECT MAX(oh2.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS oh2 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_promo AS op2 WHERE op2.ord_id = oh2.ord_id)) ORDER BY p.promo_id ASC

items.question: Find all customers who have placed an order in every single calendar year that appears in the ord_hdr table (or specifically for years 2025 and 2026 present in data). Show customer ID and customer name, ordered by customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(ord_dt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) IN (2025, 2026) EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(o.ord_dt) FROM ord_hdr AS o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id) ORDER BY c.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find web events for customers who have a platinum tier ('P') and whose event timestamp matches the maximum event timestamp recorded for that specific customer. Show the customer ID, session ID, and event timestamp, ordered by event timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT w.cust_id, w.session_id, w.evt_ts FROM web_event AS w JOIN cust_master AS c ON w.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE c.tier_cd = 'P' AND w.evt_ts = (SELECT MAX(w2.evt_ts) FROM web_event AS w2 WHERE w2.cust_id = w.cust_id) ORDER BY w.evt_ts ASC, w.cust_id ASC

items.question: Find all orders where the order total amount is greater than the total amount of the immediately preceding order placed by the same customer (ordered by order date and order ID). Show the order ID, customer ID, and order total amount, ordered by order date.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.cust_id, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 WHERE t1.ord_total_amt > (SELECT t2.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t2 WHERE t2.cust_id = t1.cust_id AND (t2.ord_dt < t1.ord_dt OR (t2.ord_dt = t1.ord_dt AND t2.ord_id < t1.ord_id)) ORDER BY t2.ord_dt DESC, t2.ord_id DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY t1.ord_dt ASC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: Find the promotion codes that have been used by customers from all four sales regions ('NA', 'EU', 'AP', 'LA'). Show the promotion ID and promotion code, ordered by promotion ID.
items.sql: SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_cd FROM promo AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT region_cd FROM (SELECT 'NA' AS region_cd UNION SELECT 'EU' UNION SELECT 'AP' UNION SELECT 'LA') AS r WHERE r.region_cd NOT IN (SELECT c.region_cd FROM ord_promo AS op JOIN ord_hdr AS oh ON op.ord_id = oh.ord_id JOIN cust_master AS c ON oh.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE op.promo_id = p.promo_id)) ORDER BY p.promo_id ASC

items.question: Show the count of orders placed through the WEB channel versus the APP channel for customer tier 'P' since 2026-01-01.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t1.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.channel_cd = 'APP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS app_count FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.tier_cd = 'P' AND t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01'

items.question: For customers in sales region 'NA', count how many orders have status 'S' versus status 'C' in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t1.ord_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipped_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.ord_status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_count FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.region_cd = 'NA' AND t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31'

items.question: Give me the total number of website events that were 'VIEW' actions versus 'CART' actions for channel 'WEB' in October 2026.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'CART' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cart_cnt FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_ts >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2026-10-31 23:59:59'

items.question: Show the count of customers who have segment 'VIP' versus segment 'RISK' for the month of 2026-09-01.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN segment_cd = 'VIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vip_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN segment_cd = 'RISK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS risk_cnt FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE month_dt = '2026-09-01'

items.question: List each customer tier and the count of their customers split into active (is_actv = 1) and inactive (is_actv = 0). Show the tier code, active count, and inactive count, ordered by tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactive_cnt FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC

items.question: Show the sales region code, the total count of orders, and the count of orders that used currency 'USD' for all orders placed in 2026. Order by region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.region_cd, COUNT(t1.ord_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.currency_cd = 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usd_orders FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t2.region_cd ORDER BY t2.region_cd ASC

items.question: For each loyalty tier of customers, show the tier code, total distinct customers, and the count of distinct customers who signed up in or after 2022-07-01. Order by tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS total_cust, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN signup_dt >= '2022-07-01' THEN cust_id END) AS recent_signup_cust FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC

items.question: Give me a breakdown by region code showing the region, total customer count, and the count of customers currently marked active (is_actv = 1). Order by region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_customers FROM cust_master GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC

items.question: Show the promotion id, promotion name, total count of orders that used the promotion, and the count of those orders that belong to currency 'USD'. Order by promotion id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS total_used, SUM(CASE WHEN t3.currency_cd = 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usd_orders FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY t1.promo_id ASC

items.question: For each sales channel, show the channel code, total order count, and the sum of order totals for orders with status 'D' (delivered) placed in 2026. Order by channel code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(ord_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN ord_status = 'D' THEN ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY channel_cd ASC

items.question: Show the customer id, customer name, total number of orders placed, and the count of orders that were cancelled ('C') for customers in tier 'P'. Order by customer id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.ord_status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'P' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: For each customer segment in the month of 2026-07-01, show the segment code, total customer count, and the count of customers who belong to region 'NA'. Order by segment code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.segment_cd, COUNT(t1.cust_id) AS total_cust, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.region_cd = 'NA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS na_cust_cnt FROM cust_segment_hist AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.month_dt = '2026-07-01' GROUP BY t1.segment_cd ORDER BY t1.segment_cd ASC

items.question: For every promotion, display the promotion code, the discount percentage, total orders applied, and the ratio of orders applied in currency 'USD' as a percentage (USD orders divided by total orders multiplied by 100). Order by promotion id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_cd, t1.disc_pct, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS total_orders, (SUM(CASE WHEN t3.currency_cd = 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS usd_pct FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd, t1.disc_pct ORDER BY t1.promo_id ASC

items.question: For each customer loyalty tier, calculate the total number of orders, the count of orders placed via channel 'WEB', the count of orders placed via channel 'APP', and the WEB order share percentage (WEB orders / total orders * 100). Order by tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.tier_cd, COUNT(t1.ord_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.channel_cd = 'APP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS app_orders, (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(t1.ord_id) AS web_share_pct FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id GROUP BY t2.tier_cd ORDER BY t2.tier_cd ASC

items.question: Show each sales region, the total number of distinct customers, the count of distinct customers who had at least one order with status 'S', and the conversion rate percentage (customers with status 'S' divided by total customers multiplied by 100). Order by region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id) AS total_cust, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t2.ord_status = 'S' THEN t1.cust_id END) AS shipped_cust, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t2.ord_status = 'S' THEN t1.cust_id END) * 100.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id) AS conversion_rate FROM cust_master AS t1 LEFT JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id GROUP BY t1.region_cd ORDER BY t1.region_cd ASC

items.question: For each customer segment in month 2026-06-01, show the segment code, total distinct customers, the count of distinct active customers (is_actv = 1), and the active customer percentage. Order by segment code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.segment_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id) AS total_cust, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t2.is_actv = 1 THEN t1.cust_id END) AS active_cust, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t2.is_actv = 1 THEN t1.cust_id END) * 100.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT t1.cust_id) AS active_pct FROM cust_segment_hist AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.month_dt = '2026-06-01' GROUP BY t1.segment_cd ORDER BY t1.segment_cd ASC

items.question: For every promotion, output the promotion name, total orders, count of orders with status 'D' (delivered), count of orders with status 'C' (cancelled), and the success rate percentage (delivered orders divided by total orders multiplied by 100). Order by promotion id ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN t3.ord_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN t3.ord_status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders, (SUM(CASE WHEN t3.ord_status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS success_rate_pct FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY t1.promo_id ASC

items.question: For each customer tier, display the tier code, total order amount across all orders, total order amount for orders with currency 'USD', and the USD amount share percentage. Order by tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.tier_cd, SUM(t1.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.currency_cd = 'USD' THEN t1.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS usd_amt, (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.currency_cd = 'USD' THEN t1.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / SUM(t1.ord_total_amt) AS usd_share_pct FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id GROUP BY t2.tier_cd ORDER BY t2.tier_cd ASC

items.question: For each sales region, show the region code, total order count, count of orders with status 'S', count of orders with status 'R', and the return rate percentage (returned orders divided by total orders multiplied by 100). Order by region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.region_cd, COUNT(t1.ord_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.ord_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipped_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.ord_status = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_orders, (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.ord_status = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(t1.ord_id) AS return_rate_pct FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id GROUP BY t2.region_cd ORDER BY t2.region_cd ASC

items.question: For each channel in web events during 2026, show the channel code, total web events, count of 'VIEW' events, count of 'PURCHASE' events, and the purchase conversion percentage (purchase events divided by view events multiplied by 100). Order by channel code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(evt_id) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_events, SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_events, (SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN evt_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS conversion_pct FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2026-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY channel_cd ASC

items.question: Show each customer segment for month 2026-08-01 with total customers, count of customers in region 'EU', count of customers in region 'NA', and the EU customer share percentage. Order by segment code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.segment_cd, COUNT(t1.cust_id) AS total_cust, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.region_cd = 'EU' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eu_cust, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.region_cd = 'NA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS na_cust, (SUM(CASE WHEN t2.region_cd = 'EU' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(t1.cust_id) AS eu_share_pct FROM cust_segment_hist AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.month_dt = '2026-08-01' GROUP BY t1.segment_cd ORDER BY t1.segment_cd ASC

items.question: For each customer tier, show the tier code, total customers, count of active customers (is_actv = 1), count of inactive customers (is_actv = 0), and the active ratio percentage (active customers divided by total customers multiplied by 100). Order by tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS total_cust, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_cust, SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactive_cust, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_actv = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(cust_id) AS active_ratio_pct FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC

items.question: For each customer tier, display the tier code, total number of orders placed in 2026, count of orders with status 'N' (new), count of orders with status 'S' (shipped), and the percentage of shipped orders among all orders. Order by tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.tier_cd, COUNT(t1.ord_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.ord_status = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.ord_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shipped_orders, (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.ord_status = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(t1.ord_id) AS shipped_pct FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t2.tier_cd ORDER BY t2.tier_cd ASC

items.question: For each sales region, show the region code, total order amount in 2026, total order amount for WEB channel, total order amount for APP channel, and the WEB amount share percentage. Order by region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.region_cd, SUM(t1.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN t1.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS web_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN t1.channel_cd = 'APP' THEN t1.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) AS app_amt, (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.channel_cd = 'WEB' THEN t1.ord_total_amt ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / SUM(t1.ord_total_amt) AS web_amt_share_pct FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND t1.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY t2.region_cd ORDER BY t2.region_cd ASC

items.question: A promotion user is a customer who placed an order using a promotion where the promo code is 'BF25'. Show the customer ID and customer name for all promotion users.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id JOIN promo AS t4 ON t3.promo_id = t4.promo_id WHERE t4.promo_cd = 'BF25'

items.question: A web session is considered a browsing session if it recorded at least one website event with channel code 'WEB'. Show the session ID and event timestamp for the first event of each web session that occurred on '2025-11-01'.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, MIN(evt_ts) FROM web_event WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND DATE(evt_ts) = '2025-11-01' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY session_id

items.question: A VIP customer for a given month is defined as a customer record whose segment code in the monthly history table is 'VIP'. Show the customer ID and customer name for every VIP customer in the month of July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'VIP' ORDER BY t1.cust_id

items.question: A high-value order is an order header whose total amount in its order currency is strictly greater than 500. Show the order ID, order total amount, and currency code for all high-value orders placed in April 2026.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt, currency_cd FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > 500.00 AND ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id

items.question: A returning customer session is any web or app session associated with a logged-in customer whose signup date is strictly before '2025-01-01'. Show the session ID and customer ID for all returning customer sessions recorded on '2025-11-01'.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.session_id, t1.cust_id FROM web_event AS t1 JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.cust_id IS NOT NULL AND t2.signup_dt < '2025-01-01' AND DATE(t1.evt_ts) = '2025-11-01' ORDER BY t1.session_id

items.question: An active platinum customer is a customer record marked as active where the loyalty tier code is 'P'. Show the customer ID, customer name, and signup date for all active platinum customers.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND tier_cd = 'P' ORDER BY signup_dt, cust_id

items.question: A discount promotion is any promotion record where the discount percentage is greater than or equal to 20. Show the promotion code and promotion name for all discount promotions active during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct >= 20.00 AND starts_dt <= '2025-11-30' AND ends_dt >= '2025-11-01' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_cd

items.question: An app purchase order is an order header placed through the mobile app channel ('APP') that has a status of delivered ('D'). Show the order ID, customer ID, and order total amount for all app purchase orders placed in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_status = 'D' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-10-31' ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id

items.question: A multi-promo order is an order header that has had more than one promotion applied to it according to the promotion mapping table. Show the order ID and the count of promotions applied for all multi-promo orders.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(promo_id) AS promo_cnt FROM ord_promo GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(promo_id) > 1 ORDER BY promo_cnt DESC, ord_id

items.question: A risk-segment customer is a customer who held the risk segment code ('RISK') in their history for the month of September 2026. Show the customer ID and customer name for every risk-segment customer in that month.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.month_dt = '2026-09-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'RISK' ORDER BY t1.cust_id

items.question: A converted clickstream session is a browsing session that contains at least one clickstream event of type 'PURCHASE'. Show the session ID and the count of purchase events for every converted clickstream session occurring in November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS purchase_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY purchase_cnt DESC, session_id

items.question: An unpromoted large order is an order header with a total amount greater than 400 that does not appear in the order promotion table. Show the order ID, order date, and order total amount for all unpromoted large orders.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt, t1.ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 LEFT JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_total_amt > 400.00 AND t2.ord_id IS NULL ORDER BY t1.ord_total_amt DESC, t1.ord_id

items.question: A newly signed customer is a customer record whose signup date falls between '2022-07-01' and '2022-07-31' inclusive. Show the customer ID, customer name, and sales region code for all newly signed customers.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, region_cd FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-07-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-07-31' ORDER BY signup_dt, cust_id

items.question: A seasonal promotion is a promotion whose name contains the word 'offer' (case-insensitive search). Show the promotion ID, promotion code, and start date for all seasonal promotions starting in the year 2026.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, starts_dt FROM promo WHERE promo_nm LIKE '%offer%' AND starts_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND starts_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY starts_dt, promo_id

items.question: A browser product view event is a clickstream event where the event type is 'VIEW' and the channel code is 'WEB'. Show the product SKU and the total number of browser product view events for each SKU recorded in 2025.
items.sql: SELECT sku, COUNT(*) AS view_cnt FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND sku IS NOT NULL AND evt_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts <= '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY view_cnt DESC, sku

items.question: A regional web customer is an active customer from the North America region ('NA') who has signed up prior to '2022-06-01'. Show the customer ID and customer name for all regional web customers.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'NA' AND is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt < '2022-06-01' ORDER BY cust_id

items.question: A segment-transitioning customer is a customer who held the 'NEW' segment code in August 2026 and the 'REG' segment code in September 2026. Show the customer ID for all segment-transitioning customers.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id FROM cust_segment_hist AS t1 JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.month_dt = '2026-08-01' AND t1.segment_cd = 'NEW' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-09-01' AND t2.segment_cd = 'REG' ORDER BY t1.cust_id

items.question: A promotional order header is an order header that used a promotion with discount percentage equal to 15.00. Show the order ID, customer ID, and order date for all promotional order headers.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.ord_id, t1.cust_id, t1.ord_dt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id JOIN promo AS t3 ON t2.promo_id = t3.promo_id WHERE t3.disc_pct = 15.00 ORDER BY t1.ord_dt, t1.ord_id

items.question: A web cart addition event is a clickstream event where the event type is 'CART' and the channel code is 'WEB'. Show the session ID, event timestamp, and product SKU for all web cart addition events on '2025-11-09'.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, evt_ts, sku FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND DATE(evt_ts) = '2025-11-09' ORDER BY evt_ts, session_id

items.question: A top-tier customer is a customer record whose loyalty tier code is 'P' or 'G'. Show the customer ID, customer name, and tier code for all top-tier customers in the Asia Pacific region ('AP').
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' AND tier_cd IN ('P', 'G') ORDER BY tier_cd, cust_id

items.question: A multi-event browsing session is any web session that generated 4 or more clickstream events in total. Show the session ID and the total event count for every multi-event browsing session.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM web_event GROUP BY session_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ORDER BY event_cnt DESC, session_id

items.question: An inactive standard customer is a customer record who is inactive (is_actv = 0) and belongs to the standard tier ('S'). Show the customer ID, customer name, and signup date for all inactive standard customers.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 0 AND tier_cd = 'S' ORDER BY signup_dt, cust_id

items.question: A promotional discount revenue generator is any promotion that was applied to orders with a cumulative total order amount exceeding 1000 across all its usages. Show the promotion ID, promotion code, and the total order amount sum for all such promotions.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd, SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) AS total_revenue FROM promo AS t1 JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_cd HAVING SUM(t3.ord_total_amt) > 1000.00 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, t1.promo_id

items.question: A loyalty campaign promotion is any promotion whose code starts with the letters 'LOYAL'. Show the promotion ID, promotion name, discount percentage, and end date for all loyalty campaign promotions.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_nm, disc_pct, ends_dt FROM promo WHERE promo_cd LIKE 'LOYAL%' ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_id

items.question: Show the employee name and employee id for everyone who reports directly to Amara Singh (E-001).
items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_nm, t1.emp_id FROM emp AS t1 JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.mgr_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t2.emp_nm = 'Amara Singh' ORDER BY t1.emp_id

items.question: List the employee id and full name of all staff members whose manager is E-002, ordered alphabetically by their name.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-002' ORDER BY emp_nm, emp_id

items.question: What is the total count of direct reports for each manager? Show the manager's employee id and the count of subordinates, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT mgr_emp_id, COUNT(*) FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mgr_emp_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, mgr_emp_id

items.question: Show the department code and the total number of employees in that department.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd ORDER BY dept_cd

items.question: List the full name and department code of employees who were hired in the year 2019, ordered by hire date.
items.sql: SELECT emp_nm, dept_cd FROM emp WHERE hire_dt >= '2019-01-01' AND hire_dt <= '2019-12-31' ORDER BY hire_dt, emp_id

items.question: Show the employee id and name for employees who do not have any direct reports (i.e. they are not listed as a manager for anyone in the emp table).
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE emp_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY emp_id

items.question: For the employee named Chloe Whitaker, find the name of her direct manager. Show Chloe's name and her manager's name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_nm, t2.emp_nm FROM emp AS t1 JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.mgr_emp_id = t2.emp_id WHERE t1.emp_nm = 'Chloe Whitaker'

items.question: Find all employees who sit in the same department as employee E-003, displaying their employee id and name, excluding E-003 themselves.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = (SELECT dept_cd FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-003') AND emp_id <> 'E-003' ORDER BY emp_id

items.question: Show the department code and the count of employees for departments that have more than one employee, sorted by headcount descending.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, dept_cd

items.question: List the employee id, name, and hire date of the earliest hired employee in each department.
items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm, t1.hire_dt FROM emp AS t1 JOIN (SELECT dept_cd, MIN(hire_dt) AS min_dt FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd) AS t2 ON t1.dept_cd = t2.dept_cd AND t1.hire_dt = t2.min_dt ORDER BY t1.dept_cd

items.question: Show the manager's employee id, manager's name, and the count of their direct reports, restricted only to managers who have at least 2 direct reports.
items.sql: SELECT t2.emp_id, t2.emp_nm, COUNT(t1.emp_id) FROM emp AS t1 JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.mgr_emp_id = t2.emp_id GROUP BY t2.emp_id, t2.emp_nm HAVING COUNT(t1.emp_id) >= 2 ORDER BY COUNT(t1.emp_id) DESC, t2.emp_id

items.question: Find the second-level subordinates of E-001 (i.e. employees who report to someone who reports directly to E-001). Show their employee id and name.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IN (SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001') ORDER BY emp_id

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, list the employee id, name, and hierarchical depth (starting at depth 0 for top-level managers with NULL manager) for all employees.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE emp_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 0 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, et.depth + 1 FROM emp AS e JOIN emp_tree AS et ON e.mgr_emp_id = et.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, depth FROM emp_tree ORDER BY depth, emp_id

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, build the full reporting chain under the top-level manager E-001. Show employee id, name, and their level relative to E-001 (where E-001 is level 0).
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE report_chain AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 0 AS lvl FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-001' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, rc.lvl + 1 FROM emp AS e JOIN report_chain AS rc ON e.mgr_emp_id = rc.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, lvl FROM report_chain ORDER BY lvl, emp_id

items.question: Find all descendants (direct and indirect subordinates) of employee E-001 using a recursive CTE. Display their employee id and name.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id FROM emp AS e JOIN descendants AS d ON e.mgr_emp_id = d.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM descendants ORDER BY emp_id

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, trace the management chain upwards from employee E-007, showing every manager above them up to the top of the tree, along with the distance step.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE upward_chain AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 0 AS step FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-007' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, uc.step + 1 FROM emp AS e JOIN upward_chain AS uc ON e.emp_id = uc.mgr_emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, step FROM upward_chain WHERE emp_id <> 'E-007' ORDER BY step

items.question: For each employee, compute their span of control (total count of all recursive descendants under them) using a recursive CTE. Show employee id, name, and total subordinate count, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE all_subs AS (SELECT emp_id AS root_id, emp_id AS sub_id FROM emp UNION ALL SELECT ast.root_id, e.emp_id FROM all_subs AS ast JOIN emp AS e ON e.mgr_emp_id = ast.sub_id) SELECT t.emp_id, t.emp_nm, COUNT(s.sub_id) - 1 AS sub_count FROM emp AS t JOIN all_subs AS s ON t.emp_id = s.root_id GROUP BY t.emp_id, t.emp_nm ORDER BY sub_count DESC, t.emp_id

items.question: List department codes that have a higher average hire date seniority (meaning earlier average hire date) than the overall company average hire date.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd HAVING AVG(hire_dt) < (SELECT AVG(hire_dt) FROM emp) ORDER BY dept_cd

items.question: Find employees who share the exact same manager and hire year. Show their employee ids and names in pairs (where emp1.emp_id < emp2.emp_id).
items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm, t2.emp_id, t2.emp_nm FROM emp AS t1 JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.mgr_emp_id = t2.mgr_emp_id AND YEAR(t1.hire_dt) = YEAR(t2.hire_dt) AND t1.emp_id < t2.emp_id ORDER BY t1.emp_id, t2.emp_id

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, find the maximum depth of the entire organization tree (the longest chain from any top-level manager down to the lowest leaf employee). Show the maximum depth number.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE tree_depth AS (SELECT emp_id, 0 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, td.depth + 1 FROM emp AS e JOIN tree_depth AS td ON e.mgr_emp_id = td.emp_id) SELECT MAX(depth) FROM tree_depth

items.question: List the employee id and name of any manager whose direct reports outnumber the average number of direct reports across all managers who have at least one report.
items.sql: SELECT t2.emp_id, t2.emp_nm FROM emp AS t1 JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.mgr_emp_id = t2.emp_id GROUP BY t2.emp_id, t2.emp_nm HAVING COUNT(t1.emp_id) > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mgr_emp_id) AS sub) ORDER BY t2.emp_id

items.question: For each department, return the employee id, name, and hire date of the person who was hired last (most recently) in that department.
items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm, t1.hire_dt FROM emp AS t1 JOIN (SELECT dept_cd, MAX(hire_dt) AS max_dt FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd) AS t2 ON t1.dept_cd = t2.dept_cd AND t1.hire_dt = t2.max_dt ORDER BY t1.dept_cd

items.question: Find all pairs of employees (emp1, emp2) who belong to the same department and were hired on the exact same date. Show emp1 id, emp2 id, and department code, ordered by department code.
items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_id, t2.emp_id, t1.dept_cd FROM emp AS t1 JOIN emp AS t2 ON t1.dept_cd = t2.dept_cd AND t1.hire_dt = t2.hire_dt AND t1.emp_id < t2.emp_id ORDER BY t1.dept_cd, t1.emp_id, t2.emp_id

items.question: Show the department code and the total count of staff members for departments where every employee in that department was hired before '2020-01-01'.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd HAVING MAX(hire_dt) < '2020-01-01' ORDER BY dept_cd

items.question: Show the promotion code and promotion name for all promotions that give a discount percentage strictly greater than 15.
items.sql: SELECT promo_cd, promo_nm FROM promo WHERE disc_pct > 15.00 ORDER BY promo_cd ASC

items.question: List the customer id and customer name for platinum tier customers located in the Europe sales region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'EU' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Give me the order id and order total amount for orders placed through the store sales channel with a currency of USD.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'STR' AND currency_cd = 'USD' ORDER BY ord_id ASC

items.question: Find the stock keeping unit and list price for products in the kitchen product category whose list price is above 50.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND list_prc > 50.00 ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Show the order id and order date for orders whose order status is cancelled.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C' ORDER BY ord_id ASC

items.question: List the supplier id and supplier name for all suppliers located in country US.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the promotion code and the count of orders that used each promotion code, ordered by highest count first then promotion code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT t2.promo_cd, COUNT(t1.ord_id) AS ord_cnt FROM ord_promo AS t1 INNER JOIN promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id GROUP BY t2.promo_cd ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC, t2.promo_cd ASC

items.question: List each sales region and the count of active customers in that region who belong to the gold loyalty tier.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(cust_id) AS cust_cnt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'G' AND is_actv = 1 GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY cust_cnt DESC, region_cd ASC

items.question: For web channel orders placed between 2026-04-01 and 2026-04-30, show the order id, order date, and order total amount.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Find the product name and list price of electronics products that are supplied by supplier id 6.
items.sql: SELECT t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND t2.sup_id = 6 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC

items.question: List the customer name and signup date for customers who were in the at risk customer segment in the month of August 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, t1.signup_dt FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t2.segment_cd = 'RISK' AND t2.month_dt = '2026-08-01' ORDER BY t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the order id, payment method code, and payment amount for successful payment attempts made on orders that used the app sales channel.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.method_cd, t1.pay_amt FROM payment AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.pay_status = 'S' AND t2.channel_cd = 'APP' ORDER BY t1.pay_id ASC

items.question: For each sales channel, calculate the total order amount for all delivered orders in the North America sales region during July 2026, showing channel code and total amount.
items.sql: SELECT t1.channel_cd, SUM(t1.ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_status = 'D' AND t2.region_cd = 'NA' AND t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY t1.channel_cd ORDER BY total_amt DESC, t1.channel_cd ASC

items.question: Find the customer name and total spend for VIP customers whose total order amount across all their delivered orders exceeds 500 USD, sorted by spend descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) AS total_spend FROM cust_master AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id INNER JOIN cust_segment_hist AS t3 ON t1.cust_id = t3.cust_id WHERE t3.segment_cd = 'VIP' AND t3.month_dt = '2026-07-01' AND t2.ord_status = 'D' AND t2.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm HAVING SUM(t2.ord_total_amt) > 500.00 ORDER BY total_spend DESC, t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the product name and total quantity ordered for the top 5 most frequently ordered products in the home category for orders placed in 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.prod_nm, SUM(t2.qty) AS total_qty FROM prod_catalog AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_line AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.categ_cd = 'HOM' AND t3.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t1.sku, t1.prod_nm ORDER BY total_qty DESC, t1.prod_nm ASC LIMIT 5

items.question: List the promotion name and the count of unique customers who placed an order using that promotion, for promotions starting after 2025-11-01.
items.sql: SELECT t1.promo_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT t3.cust_id) AS cust_cnt FROM promo AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_promo AS t2 ON t1.promo_id = t2.promo_id INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t2.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t1.starts_dt > '2025-11-01' GROUP BY t1.promo_id, t1.promo_nm ORDER BY cust_cnt DESC, t1.promo_nm ASC

items.question: Find the customer name, order id, and refund request amount for approved refund requests where the refund reason code is damaged and the request date is in December 2025.
items.sql: SELECT t2.cust_nm, t1.ord_id, t1.rfd_amt FROM refund_req AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t3.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.status_cd = 'A' AND t1.reason_cd = 'DMG' AND t1.req_dt BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY t1.req_dt ASC, t1.rfd_id ASC

items.question: For web sessions that resulted in a purchase event, show the session id, customer name, and the event timestamp, filtered for sessions occurring in November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT t1.session_id, t2.cust_nm, t1.evt_ts FROM web_event AS t1 INNER JOIN cust_master AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND t1.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND t1.evt_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-11-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY t1.evt_ts ASC, t1.session_id ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse name and the count of products where the on hand quantity is less than or equal to the reorder point for products in the electronics category.
items.sql: SELECT t2.wh_nm, COUNT(t1.sku) AS low_stock_cnt FROM inventory AS t1 INNER JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS t3 ON t1.sku = t3.sku WHERE t1.on_hand_qty <= t1.reorder_pt AND t3.categ_cd = 'ELC' GROUP BY t2.wh_id, t2.wh_nm ORDER BY low_stock_cnt DESC, t2.wh_nm ASC

items.question: List the employee name and count of support tickets assigned to them that have a critical severity level and were opened after 2026-04-01.
items.sql: SELECT t1.emp_nm, COUNT(t2.tkt_id) AS tkt_cnt FROM emp AS t1 INNER JOIN support_tkt AS t2 ON t1.emp_id = t2.assigned_emp_id WHERE t2.sev_lvl = 1 AND t2.opened_ts > '2026-04-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY t1.emp_id, t1.emp_nm ORDER BY tkt_cnt DESC, t1.emp_nm ASC

items.question: For each supplier name, calculate the average lead days across all products they provide, showing supplier name and average lead days.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, AVG(t2.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM supplier AS t1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY avg_lead_days ASC, t1.sup_nm ASC

items.question: Show the order id, line number, and ordered quantity for order lines that belong to orders placed through the phone sales channel.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.line_no, t1.qty FROM ord_line AS t1 INNER JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.channel_cd = 'PHN' ORDER BY t1.ord_id ASC, t1.line_no ASC

items.question: List the product name, stock keeping unit, and unit price for order lines where the discount percentage is 10 or higher.
items.sql: SELECT t2.prod_nm, t1.sku, t1.unit_prc FROM ord_line AS t1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.disc_pct >= 10.00 ORDER BY t1.ord_id ASC, t1.line_no ASC

items.question: Find the customer name, signup date, and sales region for active customers in the Asia Pacific region who signed up in July 2022.
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, signup_dt, region_cd FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP' AND is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-07-01' AND '2022-07-31' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: What are the figures for the new customer segment?
items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Do you want the count of customers who newly signed up or those currently classified under the 'NEW' segment in segment history?

items.question: Pull order metrics for last month.
items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Should I report in the order's native currencies or convert everything to USD using the exchange rates?

items.question: How many users abandoned their carts?
items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Do you want sessions that added items to the cart but had no subsequent checkout/purchase, or total cart event counts?

items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Should I check VIP status based on their current master record or their historical segment for the specific month of the order?

items.question: Pull the clickstream data for product searches.
items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Do you only want 'VIEW' events, or should I include 'CART' events as well?

items.question: Show me orders placed through mobile versus desktop.
items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Do you want order counts, total revenue, or average order value compared across APP and WEB channels?

items.question: How many at-risk customers do we have right now?
items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Do you want the count from the most recent monthly segment history or filtered by a specific month?

items.question: What was the revenue impact of our discount codes?
items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Do you want total sales from orders using promotions, or the total monetary value of the discounts given?

items.question: Get the list of customer email addresses for our campaign.
items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Which customer segment or criteria should I use to filter the email list?

items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Do you mean orders that had more than one payment attempt overall, or specifically orders where an earlier attempt failed before settling?

items.question: What are the top regions by order volume?
items.reply: -- CLARIFY: Should region be determined by the customer's registered region or the sales channel/warehouse location?

items.question: Give me the full name, hiring date, and department code for the employee with ID E-001.
items.sql: SELECT emp_nm, hire_dt, dept_cd FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-001'

items.question: What is the product name and list price for SKU ELC-024?
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku = 'ELC-024'

items.question: List all customer names and phone numbers for customers located in the AP sales region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, phone_no FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'AP'

items.question: Show the warehouse name and region code for the warehouse with ID W1.
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE wh_id = 'W1'

items.question: Find the stock movement ID, quantity, and movement type for movement 1.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, qty, mv_type FROM inv_move WHERE mv_id = 1

items.question: What is the supplier name and country for supplier ID 1?
items.sql: SELECT sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE sup_id = 1

items.question: Pull all support ticket IDs and opened timestamps where the category code is TECH.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'TECH'

items.question: List the SKU, list price, and product name for all items in the ELC category that are currently marked as discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 1

items.question: Show the customer ID and signup date for all active customers who belong to the platinum loyalty tier and signed up after 2022-05-01, ordered by signup date ascending, then customer ID descending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND tier_cd = 'P' AND signup_dt > '2022-05-01' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id DESC

items.question: Find all support tickets that are still open, meaning their closed timestamp is null, and have a severity level of 1.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NULL AND sev_lvl = 1

items.question: List the refund request ID, requested amount, and request date for all refund requests where the reason code is DMG and the status is pending.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, rfd_amt, req_dt FROM refund_req WHERE reason_cd = 'DMG' AND status_cd = 'P'

items.question: Show the SKU, on-hand quantity, and reorder point for inventory records in warehouse W2 where the on-hand stock is less than or equal to the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt

items.question: What are the promotion IDs and order IDs for all orders where the applied promotion ID is 3?
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, promo_id FROM ord_promo WHERE promo_id = 3

items.question: Pull the employee ID, full name, and email address for all employees who have a direct manager ID assigned and work in the FIN department.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, email_addr FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL AND dept_cd = 'FIN'

items.question: List the SKU, lead days, and primary supplier flag for all supplier product records where the supplier ID is 1 and lead days are greater than 20, sorted by lead days descending, then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days, is_primary FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 1 AND lead_days > 20 ORDER BY lead_days DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Show the shipment ID, order ID, and delivery date for all shipments handled by the UPS carrier that were delivered in November 2025, ordered by delivery date ascending, then shipment ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, deliv_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS' AND deliv_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND deliv_dt <= '2025-11-30' ORDER BY deliv_dt ASC, ship_id ASC

items.question: Find all payment attempts using the credit card method with a payment status of failed that occurred between 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-30, showing the payment attempt ID, order ID, and payment amount, ordered by payment amount descending, then payment attempt ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'CC' AND pay_status = 'F' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts <= '2025-11-30 23:59:59' ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC

items.question: List the order ID, line number, SKU, and ordered quantity for order line items where the unit price is greater than 100.00 and the discount percentage is zero, ordered by order ID ascending, then line number ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, sku, qty FROM ord_line WHERE unit_prc > 100.00 AND disc_pct = 0.00 ORDER BY ord_id ASC, line_no ASC

items.question: Show the session ID, event timestamp, and channel code for all clickstream events of type cart where the channel code is APP and the customer ID is null, ordered by event timestamp descending, then session ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT session_id, evt_ts, channel_cd FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'CART' AND channel_cd = 'APP' AND cust_id IS NULL ORDER BY evt_ts DESC, session_id ASC

items.question: Find all stock movements in warehouse W1 where the movement type is adjustment and the quantity is negative, returning the movement ID, SKU, and quantity, ordered by movement timestamp ascending, then movement ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND mv_type = 'ADJ' AND qty < 0 ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC

items.question: List the customer ID, month date, and segment code for customer segment history records where the segment code is RISK and the month date is exactly 2025-11-01, ordered by customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, month_dt, segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist WHERE segment_cd = 'RISK' AND month_dt = '2025-11-01' ORDER BY cust_id ASC

items.question: Show the promotion ID, promotion code, and discount percentage for promotions that start on or after 2025-11-01 and have a discount percentage of at least 15 percent, ordered by discount percentage descending, then promotion ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT promo_id, promo_cd, disc_pct FROM promo WHERE starts_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND disc_pct >= 15.00 ORDER BY disc_pct DESC, promo_id ASC

items.question: Find all policy rules where the rule key is refund approval threshold and the effective to date is not null, returning the rule ID, rule value, and effective from date, ordered by effective from date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT rule_id, rule_val, eff_from FROM policy_rule WHERE rule_key = 'refund_approval_threshold' AND eff_to IS NOT NULL ORDER BY eff_from ASC

items.question: List the exchange rate currency code, effective date, and rate to USD for all currency records where the effective date is 2025-07-01 and the rate to USD is greater than 1.000000, ordered by currency code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, eff_dt, rate_to_usd FROM fx_rate WHERE eff_dt = '2025-07-01' AND rate_to_usd > 1.000000 ORDER BY currency_cd ASC

items.question: How many warehouses do we have in each region? Show the region code and the count of warehouses, ordered by the region code.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS warehouse_count FROM warehouse GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC, warehouse_count DESC

items.question: List all product categories along with their average list price, showing category code and average price, sorted from highest price to lowest.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY avg_list_prc DESC, categ_cd ASC

items.question: What is the total on-hand inventory quantity for each product across all warehouses? Show the SKU and total quantity, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: How many suppliers are located in each country? Return the country code and supplier count, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM supplier GROUP BY country ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, country ASC

items.question: Give me the total number of stock movements recorded for each movement type. Show the movement type and the total count, ordered by movement type.
items.sql: SELECT mv_type, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inv_move GROUP BY mv_type ORDER BY mv_type ASC

items.question: What is the highest list price among all products in our catalog?
items.sql: SELECT MAX(list_prc) AS max_list_prc FROM prod_catalog

items.question: Show the SKU and average ordered quantity for each product from order lines where the quantity is greater than 1, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, AVG(qty) AS avg_qty FROM ord_line WHERE qty > 1 GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: How many distinct products have had at least one stock movement recorded?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS active_moved_products FROM inv_move

items.question: Which warehouses hold more than 300 units of total on-hand inventory? Show the warehouse ID and total on-hand quantity, sorted by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id HAVING SUM(on_hand_qty) > 300 ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Find suppliers that provide more than one product in our catalog. Show the supplier ID and the count of products they supply, ordered by product count descending.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS product_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id HAVING COUNT(sku) > 1 ORDER BY product_count DESC, sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for all products that belong to the electronics category ('ELC') and have a list price above the average list price of all electronics products.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > (SELECT AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC') ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: What is the average lead time in days for primary suppliers? Show the product category code and average lead days, sorted by average lead days.
items.sql: SELECT T1.categ_cd, AVG(T2.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY T1.categ_cd ORDER BY avg_lead_days ASC, T1.categ_cd ASC

items.question: List the warehouses and the count of inventory items they stock where the current on-hand quantity is below the reorder point. Show the warehouse ID and the count, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS low_stock_count FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY low_stock_count DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Show each product category and the maximum list price for discontinued products versus active products. Return category code, discontinuation flag, and max list price, sorted by category code.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, disc_flag, MAX(list_prc) AS max_price FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd, disc_flag ORDER BY categ_cd ASC, disc_flag ASC

items.question: Find all order lines where the unit price is higher than the list price of the corresponding product in the catalog. Return the order ID, line number, SKU, unit price, and list price, ordered by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T1.line_no, T1.sku, T1.unit_prc, T2.list_prc FROM ord_line AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.unit_prc > T2.list_prc ORDER BY T1.ord_id ASC, T1.line_no ASC

items.question: How many stock movements of type 'OUT' occurred for each warehouse in October 2025? Show the warehouse ID and movement count, sorted by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(*) AS out_movement_count FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: Which products have active inventory across all four warehouses ('W1', 'W2', 'W3', 'W4')? Return the SKU and product name, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T1 INNER JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku GROUP BY T1.sku, T2.prod_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.wh_id) = 4 ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: Find the supplier who supplies the highest number of products in the catalog. Show the supplier ID, supplier name, and the count of products supplied, ordered by supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_id, T2.sup_nm, COUNT(T1.sku) AS prod_count FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T2.sup_nm ORDER BY prod_count DESC, T1.sup_id ASC LIMIT 1

items.question: What is the total quantity of stock moved (absolute sum of quantities across all movement types) for each product during October 2025? Show the SKU and total quantity moved, returning the top 5 products with the highest movement volume, ordered by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_qty_moved FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_qty_moved DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 5

items.question: List all products that have never had a stock movement of type 'OUT'. Return the SKU and product name, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT') ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: For each warehouse, find the product with the highest on-hand quantity. Show the warehouse ID, SKU, and on-hand quantity, sorted by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.sku, T1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS T1 WHERE T1.on_hand_qty = (SELECT MAX(T2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory AS T2 WHERE T2.wh_id = T1.wh_id) ORDER BY T1.wh_id ASC, T1.sku ASC

items.question: Calculate the average lead days for each supplier across all products they provide, but only include suppliers whose average lead days exceed 25 days. Show the supplier ID, supplier name, and average lead days, sorted by average lead days descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_id, T2.sup_nm, AVG(T1.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T2.sup_nm HAVING AVG(T1.lead_days) > 25 ORDER BY avg_lead_days DESC, T1.sup_id ASC

items.question: Which products have a total ordered quantity across all order lines that is strictly greater than the sum of their on-hand inventory across all warehouses? Return the SKU and product name, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS tot_ordered FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku) AS T_ord ON T1.sku = T_ord.sku INNER JOIN (SELECT sku, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS tot_stock FROM inventory GROUP BY sku) AS T_inv ON T1.sku = T_inv.sku WHERE T_ord.tot_ordered > T_inv.tot_stock ORDER BY T1.sku ASC

items.question: Find the suppliers that are the primary supplier for at least two products and also have an average lead time of under 30 days across those primary products. Show the supplier ID and supplier name, ordered by supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_id, T2.sup_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 INNER JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T1.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T2.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(T1.sku) >= 2 AND AVG(T1.lead_days) < 30 ORDER BY T1.sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the product SKU, product name, and list price for all electronics items in the catalog.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 WHERE t1.categ_cd = 'ELC';

items.question: List the warehouse name and region code for all warehouses.
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse;

items.question: Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity for any inventory records where the stock is below 300.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty < 300;

items.question: What are the names and countries of all suppliers located in the United States?
items.sql: SELECT sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US';

items.question: Show the SKU and lead days for every supplier product link where the primary flag is set to 1.
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1;

items.question: List the movement ID, movement timestamp, and quantity for all stock adjustments.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ';

items.question: Show the product SKU, product name, and the name of its primary supplier.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t3.sup_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN supplier AS t3 ON t2.sup_id = t3.sup_id WHERE t2.is_primary = 1;

items.question: For each warehouse, list the warehouse name and the total on-hand quantity of all products currently in stock, sorted from highest total quantity to lowest.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_nm, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) AS total_stock FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_stock DESC, t1.wh_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the product name, warehouse name, and on-hand quantity for any inventory items where the on-hand quantity is less than or equal to the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT t1.prod_nm, t3.wh_nm, t2.on_hand_qty FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN warehouse AS t3 ON t2.wh_id = t3.wh_id WHERE t2.on_hand_qty <= t2.reorder_pt;

items.question: List the supplier name, product SKU, and lead days for all products supplied by 'Orion Electronics'.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, t2.sku, t2.lead_days FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id WHERE t1.sup_nm = 'Orion Electronics';

items.question: Show the warehouse name, movement timestamp, SKU, and movement quantity for all OUT movements that occurred at the 'Newark Hub'.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_nm, t2.mv_ts, t2.sku, t2.qty FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inv_move AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' AND t2.mv_type = 'OUT';

items.question: Find all products in the kitchen category that have a list price greater than 50.00, returning the SKU, product name, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND list_prc > 50.00;

items.question: For products supplied by 'Sakura Glassworks', show the product name, category code, lead days, and whether it is the primary supplier, ordered by product name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.prod_nm, t1.categ_cd, t2.lead_days, t2.is_primary FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN supplier AS t3 ON t2.sup_id = t3.sup_id WHERE t3.sup_nm = 'Sakura Glassworks' ORDER BY t1.prod_nm ASC, t2.sku ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse name, product SKU, product name, and current on-hand quantity for all inventory items located in warehouses serving the 'NA' region.
items.sql: SELECT t3.wh_nm, t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t2.on_hand_qty FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN warehouse AS t3 ON t2.wh_id = t3.wh_id WHERE t3.region_cd = 'NA';

items.question: Show the supplier name and the total number of distinct products they supply, ordered from the most products to the least.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sup_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) AS product_count FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.sup_id, t1.sup_nm ORDER BY product_count DESC, t1.sup_nm ASC;

items.question: For stock movements that occurred in October 2025 (starting '2025-10-01' and ending '2025-10-31'), show the warehouse name, movement type, product SKU, and movement quantity.
items.sql: SELECT t2.wh_nm, t1.mv_type, t1.sku, t1.qty FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND t1.mv_ts <= '2025-10-31 23:59:59';

items.question: Find the average lead days for each product category across all active supplier relationships, returning the category code and average lead days.
items.sql: SELECT t1.categ_cd, AVG(t2.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.categ_cd ORDER BY avg_lead_days DESC;

items.question: List the product SKU, product name, list price, and the name of its primary supplier for all discontinued products.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc, t3.sup_nm FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN supplier AS t3 ON t2.sup_id = t3.sup_id WHERE t1.disc_flag = 1 AND t2.is_primary = 1;

items.question: Show the warehouse name, product name, on-hand quantity, and reorder point for all inventory items at the 'Singapore Hub' where stock is strictly below the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT t2.wh_nm, t1.prod_nm, t3.on_hand_qty, t3.reorder_pt FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t3 ON t1.sku = t3.sku JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t3.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.wh_nm = 'Singapore Hub' AND t3.on_hand_qty < t3.reorder_pt;

items.question: For each supplier country, calculate the total number of supplier records and the average lead days of their offered products, ordered by country name.
items.sql: SELECT t1.country, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.sup_id) AS supplier_count, AVG(t2.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM supplier AS t1 JOIN prod_supplier AS t2 ON t1.sup_id = t2.sup_id GROUP BY t1.country ORDER BY t1.country ASC;

items.question: Show the product SKU, product name, and total absolute movement quantity (sum of absolute values of qty) for all stock movements recorded in the system.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, SUM(ABS(t2.qty)) AS total_moved_qty FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inv_move AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.sku, t1.prod_nm ORDER BY total_moved_qty DESC, t1.sku ASC;

items.question: List the order ID, line number, product SKU, quantity, and unit price for all order lines associated with product category 'ELC'.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.line_no, t1.sku, t1.qty, t1.unit_prc FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.categ_cd = 'ELC';

items.question: Show the warehouse name and the count of unique SKUs held in inventory for each warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_nm, COUNT(t2.sku) AS sku_count FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY sku_count DESC, t1.wh_nm ASC;

items.question: Find the maximum and minimum list price across all products in the office category.
items.sql: SELECT MAX(list_prc) AS max_price, MIN(list_prc) AS min_price FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'OFC';

items.question: Show the product SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity for any inventory items where the stock level is less than or equal to the reorder point as of the current dataset state.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY sku, wh_id;

items.question: List the supplier ID and supplier name for all suppliers located in the United States, sorted by supplier name.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_nm;

items.question: Display the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and region code for the Newark Hub.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE wh_nm = 'Newark Hub';

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products in the electronics category whose list price is strictly greater than 50.00, ordered from highest to lowest price.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku;

items.question: Find the movement ID, SKU, movement timestamp, and moved quantity for all stock adjustments that occurred on exactly 2025-10-04, ordered by movement ID.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-04 00:00:00' AND mv_ts <= '2025-10-04 23:59:59' ORDER BY mv_id;

items.question: List the SKU, supplier ID, and lead days for all primary supplier relationships.
items.sql: SELECT sku, sup_id, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1 ORDER BY sku, sup_id;

items.question: Show the product SKU and total quantity moved out of warehouses between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31, for products where total outbound volume exceeds 5 units, ordered by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_qty_out FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts BETWEEN '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(ABS(qty)) > 5 ORDER BY total_qty_out DESC, sku;

items.question: For each supplier name, calculate the average lead time in days across all products they supply, showing supplier name and average lead time, ordered by average lead time ascending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_nm, AVG(T2.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm ORDER BY avg_lead_days ASC, T1.sup_nm;

items.question: List the SKU and product name for items that have never been involved in any stock movement recorded in the system, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT sku FROM inv_move) ORDER BY sku;

items.question: For every warehouse in the North American region ('NA'), list the warehouse name and the total on-hand inventory across all products stored there, ordered by total inventory descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM warehouse AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id WHERE T1.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, T1.wh_nm;

items.question: Find all products (SKU and product name) that are supplied by 'Orion Electronics' and have a lead time greater than 15 days, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T2.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T3.sup_nm = 'Orion Electronics' AND T2.lead_days > 15 ORDER BY T1.sku;

items.question: Display the category code and the count of products in each category for all products that are not discontinued, ordered by product count descending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_count FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 0 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY prod_count DESC, categ_cd;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products where the list price is greater than the average list price of all products in their respective category, ordered by category code and list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS T1 WHERE T1.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(T2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog AS T2 WHERE T2.categ_cd = T1.categ_cd) ORDER BY T1.categ_cd, T1.list_prc DESC, T1.sku;

items.question: For each month between 2025-10-01 and 2025-12-31, calculate the total absolute quantity of stock movements categorized as 'OUT', showing the month start date and total outbound quantity, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m-01') AS movement_month, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_out_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts BETWEEN '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY movement_month ORDER BY movement_month;

items.question: Identify products that are supplied by more than one supplier, listing their SKU and the count of distinct suppliers, ordered by supplier count descending then SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, COUNT(DISTINCT sup_id) AS supplier_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sup_id) > 1 ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, sku;

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and total units ordered across all order lines for products where total ordered quantity exceeds 10 units during the period where orders are dated from 2025-11-01 to 2025-11-30, ordered by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, SUM(T2.qty) AS total_ordered_qty FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN ord_line AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku JOIN ord_hdr AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id WHERE T3.ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' GROUP BY T1.sku, T1.prod_nm HAVING SUM(T2.qty) > 10 ORDER BY total_ordered_qty DESC, T1.sku;

items.question: For warehouses that hold inventory for products in the kitchen category ('KIT'), show the warehouse name and the total inventory on-hand value (calculated as on_hand_qty multiplied by list_prc), ordered by total value descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_nm, SUM(T2.on_hand_qty * T3.list_prc) AS total_inventory_value FROM warehouse AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T2.sku = T3.sku WHERE T3.categ_cd = 'KIT' GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm ORDER BY total_inventory_value DESC, T1.wh_nm;

items.question: Find suppliers who provide products across at least 2 different product categories, showing supplier ID, supplier name, and the count of distinct categories supplied, ordered by category count descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.categ_cd) AS categ_count FROM supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T2.sku = T3.sku GROUP BY T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T3.categ_cd) >= 2 ORDER BY categ_count DESC, T1.sup_id;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for all products whose list price is higher than the maximum list price of all products in the office category ('OFC'), sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > (SELECT MAX(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'OFC') ORDER BY sku;

items.question: List the warehouse ID and warehouse name for warehouses that currently stock fewer than 5 distinct SKUs, ordered by warehouse ID.
items.sql: SELECT T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm FROM warehouse AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.wh_id = T2.wh_id GROUP BY T1.wh_id, T1.wh_nm HAVING COUNT(T2.sku) < 5 ORDER BY T1.wh_id;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price of the single most expensive product in the entire product catalog.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku LIMIT 1;

items.question: List the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers who do not have any primary product supply relationships recorded, sorted by supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm FROM supplier WHERE sup_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT sup_id FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1) ORDER BY sup_id;

items.question: For stock movements that occurred between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-15, report the movement type and the sum of quantities moved, ordered by movement type.
items.sql: SELECT mv_type, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_ts BETWEEN '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-10-15 23:59:59' GROUP BY mv_type ORDER BY mv_type;

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, primary supplier name, and lead days for all products where the primary supplier's country is 'DE' (Germany), ordered by lead days descending.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T3.sup_nm, T2.lead_days FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T2.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T2.is_primary = 1 AND T3.country = 'DE' ORDER BY T2.lead_days DESC, T1.sku;

items.question: Show the month as YYYY-MM and the total units moved out for each month in Q1 2026, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mth, SUM(-qty) AS total_out FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: List the year-quarter and total order line quantity for category ELC in 2025, sorted chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(h.ord_dt), '-Q', QUARTER(h.ord_dt)) AS yq, SUM(l.qty) AS tot_qty FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(h.ord_dt), QUARTER(h.ord_dt) ORDER BY yq ASC;

items.question: What is the weekly breakdown of stock movement counts for movement type IN during October 2025? Give the year-week and the count, sorted by week.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%u') AS yr_wk, COUNT(*) AS mv_cnt FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01' AND mv_ts < '2025-11-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%u') ORDER BY yr_wk ASC;

items.question: Show each month in 2025 (as YYYY-MM) and the total sum of units ordered across all order lines, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, SUM(l.qty) AS sum_qty FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: For each quarter of 2025, show the quarter label and the total list price value of products with discount flag 0 added to inventory movements of type ADJ.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(i.mv_ts), '-Q', QUARTER(i.mv_ts)) AS qtr, SUM(p.list_prc * ABS(i.qty)) AS tot_val FROM inv_move i JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE i.mv_type = 'ADJ' AND p.disc_flag = 0 AND i.mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND i.mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(i.mv_ts), QUARTER(i.mv_ts) ORDER BY qtr ASC;

items.question: List the YYYY-MM month and total order revenue (line unit_prc * qty) for category KIT in the second half of 2025, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, SUM(l.unit_prc * l.qty) AS rev FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'KIT' AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-07-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Give the year-week format and count of inventory adjustments for warehouse W1 during November 2025, ordered by week.
