items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%u') AS yr_wk, COUNT(*) AS adj_count FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-11-01' AND mv_ts < '2025-12-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%u') ORDER BY yr_wk ASC;

items.question: Show the YYYY-MM month and distinct count of SKUs moved out from warehouse W2 in 2025, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mth, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS distinct_skus FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: What are the quarterly order line counts for products supplied by supplier 1 during 2025? Output quarter and count, ordered by quarter.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(h.ord_dt), '-Q', QUARTER(h.ord_dt)) AS qtr, COUNT(*) AS line_cnt FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_supplier s ON l.sku = s.sku WHERE s.sup_id = 1 AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(h.ord_dt), QUARTER(h.ord_dt) ORDER BY qtr ASC;

items.question: Display each month (YYYY-MM) in 2025 and the total quantity of items moved with movement type IN, sorted by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mth, SUM(qty) AS total_in FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Show the year and quarter alongside the average unit price of order lines for category HOM in 2025, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(h.ord_dt), '-Q', QUARTER(h.ord_dt)) AS qtr, AVG(l.unit_prc) AS avg_prc FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'HOM' AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(h.ord_dt), QUARTER(h.ord_dt) ORDER BY qtr ASC;

items.question: For warehouse W3, list every YYYY-MM in 2025 with the total quantity of stock adjustments made, in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mth, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_adj FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W3' AND mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Give the year-week and the total count of order lines placed via the WEB channel during November 2025, sorted by week.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%u') AS yr_wk, COUNT(*) AS lines_cnt FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.channel_cd = 'WEB' AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2025-12-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%u') ORDER BY yr_wk ASC;

items.question: List the YYYY-MM and the total units ordered for products whose category is OFC across all of 2025, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, SUM(l.qty) AS tot_qty FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'OFC' AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Show the quarterly breakdown for 2025 showing quarter and total absolute quantity of inventory movements of type ADJ, ordered by quarter.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(mv_ts), '-Q', QUARTER(mv_ts)) AS qtr, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS tot_adj_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(mv_ts), QUARTER(mv_ts) ORDER BY qtr ASC;

items.question: What is the monthly trend of order line counts for products with discount flag 1 during 2025? Provide YYYY-MM and count, sorted by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE p.disc_flag = 1 AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Give the year-week and total order line revenue for warehouse shipments originating from W4 in November 2025, ordered by week.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%u') AS yr_wk, SUM(l.unit_prc * l.qty) AS rev FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN shipment s ON h.ord_id = s.ord_id WHERE s.wh_id = 'W4' AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-11-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2025-12-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%u') ORDER BY yr_wk ASC;

items.question: Show each month of 2025 as YYYY-MM and the count of distinct products that had an OUT movement, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mth, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS prod_count FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: For each quarter in 2025, report the quarter and the maximum order line quantity sold in that quarter, sorted chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(h.ord_dt), '-Q', QUARTER(h.ord_dt)) AS qtr, MAX(l.qty) AS max_qty FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id WHERE h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(h.ord_dt), QUARTER(h.ord_dt) ORDER BY qtr ASC;

items.question: List the YYYY-MM month and total quantity of stock movements for warehouse W1 where movement type is IN, during 2025, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') AS mth, SUM(qty) AS total_in FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND mv_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: What are the quarterly total quantities of products ordered in category ELC during 2025? Display year-quarter and sum of qty, ordered by quarter.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(h.ord_dt), '-Q', QUARTER(h.ord_dt)) AS qtr, SUM(l.qty) AS tot_qty FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(h.ord_dt), QUARTER(h.ord_dt) ORDER BY qtr ASC;

items.question: Show the YYYY-MM and the average discount percentage applied on order lines for category HOM in 2025, ordered by month.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS mth, AVG(l.disc_pct) AS avg_disc FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'HOM' AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY mth ASC;

items.question: Give the year-week and count of inventory movements of type OUT for warehouse W2 during October 2025, ordered by week.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%u') AS yr_wk, COUNT(*) AS out_cnt FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01' AND mv_ts < '2025-11-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mv_ts, '%Y-%u') ORDER BY yr_wk ASC;

items.question: For each quarter in 2025, calculate the total order revenue generated by primary suppliers (prod_supplier.is_primary = 1), ordered by quarter.
items.sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(h.ord_dt), '-Q', QUARTER(h.ord_dt)) AS qtr, SUM(l.unit_prc * l.qty) AS rev FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr h ON l.ord_id = h.ord_id JOIN prod_supplier ps ON l.sku = ps.sku WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 AND h.ord_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND h.ord_dt < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(h.ord_dt), QUARTER(h.ord_dt) ORDER BY qtr ASC;

items.question: Give me the warehouse ID and the total units on hand for all items in that warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, wh_id ASC

items.question: List each SKU and its total stock movement quantity across all movement IDs.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_moved FROM inv_move GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_moved DESC, sku ASC

items.question: For each supplier ID, show how many products they supply in the product supplier table.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS product_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY product_count DESC, sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the category code and the count of products in each category from the product catalog.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY prod_count DESC, categ_cd ASC

items.question: Display the region code and the number of warehouses in each region.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS wh_count FROM warehouse GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY wh_count DESC, region_cd ASC

items.question: What is the SKU and lead days for every row in the product supplier table, ordered by lead time?
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier ORDER BY lead_days DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Show each SKU and its list price from the product catalog, sorted from highest to lowest price.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: List every supplier ID and their name where the country code is US.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_nm ASC, sup_id ASC

items.question: For each warehouse ID, rank its inventory items by their on-hand quantity from highest to lowest, showing the SKU and quantity.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC) AS rnk FROM inventory ORDER BY wh_id ASC, rnk ASC, sku ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity, along with the previous inventory record's on-hand quantity ordered by SKU and warehouse ID using LAG.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, LAG(on_hand_qty, 1) OVER (ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC) AS prev_qty FROM inventory ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC

items.question: Calculate a running total of stock movement quantities ordered by movement ID, showing movement ID, SKU, quantity, and the cumulative total.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY mv_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM inv_move ORDER BY mv_id ASC

items.question: For each category code, rank the products by list price in descending order, showing category code, SKU, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, sku, list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) AS price_rank FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY categ_cd ASC, price_rank ASC, sku ASC

items.question: Assign a row number to each product supplier record partitioned by supplier ID, ordered by lead days descending, showing supplier ID, SKU, and lead days.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sku, lead_days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sup_id ORDER BY lead_days DESC) as rn FROM prod_supplier ORDER BY sup_id ASC, rn ASC, sku ASC

items.question: Show each SKU, its warehouse ID, and the next movement quantity for that SKU ordered by movement timestamp using LEAD.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, qty, LEAD(qty, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY sku ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC) AS next_qty FROM inv_move ORDER BY sku ASC, mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC

items.question: List the SKU, warehouse ID, and inventory quantity for the item with the absolute highest on-hand quantity in each warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty FROM (SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC) as rn FROM inventory) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: Find products whose list price is strictly greater than the average list price of all products in their respective category.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.categ_cd, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p WHERE p.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(p2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog p2 WHERE p2.categ_cd = p.categ_cd) ORDER BY p.categ_cd ASC, p.list_prc DESC, p.sku ASC

items.question: For each category, find the top 2 products with the highest list prices, showing category code, SKU, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, sku, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, sku, list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) as rnk FROM prod_catalog) ranked WHERE rnk <= 2 ORDER BY categ_cd ASC, list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Show each product SKU, its warehouse ID, its on-hand quantity, and the total on-hand quantity across all warehouses for that SKU as a percentage of total.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, (on_hand_qty * 100.0 / SUM(on_hand_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY sku)) AS pct_of_sku_total FROM inventory ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC

items.question: For each supplier, list their primary product along with the product's list price, ranking them by list price within each supplier using DENSE_RANK.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, ps.sku, pc.list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.sup_id ORDER BY pc.list_prc DESC) AS price_rank FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog pc ON ps.sku = pc.sku WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 ORDER BY s.sup_id ASC, price_rank ASC, ps.sku ASC

items.question: Calculate a running total of stock movement quantities for each SKU separately, ordered by movement timestamp and movement ID, showing SKU, movement timestamp, quantity, and running sum.
items.sql: SELECT sku, mv_ts, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY sku ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sku_running_total FROM inv_move ORDER BY sku ASC, mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC

items.question: Find the inventory items that have an on-hand quantity greater than the average on-hand quantity of their warehouse, displaying warehouse ID, SKU, and on-hand quantity.
items.sql: SELECT i.wh_id, i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i WHERE i.on_hand_qty > (SELECT AVG(i2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory i2 WHERE i2.wh_id = i.wh_id) ORDER BY i.wh_id ASC, i.on_hand_qty DESC, i.sku ASC

items.question: For each supplier, rank their supplied products by lead days from shortest to longest, returning supplier ID, SKU, lead days, and the rank.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sku, lead_days, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sup_id ORDER BY lead_days ASC) AS lead_rank FROM prod_supplier ORDER BY sup_id ASC, lead_rank ASC, sku ASC

items.question: Compare each stock movement's quantity with the previous movement quantity for the same SKU using LAG, returning SKU, movement ID, quantity, and previous quantity.
items.sql: SELECT sku, mv_id, qty, LAG(qty, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY sku ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC) AS prev_qty FROM inv_move ORDER BY sku ASC, mv_ts ASC, mv_id ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID, SKU, on-hand quantity, and the difference between the current row's on-hand quantity and the maximum on-hand quantity across all rows in that warehouse using MAX() as a window function.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, (on_hand_qty - MAX(on_hand_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id)) AS diff_from_max FROM inventory ORDER BY wh_id ASC, on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Show the product SKU and total units moved out for items where total outbound movement exceeds 10 units in stock movements since 2025-10-01, ordered by total units descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH out_mov AS (SELECT sku, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_out FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, total_out FROM out_mov WHERE total_out > 10 ORDER BY total_out DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: List the supplier ID and number of products supplied for suppliers that provide more than 1 product, ordered by product count descending then supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH sup_counts AS (SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS prod_cnt FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id) SELECT sup_id, prod_cnt FROM sup_counts WHERE prod_cnt > 1 ORDER BY prod_cnt DESC, sup_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and average order quantity for products whose average ordered quantity is greater than 2 units, ordered by average quantity descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH avg_ord AS (SELECT sku, AVG(qty) AS avg_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, avg_qty FROM avg_ord WHERE avg_qty > 2 ORDER BY avg_qty DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse ID and total inventory on hand for warehouses where total on-hand stock is above 1000 units, ordered by total stock descending then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH wh_stock AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_stock FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, total_stock FROM wh_stock WHERE total_stock > 1000 ORDER BY total_stock DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the category code and average list price for product categories where the average list price exceeds 50 dollars, sorted by average list price descending then category code ascending.
items.sql: WITH cat_avg AS (SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_price FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) SELECT categ_cd, avg_price FROM cat_avg WHERE avg_price > 50 ORDER BY avg_price DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and count of distinct warehouses holding stock for items that are stored in more than 1 warehouse, ordered by warehouse count descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH sku_wh AS (SELECT sku, COUNT(wh_id) AS wh_cnt FROM inventory GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, wh_cnt FROM sku_wh WHERE wh_cnt > 1 ORDER BY wh_cnt DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the supplier ID and average lead days for suppliers whose average lead time is less than 35 days, ordered by average lead days ascending then supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH avg_lead AS (SELECT sup_id, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_days FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id) SELECT sup_id, avg_days FROM avg_lead WHERE avg_days < 35 ORDER BY avg_days ASC, sup_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and total adjustment quantity for products with total absolute adjustment quantity greater than 5 units in stock movements, ordered by total adjustment descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH adj_mov AS (SELECT sku, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS total_adj FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, total_adj FROM adj_mov WHERE total_adj > 5 ORDER BY total_adj DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and count of stock items where current on-hand quantity is below the reorder point, ordered by low stock count descending then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH low_stock AS (SELECT wh_id, COUNT(sku) AS low_cnt FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, low_cnt FROM low_stock ORDER BY low_cnt DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and maximum unit price ordered for items that have appeared in more than 1 order line, ordered by maximum price descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH line_stats AS (SELECT sku, COUNT(ord_id) AS line_cnt, MAX(unit_prc) AS max_prc FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, max_prc FROM line_stats WHERE line_cnt > 1 ORDER BY max_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the supplier ID and count of primary products provided by each supplier, restricted to suppliers who provide at least 1 primary product, ordered by primary product count descending then supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH prim_sup AS (SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS prim_cnt FROM prod_supplier WHERE is_primary = 1 GROUP BY sup_id) SELECT sup_id, prim_cnt FROM prim_sup WHERE prim_cnt > 0 ORDER BY prim_cnt DESC, sup_id ASC;

items.question: List the category code and total inventory on hand for categories where total stock exceeds 500 units, ordered by total stock descending then category code ascending.
items.sql: WITH cat_stock AS (SELECT p.categ_cd, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku GROUP BY p.categ_cd) SELECT categ_cd, total_on_hand FROM cat_stock WHERE total_on_hand > 500 ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and total outbound quantity moved for warehouses where total outbound movement is greater than 5 units, ordered by outbound quantity descending then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH wh_out AS (SELECT wh_id, SUM(ABS(qty)) AS out_qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, out_qty FROM wh_out WHERE out_qty > 5 ORDER BY out_qty DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and total units ordered across all orders for products whose total ordered quantity is greater than 3 units, ordered by total quantity descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH ord_sums AS (SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS tot_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, tot_qty FROM ord_sums WHERE tot_qty > 3 ORDER BY tot_qty DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and maximum lead days among its suppliers for products where the maximum lead time is 30 days or more, ordered by maximum lead days descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH max_leads AS (SELECT sku, MAX(lead_days) AS max_lead FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, max_lead FROM max_leads WHERE max_lead >= 30 ORDER BY max_lead DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: List the supplier ID and average discount percentage applied on order lines for products supplied by each supplier, ordered by average discount descending then supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH sup_disc AS (SELECT ps.sup_id, AVG(ol.disc_pct) AS avg_disc FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN ord_line ol ON ps.sku = ol.sku GROUP BY ps.sup_id) SELECT sup_id, avg_disc FROM sup_disc ORDER BY avg_disc DESC, sup_id ASC;

items.question: Show the region code and count of warehouses located in each region, ordered by warehouse count descending then region code ascending.
items.sql: WITH reg_wh AS (SELECT region_cd, COUNT(wh_id) AS wh_cnt FROM warehouse GROUP BY region_cd) SELECT region_cd, wh_cnt FROM reg_wh ORDER BY wh_cnt DESC, region_cd ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and count of stock movements recorded for products that have more than 1 stock movement event, ordered by movement count descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH mov_cnts AS (SELECT sku, COUNT(mv_id) AS m_cnt FROM inv_move GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, m_cnt FROM mov_cnts WHERE m_cnt > 1 ORDER BY m_cnt DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and average unit price on order lines for products whose average unit price is greater than 100 dollars, ordered by average price descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH avg_prc AS (SELECT sku, AVG(unit_prc) AS avg_p FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, avg_p FROM avg_prc WHERE avg_p > 100 ORDER BY avg_p DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse ID and count of unique products stocked in warehouses that hold more than 2 different products, ordered by product count descending then warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH wh_prods AS (SELECT wh_id, COUNT(sku) AS p_cnt FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id) SELECT wh_id, p_cnt FROM wh_prods WHERE p_cnt > 2 ORDER BY p_cnt DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and total inbound quantity received for products where total inbound movement exceeds 50 units, ordered by inbound quantity descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH in_mov AS (SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_in FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, total_in FROM in_mov WHERE total_in > 50 ORDER BY total_in DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: List the category code and count of products in each category for categories containing at least 2 products, ordered by product count descending then category code ascending.
items.sql: WITH cat_prod AS (SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(sku) AS p_cnt FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd) SELECT categ_cd, p_cnt FROM cat_prod WHERE p_cnt >= 2 ORDER BY p_cnt DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Show the supplier ID and minimum lead days among supplied products for suppliers whose minimum lead time is under 20 days, ordered by minimum lead days ascending then supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: WITH min_leads AS (SELECT sup_id, MIN(lead_days) AS min_lead FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id) SELECT sup_id, min_lead FROM min_leads WHERE min_lead < 20 ORDER BY min_lead ASC, sup_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and count of distinct suppliers for products sourced from multiple suppliers, ordered by supplier count descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: WITH sku_sups AS (SELECT sku, COUNT(sup_id) AS sup_cnt FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sku) SELECT sku, sup_cnt FROM sku_sups WHERE sup_cnt > 1 ORDER BY sup_cnt DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and product name of electronics items that have a list price over 50 dollars.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 50.00;

items.question: List the SKU and list price for products in the kitchen category that are not discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND disc_flag = 0;

items.question: Find the warehouse ID and warehouse name for facilities serving the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA';

items.question: Display the supplier ID and supplier name for all active suppliers based in the United States.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US';

items.question: Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity for inventory records where stock is currently at or below the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt;

items.question: List the movement ID, SKU, and moved quantity for all stock movements of type adjustment recorded on 2025-10-04.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND DATE(mv_ts) = '2025-10-04';

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for all items supplied by supplier ID 1.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.sup_id = 1;

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and list price for products that are currently held in the Newark Hub warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm, T1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN inventory AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku JOIN warehouse AS T3 ON T2.wh_id = T3.wh_id WHERE T3.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub';

items.question: Find the SKU and product name of items supplied by both supplier ID 1 and supplier ID 6.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.sup_id = 1 INTERSECT SELECT T3.sku, T4.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T3 JOIN prod_catalog AS T4 ON T3.sku = T4.sku WHERE T3.sup_id = 6;

items.question: Get the SKU and product name for products that have a primary supplier with lead days greater than 30.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T2.is_primary = 1 AND T2.lead_days > 30;

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and total on-hand inventory quantity for each warehouse, ordered from highest total quantity to lowest, breaking ties by warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_qty DESC, wh_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU and product name of items that have stock movements of type out.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM inv_move AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.mv_type = 'OUT';

items.question: Find the SKU and product name for products that are supplied by supplier ID 3 but are not stocked in warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.sup_id = 3 EXCEPT SELECT T3.sku, T4.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T3 JOIN prod_catalog AS T4 ON T3.sku = T4.sku WHERE T3.wh_id = 'W1';

items.question: Show the SKU and product name of items that appear in order lines with a unit price strictly greater than 300 dollars.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM ord_line AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.unit_prc > 300.00;

items.question: List the SKU and product name for products that have never been ordered in any order line.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM ord_line);

items.question: Display the category code and the count of products in each category for all products that are not discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_count FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 0 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY prod_count DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the SKU and product name of items supplied by suppliers located in either the US or CA countries.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T1.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T3.country IN ('US', 'CA');

items.question: Show the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers who provide products in the electronics category.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm FROM supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T2.sku = T3.sku WHERE T3.categ_cd = 'ELC';

items.question: List the SKU and product name for products that are supplied by supplier ID 2 and also supplied by supplier ID 3.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.sup_id = 2 INTERSECT SELECT T3.sku, T4.prod_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T3 JOIN prod_catalog AS T4 ON T3.sku = T4.sku WHERE T3.sup_id = 3;

items.question: Find the SKU and product name of items that are stocked in all four warehouses (W1, W2, W3, W4).
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' INTERSECT SELECT T3.sku, T4.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T3 JOIN prod_catalog AS T4 ON T3.sku = T4.sku WHERE T3.wh_id = 'W2' INTERSECT SELECT T5.sku, T6.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T5 JOIN prod_catalog AS T6 ON T5.sku = T6.sku WHERE T5.wh_id = 'W3' INTERSECT SELECT T7.sku, T8.prod_nm FROM inventory AS T7 JOIN prod_catalog AS T8 ON T7.sku = T8.sku WHERE T7.wh_id = 'W4';

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products that have a primary supplier in the US but do not have any stock movements of type in.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T1.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku JOIN supplier AS T3 ON T2.sup_id = T3.sup_id WHERE T2.is_primary = 1 AND T3.country = 'US' EXCEPT SELECT T4.sku, T5.prod_nm FROM inv_move AS T4 JOIN prod_catalog AS T5 ON T4.sku = T5.sku WHERE T4.mv_type = 'IN';

items.question: List the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers who provide at least one product with a list price greater than 100 dollars, excluding any suppliers who supply discontinued products.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sup_id, T1.sup_nm FROM supplier AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T2 ON T1.sup_id = T2.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog AS T3 ON T2.sku = T3.sku WHERE T3.list_prc > 100.00 EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT T4.sup_id, T5.sup_nm FROM prod_supplier AS T4 JOIN supplier AS T5 ON T4.sup_id = T5.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog AS T6 ON T4.sku = T6.sku WHERE T6.disc_flag = 1;

items.question: Find the SKU and product name of items that have recorded stock movements in both warehouse W1 and warehouse W2.
items.sql: SELECT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM inv_move AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.wh_id = 'W1' INTERSECT SELECT T3.sku, T4.prod_nm FROM inv_move AS T3 JOIN prod_catalog AS T4 ON T3.sku = T4.sku WHERE T3.wh_id = 'W2';

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products that have order lines in the order currency but do not have any inventory records in warehouse W4.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.sku, T2.prod_nm FROM ord_line AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W4');

items.question: Show the product SKU, warehouse ID, and on hand quantity for inventory items whose stock is strictly below the reorder point in the Newark Hub warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' AND i.on_hand_qty < i.reorder_pt ORDER BY i.sku ASC

items.question: List the supplier ID and supplier name for all suppliers located in the United States.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sup_nm FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US' ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for all items in the electronic category that are currently marked as discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: List the warehouse ID and warehouse name for the hub serving the European region.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'EU' ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and lead days for supplier ID 3 from the product supplier records.
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE sup_id = 3 ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: List the movement ID, movement timestamp, and quantity for stock movements of type adjustment in the Singapore Hub.
items.sql: SELECT m.mv_id, m.mv_ts, m.qty FROM inv_move m JOIN warehouse w ON m.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm = 'Singapore Hub' AND m.mv_type = 'ADJ' ORDER BY m.mv_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products whose list price is greater than 100 USD.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 100.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: List the order ID, line number, and ordered quantity for order lines that have a quantity of 5 or more units.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, qty FROM ord_line WHERE qty >= 5 ORDER BY ord_id ASC, line_no ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and on hand quantity for inventory records where the stock is above 500 units in warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' AND on_hand_qty > 500 ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC

items.question: List the supplier ID, supplier name, and country for suppliers that provide products in the kitchen category.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, s.country FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'KIT' ORDER BY s.sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products whose list price is higher than the average list price of all products in their respective category.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE p.list_prc > (SELECT AVG(p2.list_prc) FROM prod_catalog p2 WHERE p2.categ_cd = p.categ_cd) ORDER BY p.sku ASC

items.question: List the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers that are flagged as the primary supplier for at least one product.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm FROM supplier s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_supplier ps WHERE ps.sup_id = s.sup_id AND ps.is_primary = 1) ORDER BY s.sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and on hand quantity for inventory rows where the stock level is greater than the average on hand stock of that same warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i WHERE i.on_hand_qty > (SELECT AVG(i2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory i2 WHERE i2.wh_id = i.wh_id) ORDER BY i.wh_id ASC, i.sku ASC

items.question: List the SKU and product name for products that have never appeared in any stock movement records.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_move m WHERE m.sku = p.sku) ORDER BY p.sku ASC

items.question: Show the movement ID, SKU, warehouse ID, and quantity for the latest stock movement recorded for each distinct product.
items.sql: SELECT m.mv_id, m.sku, m.wh_id, m.qty FROM inv_move m WHERE m.mv_ts = (SELECT MAX(m2.mv_ts) FROM inv_move m2 WHERE m2.sku = m.sku) ORDER BY m.sku ASC, m.mv_id ASC

items.question: List the supplier ID, supplier name, and count of products they supply for suppliers that provide more than 2 products.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, COUNT(ps.sku) FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(ps.sku) > 2 ORDER BY COUNT(ps.sku) DESC, s.sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU and product name for products whose list price exceeds the highest list price of any product in the office category.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > (SELECT MAX(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'OFC') ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: List the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and the SKU of the product with the maximum on hand quantity in each warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT w.wh_id, w.wh_nm, i.sku FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE i.on_hand_qty = (SELECT MAX(i2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory i2 WHERE i2.wh_id = w.wh_id) ORDER BY w.wh_id ASC, i.sku ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, product name, and list price for products that have a lead time longer than the average lead time across all product supplier relationships.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p JOIN prod_supplier ps ON p.sku = ps.sku WHERE ps.lead_days > (SELECT AVG(lead_days) FROM prod_supplier) ORDER BY p.sku ASC

items.question: List the supplier ID and supplier name for suppliers who are the primary supplier for every product they supply.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm FROM supplier s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_supplier ps WHERE ps.sup_id = s.sup_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prod_supplier ps WHERE ps.sup_id = s.sup_id AND ps.is_primary = 0) ORDER BY s.sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and on hand quantity for inventory items that have the lowest stock level in their respective warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT i.sku, i.wh_id, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i WHERE i.on_hand_qty = (SELECT MIN(i2.on_hand_qty) FROM inventory i2 WHERE i2.wh_id = i.wh_id) ORDER BY i.wh_id ASC, i.sku ASC

items.question: List the SKU and product name for products that are supplied by both supplier ID 1 and supplier ID 6.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN prod_supplier ps1 ON p.sku = ps1.sku AND ps1.sup_id = 1 JOIN prod_supplier ps2 ON p.sku = ps2.sku AND ps2.sup_id = 6 ORDER BY p.sku ASC

items.question: Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and movement timestamp for the very first stock movement recorded for each warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT m.sku, m.wh_id, m.mv_ts FROM inv_move m WHERE m.mv_ts = (SELECT MIN(m2.mv_ts) FROM inv_move m2 WHERE m2.wh_id = m.wh_id) ORDER BY m.wh_id ASC, m.sku ASC

items.question: List the supplier ID, supplier name, and maximum lead days among the products they supply, for suppliers whose maximum lead days are above 30 days.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, MAX(ps.lead_days) FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING MAX(ps.lead_days) > 30 ORDER BY MAX(ps.lead_days) DESC, s.sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the count of items in the catalog that are discontinued and those that are still sold side by side in a single row.
items.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discontinued_count, SUM(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM prod_catalog

items.question: For each warehouse ID, give me the total inventory on hand and the count of items that have dropped to or below their reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand, SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS items_below_reorder FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: Show me a breakdown of inventory movement types across all warehouses, returning the movement type, total movement quantity, and count of movements in separate columns grouped by movement type.
items.sql: SELECT mv_type, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inv_move GROUP BY mv_type ORDER BY mv_type ASC

items.question: For each supplier ID, list the total count of products supplied and how many of those are flagged as the primary supplier.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS total_products, SUM(CASE WHEN is_primary = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS primary_products_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: Give me the total count of stock movements and the sum of positive quantities (restocks) versus negative quantities (shipments) across all inventory moves.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_movements, SUM(CASE WHEN qty > 0 THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS total_inbound_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN qty < 0 THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS total_outbound_qty FROM inv_move

items.question: For every warehouse ID, show the total number of distinct SKUs currently held in inventory and the number of SKUs that are below their reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS total_skus, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN sku END) AS low_stock_skus FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the count of products in each category code along with the count of products that are discontinued within each category.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS total_products, SUM(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discontinued_products FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC

items.question: For each supplier, calculate the total number of products they provide and the average lead days for their supplied products, ordered by supplier ID.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS product_count, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: For each warehouse, show the warehouse name, the total quantity on hand, and the total reorder point sum across all stored products.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_nm, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand, SUM(t2.reorder_pt) AS total_reorder_pt FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC

items.question: Show the total count of order lines and the sum of quantities ordered for each product category by joining the product catalog and order lines.
items.sql: SELECT t1.categ_cd, COUNT(t2.ord_id) AS total_lines, SUM(t2.qty) AS total_qty_ordered FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN ord_line AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku GROUP BY t1.categ_cd ORDER BY t1.categ_cd ASC

items.question: For each warehouse ID, give me the count of inbound movements (IN), outbound movements (OUT), and adjustment movements (ADJ) side by side in one row per warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_count, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_count, SUM(CASE WHEN mv_type = 'ADJ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adj_count FROM inv_move GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: Show me the distribution of suppliers by country, returning the country code and the count of suppliers in each country, ordered by the supplier count descending then country ascending.
items.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM supplier GROUP BY country ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, country ASC

items.question: For every product category, calculate the total number of products, the average list price, and the count of products priced strictly above 50 USD.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS product_count, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_price, SUM(CASE WHEN list_prc > 50.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_price_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC

items.question: For each supplier ID, show the minimum lead days, maximum lead days, and average lead days for the products they supply.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, MIN(lead_days) AS min_lead_days, MAX(lead_days) AS max_lead_days, AVG(lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the warehouse ID and the total inventory deficit (sum of how much on_hand_qty is below reorder_pt) for items that are currently understocked, for each warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(reorder_pt - on_hand_qty) AS total_deficit FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty < reorder_pt GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: For each region code from the warehouse table, return the warehouse count and the total inventory on hand across all warehouses in that region.
items.sql: SELECT t1.region_cd, COUNT(t1.wh_id) AS warehouse_count, SUM(t2.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id GROUP BY t1.region_cd ORDER BY t1.region_cd ASC

items.question: Give me a summary of product suppliers showing the supplier ID, the count of SKUs they provide, and the count of SKUs where they are designated as the primary supplier.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, COUNT(sku) AS sku_count, SUM(is_primary) AS primary_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: For each SKU in the inventory, calculate the total quantity moved across all stock movements and the count of movement transactions it has been involved in.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS net_moved_qty, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inv_move GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku ASC

items.question: Show the category code and the count of products whose list price is less than or equal to 50 USD versus those greater than 50 USD, side by side.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN list_prc <= 50.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS budget_products, SUM(CASE WHEN list_prc > 50.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS premium_products FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC

items.question: For every supplier, return the supplier ID and the count of products they supply that have a lead time greater than 30 days.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, SUM(CASE WHEN lead_days > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_lead_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: Show me the warehouse ID and the ratio of items below their reorder point to the total number of items stored in that warehouse, expressed as a decimal.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) / COUNT(*) AS low_stock_ratio FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: For each product category, calculate the percentage of discontinued products out of all products in that category.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, (SUM(CASE WHEN disc_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS discontinued_pct FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY categ_cd ASC

items.question: For each warehouse, compute the overall stock health percentage, defined as the percentage of items whose on-hand quantity exceeds their reorder point out of all items stored.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN on_hand_qty > reorder_pt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS healthy_stock_pct FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY wh_id ASC

items.question: For each supplier, calculate the percentage of products they supply where they are marked as the primary supplier out of their total supplied products.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_primary = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS primary_supplier_pct FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sup_id ORDER BY sup_id ASC

items.question: An active supplier is any supplier that currently provides at least one product with a primary supplier flag set to 1. Show the supplier ID and supplier name for all active suppliers, ordered by supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 ORDER BY s.sup_id ASC

items.question: A sluggish item is defined as any product in the electronic category where the current stock on hand across all warehouses is greater than 800 units. Show the SKU and product name for all sluggish items, ordered by product name ascending, breaking ties by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm HAVING SUM(i.on_hand_qty) > 800 ORDER BY p.prod_nm ASC, p.sku ASC

items.question: A stock deficit product is any SKU where the total units on hand in inventory are strictly less than the reorder point summed across all warehouses. Show the SKU, product name, and category code for all stock deficit products, ordered by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.categ_cd FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.categ_cd HAVING SUM(i.on_hand_qty) < SUM(i.reorder_pt) ORDER BY p.sku ASC

items.question: A risky overseas supplier is any supplier located outside the United States (country not equal to 'US') that provides a primary product with a lead time greater than 30 days. Show the supplier name, country, and SKU for these records, ordered by supplier name ascending, breaking ties by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_nm, s.country, ps.sku FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE s.country <> 'US' AND ps.is_primary = 1 AND ps.lead_days > 30 ORDER BY s.sup_nm ASC, ps.sku ASC

items.question: A heavily discounted order line is any order line where the line discount percentage is greater than or equal to 15.00. Show the order ID, line number, SKU, and unit price for all heavily discounted order lines, ordered by order ID ascending, breaking ties by line number ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, sku, unit_prc FROM ord_line WHERE disc_pct >= 15.00 ORDER BY ord_id ASC, line_no ASC

items.question: A prompt warehouse shipment is a shipment where the delivery date is not null and the time difference between delivery date and shipment date is 3 days or fewer. Show the warehouse ID, shipment ID, and order ID for all prompt warehouse shipments, ordered by shipment ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT s.wh_id, s.ship_id, s.ord_id FROM shipment s WHERE s.deliv_dt IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(s.deliv_dt, s.ship_dt) <= 3 ORDER BY s.ship_id ASC

items.question: An emergency stock adjustment is any stock movement where the movement type is ADJ and the quantity moved is less than 0. Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and quantity for all emergency stock adjustments, ordered by SKU ascending, breaking ties by warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ' AND qty < 0 ORDER BY sku ASC, wh_id ASC

items.question: A bulk component order is any order line where the ordered quantity is greater than or equal to 4 units. Show the SKU, order ID, and quantity for all bulk component orders, ordered by quantity descending, breaking ties by order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, ord_id, qty FROM ord_line WHERE qty >= 4 ORDER BY qty DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A high-lead secondary supplier is any supplier that is not the primary supplier (is_primary = 0) and has a lead time of 20 days or more. Show the supplier name, SKU, and lead days for all high-lead secondary suppliers, ordered by lead days descending, breaking ties by supplier name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_nm, ps.sku, ps.lead_days FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 0 AND ps.lead_days >= 20 ORDER BY ps.lead_days DESC, s.sup_nm ASC

items.question: A top-tier warehouse inventory item is any inventory record where the on-hand quantity is greater than 300 and the warehouse is located in the North America region ('NA'). Show the warehouse ID, SKU, and on-hand quantity for all top-tier warehouse inventory items, ordered by on-hand quantity descending, breaking ties by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT i.wh_id, i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE i.on_hand_qty > 300 AND w.region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY i.on_hand_qty DESC, i.sku ASC

items.question: A high-value catalog product is any product with a list price greater than 80.00 that is not discontinued (disc_flag = 0). Show the SKU, product name, and list price for all high-value catalog products, ordered by list price descending, breaking ties by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE list_prc > 80.00 AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC

items.question: An inbound restock shipment is a stock movement of type 'IN' that occurred between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-07 inclusive. Show the SKU, warehouse ID, movement timestamp, and quantity for all inbound restock shipments, ordered by movement timestamp ascending, breaking ties by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts BETWEEN '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-10-07 23:59:59' ORDER BY mv_ts ASC, sku ASC

items.question: A primary multi-source product is any product SKU that has more than one supplier linked to it in the product supplier table. Show the SKU and the count of supplying suppliers for all primary multi-source products, ordered by the supplier count descending, breaking ties by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, COUNT(sup_id) AS supplier_count FROM prod_supplier GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(sup_id) > 1 ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, sku ASC

items.question: A fragile supply chain product is any product where the single primary supplier has a lead time exceeding 25 days. Show the SKU, product name, supplier name, and lead days for all fragile supply chain products, ordered by lead days descending, breaking ties by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.prod_nm, s.sup_nm, ps.lead_days FROM prod_catalog p JOIN prod_supplier ps ON p.sku = ps.sku JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 AND ps.lead_days > 25 ORDER BY ps.lead_days DESC, p.sku ASC

items.question: A critical stock-out risk warehouse item is any inventory record where the on-hand quantity is less than or equal to the reorder point, and the product is actively sold (disc_flag = 0). Show the warehouse name, SKU, product name, on-hand quantity, and reorder point for all critical stock-out risk warehouse items, ordered by on-hand quantity ascending, breaking ties by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT w.wh_nm, i.sku, p.prod_nm, i.on_hand_qty, i.reorder_pt FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE i.on_hand_qty <= i.reorder_pt AND p.disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY i.on_hand_qty ASC, i.sku ASC

items.question: A high-volume outbound mover is any stock movement of type 'OUT' where the absolute quantity moved is greater than 3 units. Show the SKU, warehouse ID, movement timestamp, and quantity for all high-volume outbound movers, ordered by quantity ascending, breaking ties by movement timestamp ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'OUT' AND qty < -3 ORDER BY qty ASC, mv_ts ASC

items.question: An active domestic supplier is any supplier located in the United States ('US') that supplies at least one product with a lead days value of less than 20. Show the supplier name and country for all unique active domestic suppliers, ordered by supplier name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.sup_nm, s.country FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE s.country = 'US' AND ps.lead_days < 20 ORDER BY s.sup_nm ASC

items.question: A specialized regional hub is any warehouse located in either the Asia Pacific ('AP') or Europe ('EU') region. Show the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and region code for all specialized regional hubs, ordered by region code ascending, breaking ties by warehouse ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd IN ('AP', 'EU') ORDER BY region_cd ASC, wh_id ASC

items.question: A heavy inventory deficit product is any product SKU where the sum of on-hand quantities across all warehouses is less than 350 units. Show the SKU and total on-hand quantity for all heavy inventory deficit products, ordered by total on-hand quantity ascending, breaking ties by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(on_hand_qty) < 350 ORDER BY total_on_hand ASC, sku ASC

items.question: A premier supplier partnership is defined as a supplier who provides primary products for at least 2 distinct product categories. Show the supplier ID, supplier name, and count of distinct categories supplied as primary, ordered by category count descending, breaking ties by supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT p.categ_cd) AS cat_count FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.categ_cd) >= 2 ORDER BY cat_count DESC, s.sup_id ASC

items.question: A high-unit order line is an order line where the quantity ordered is 3 or more and the unit price is greater than 100.00. Show the order ID, SKU, quantity, and unit price for all high-unit order lines, ordered by unit price descending, breaking ties by order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, sku, qty, unit_prc FROM ord_line WHERE qty >= 3 AND unit_prc > 100.00 ORDER BY unit_prc DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: A slow-moving inventory surplus is any inventory record where the current on-hand quantity exceeds 500 units and the reorder point is below 400 units. Show the warehouse ID, SKU, on-hand quantity, and reorder point for all slow-moving inventory surpluses, ordered by on-hand quantity descending, breaking ties by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty > 500 and reorder_pt < 400 ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC

items.question: A primary overseas supplier is any supplier outside the United States ('US') that serves as the primary supplier (is_primary = 1) for any product. Show the supplier name, country, and SKU for all primary overseas suppliers, ordered by supplier name ascending, breaking ties by SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_nm, s.country, ps.sku FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE s.country <> 'US' AND ps.is_primary = 1 ORDER BY s.sup_nm ASC, ps.sku ASC

items.question: An ultra-short lead time item is any product supplier relationship where the lead time is strictly less than 15 days. Show the supplier ID, SKU, and lead days for all ultra-short lead time items, ordered by lead days ascending, breaking ties by supplier ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sup_id, sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days < 15 ORDER BY lead_days ASC, sup_id ASC

items.question: Show the employee ID and full name for everyone in the department with code FIN.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'FIN' ORDER BY emp_id

items.question: List the employee ID and full name of Amara Singh's direct reports.
items.sql: SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE m.emp_nm = 'Amara Singh' ORDER BY e.emp_id

items.question: Show the department code and the total number of employees in each department.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd ORDER BY dept_cd

items.question: What is the employee ID and full name of the manager for employee E-002?
items.sql: SELECT m.emp_id, m.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.emp_id = 'E-002'

items.question: List the employee ID and full name of all employees who do not have a manager assigned (top of the tree).
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL ORDER BY emp_id

items.question: Show the department code and employee count for departments that have more than one employee, ordered by headcount descending.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, dept_cd

items.question: List the employee ID, full name, and department code for all employees hired on or after 2019-01-01.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, dept_cd FROM emp WHERE hire_dt >= '2019-01-01' ORDER BY hire_dt, emp_id

items.question: Show the full name and hire date of the employee with ID E-005.
items.sql: SELECT emp_nm, hire_dt FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-005'

items.question: Find the employee ID and full name of employees who manage someone in the ENG department.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.emp_id, m.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.dept_cd = 'ENG' ORDER BY m.emp_id

items.question: List the employee ID and full name of all employees who report directly to Amara Singh's manager.
items.sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = (SELECT mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE emp_nm = 'Amara Singh') ORDER BY emp_id

items.question: Show the employee ID and full name of employees whose manager belongs to the FIN department.
items.sql: SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE m.dept_cd = 'FIN' ORDER BY e.emp_id

items.question: List the department code and the total number of employees who have direct reports within their same department.
items.sql: SELECT e.dept_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT m.emp_id) FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.dept_cd = m.dept_cd GROUP BY e.dept_cd ORDER BY e.dept_cd

items.question: Find the employee ID and full name of employees who have at least two levels of subordinates reporting to them through their direct reports.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m1.emp_id, m1.emp_nm FROM emp m1 JOIN emp m2 ON m2.mgr_emp_id = m1.emp_id JOIN emp m3 ON m3.mgr_emp_id = m2.emp_id ORDER BY m1.emp_id

items.question: Show the full name of each manager along with the count of direct reports they manage, ordered by the count descending.
items.sql: SELECT m.emp_nm, COUNT(e.emp_id) FROM emp m JOIN emp e ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id GROUP BY m.emp_id, m.emp_nm ORDER BY COUNT(e.emp_id) DESC, m.emp_nm

items.question: List the employee ID and full name of employees who were hired before their direct manager was hired.
items.sql: SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON e.mgr_emp_id = m.emp_id WHERE e.hire_dt < m.hire_dt ORDER BY e.emp_id

items.question: Show the department code and the average hire year (extracted via year) for employees in each department.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, AVG(YEAR(hire_dt)) FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd ORDER BY dept_cd

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, list the employee ID, full name, and depth level in the reporting chain for every employee starting from the top-level manager (depth 0).
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE emp_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id, 0 AS depth FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id, et.depth + 1 FROM emp e JOIN emp_tree et ON e.mgr_emp_id = et.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, depth FROM emp_tree ORDER BY depth, emp_id

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, find all subordinates (employee ID and full name) who report up through the management chain to employee E-001 at any level.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE sub_tree AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN sub_tree st ON e.mgr_emp_id = st.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM sub_tree ORDER BY emp_id

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, find the full reporting chain path (listing employee IDs) for employee E-007 up to the top of the tree.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE path_cte AS (SELECT emp_id, mgr_emp_id, CAST(emp_id AS CHAR(200)) AS chain FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-007' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.mgr_emp_id, CONCAT(p.chain, ' -> ', e.emp_id) FROM emp e JOIN path_cte p ON e.emp_id = p.mgr_emp_id) SELECT chain FROM path_cte WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, compute the maximum depth of the reporting hierarchy starting from each top-level manager.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE tree_depth AS (SELECT emp_id AS root_id, emp_id, 0 AS lvl FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT td.root_id, e.emp_id, td.lvl + 1 FROM emp e JOIN tree_depth td ON e.mgr_emp_id = td.emp_id) SELECT root_id, MAX(lvl) FROM tree_depth GROUP BY root_id ORDER BY root_id

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, list the employee ID, full name, and the total count of all indirect and direct subordinates for every manager.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE all_subs AS (SELECT mgr_emp_id AS manager_id, emp_id AS sub_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT asub.manager_id, e.emp_id FROM emp e JOIN all_subs asub ON e.mgr_emp_id = asub.sub_id) SELECT m.emp_id, m.emp_nm, COUNT(asub.sub_id) FROM emp m JOIN all_subs asub ON m.emp_id = asub.manager_id GROUP BY m.emp_id, m.emp_nm ORDER BY m.emp_id

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, find all employees who are in the management chain above employee E-008, showing their employee ID and full name.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE upper_chain AS (SELECT emp_id, emp_nm, mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE emp_id = (SELECT mgr_emp_id FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-008') UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_nm, e.mgr_emp_id FROM emp e JOIN upper_chain uc ON e.emp_id = uc.mgr_emp_id) SELECT emp_id, emp_nm FROM upper_chain ORDER BY emp_id

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, list every employee ID along with the employee ID of the top-most root manager in their respective reporting tree.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE root_finder AS (SELECT emp_id, mgr_emp_id, emp_id AS root_emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.mgr_emp_id, rf.root_emp_id FROM emp e JOIN root_finder rf ON e.mgr_emp_id = rf.emp_id) SELECT emp_id, root_emp_id FROM root_finder ORDER BY emp_id

items.question: Using a recursive CTE, calculate the total salary budget (using salary_amt) of an employee and all their recursive subordinates combined, for manager E-001.
items.sql: WITH RECURSIVE team_sal AS (SELECT emp_id, salary_amt FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-001' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id, e.salary_amt FROM emp e JOIN team_sal ts ON e.mgr_emp_id = ts.emp_id) SELECT SUM(salary_amt) FROM team_sal

items.question: Show the product name and list price for all items in the electronics category.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC';

items.question: List the supplier name and country for suppliers located in the United States.
items.sql: SELECT sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country = 'US';

items.question: List the warehouse name and region code for hubs serving the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'NA';

items.question: Show the product SKU and units on hand for inventory items where the on hand quantity is below two hundred fifty.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty < 250;

items.question: What are the stock movement IDs and quantities for stock count correction movements?
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ';

items.question: Show the order ID and line number for order lines that purchased the product with SKU ELC-026.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no FROM ord_line WHERE sku = 'ELC-026';

items.question: List the product name and list price for discontinued products.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1;

items.question: Show the SKU and lead days for product supplier records where lead days are greater than thirty.
items.sql: SELECT sku, lead_days FROM prod_supplier WHERE lead_days > 30;

items.question: Find the product name and list price for items in the kitchen category priced over fifty dollars, ordered by list price descending, then product name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND list_prc > 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, prod_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the warehouse name and region code for warehouses serving the Asia Pacific or Europe sales regions, sorted by region code then warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd IN ('AP', 'EU') ORDER BY region_cd ASC, wh_nm ASC;

items.question: List the supplier name and country for suppliers in Canada or the United States, ordered by country and supplier name.
items.sql: SELECT sup_nm, country FROM supplier WHERE country IN ('CA', 'US') ORDER BY country ASC, sup_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU and on-hand quantity for inventory records at the Newark Hub warehouse where stock is at or below the reorder point, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' AND i.on_hand_qty <= i.reorder_pt ORDER BY i.sku ASC;

items.question: List the product name and list price for active items in the office category that cost less than one hundred dollars, ordered by list price descending then SKU.
items.sql: SELECT p.prod_nm, p.list_prc FROM prod_catalog p WHERE p.categ_cd = 'OFC' AND p.disc_flag = 0 AND p.list_prc < 100.00 ORDER BY p.list_prc DESC, p.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the movement timestamp and quantity for out-of-stock movements occurring at the Rotterdam Hub warehouse during October 2025, ordered by timestamp then movement ID.
items.sql: SELECT m.mv_ts, m.qty FROM inv_move m JOIN warehouse w ON m.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.wh_nm = 'Rotterdam Hub' AND m.mv_type = 'OUT' AND m.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND m.mv_ts < '2025-11-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY m.mv_ts ASC, m.mv_id ASC;

items.question: List the order ID, line number, and unit price for order lines in the kitchen category with a unit price above eighty dollars, ordered by unit price descending then order ID.
items.sql: SELECT ol.ord_id, ol.line_no, ol.unit_prc FROM ord_line ol JOIN prod_catalog pc ON ol.sku = pc.sku WHERE pc.categ_cd = 'KIT' AND ol.unit_prc > 80.00 ORDER BY ol.unit_prc DESC, ol.ord_id ASC, ol.line_no ASC;

items.question: Show the product name and list price for discontinued electronics products, sorted by list price ascending then product name.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 1 ORDER BY list_prc ASC, prod_nm ASC;

items.question: Find the supplier name, product name, and lead days for primary supplier assignments of home category products, ordered by lead days descending, supplier name, and SKU.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_nm, p.prod_nm, ps.lead_days FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.sup_id = s.sup_id JOIN prod_catalog p ON ps.sku = p.sku WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 AND p.categ_cd = 'HOM' ORDER BY ps.lead_days DESC, s.sup_nm ASC, p.sku ASC;

items.question: For each warehouse serving the North America region, list the warehouse name, the total number of inventory SKUs held, and the sum of on-hand quantities, sorted by warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT w.wh_nm, COUNT(i.sku) AS sku_count, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM warehouse w JOIN inventory i ON w.wh_id = i.wh_id WHERE w.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY w.wh_id, w.wh_nm ORDER BY w.wh_nm ASC;

items.question: List the product name, category code, and total units moved for products that have recorded restock movements, returning only products with total restocked units greater than one hundred, ordered by total units descending then product name.
items.sql: SELECT p.prod_nm, p.categ_cd, SUM(m.qty) AS total_restocked FROM prod_catalog p JOIN inv_move m ON p.sku = m.sku WHERE m.mv_type = 'IN' GROUP BY p.sku, p.prod_nm, p.categ_cd HAVING SUM(m.qty) > 100 ORDER BY total_restocked DESC, p.prod_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the supplier name, country, and count of products supplied where they act as the primary supplier, restricted to suppliers with at least one primary product, ordered by primary product count descending then supplier name.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_nm, s.country, COUNT(ps.sku) AS primary_prod_count FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id WHERE ps.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm, s.country ORDER BY primary_prod_count DESC, s.sup_nm ASC;

items.question: For each product category, list the category code, the count of products in the catalog, and the average list price, ordered by average list price descending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(sku) AS product_count, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_list_price FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY avg_list_price DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the warehouse name, product SKU, and on-hand quantity for inventory records where the stock is strictly less than the reorder point across warehouses in the Asia Pacific region, ordered by warehouse name then SKU.
items.sql: SELECT w.wh_nm, i.sku, i.on_hand_qty FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE w.region_cd = 'AP' AND i.on_hand_qty < i.reorder_pt ORDER BY w.wh_nm ASC, i.sku ASC;

items.question: List the product name, warehouse name, and movement quantity for out movements of electronics products that occurred during October 2025, ordered by movement quantity ascending, product name, and warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT p.prod_nm, w.wh_nm, m.qty FROM inv_move m JOIN prod_catalog p ON m.sku = p.sku JOIN warehouse w ON m.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE p.categ_cd = 'ELC' AND m.mv_type = 'OUT' AND m.mv_ts >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND m.mv_ts < '2025-11-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY m.qty ASC, p.prod_nm ASC, w.wh_nm ASC;

items.question: Show the supplier name and the average lead days for all suppliers, restricted to suppliers whose average lead days exceed twenty days, ordered by average lead days descending then supplier name.
items.sql: SELECT s.sup_nm, AVG(ps.lead_days) AS avg_lead_days FROM supplier s JOIN prod_supplier ps ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm HAVING AVG(ps.lead_days) > 20.0 ORDER BY avg_lead_days DESC, s.sup_nm ASC;
